name: 罗兰·班克斯
text:
[reaction]你击败一个敌人后：发现你所在地点的1个线索。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：你所在地点每有一个线索，+1。
real_text:
[reaction] After you defeat an enemy: Discover 1 clue at your location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each clue on your location.
flavor:
事无巨细的办案准则过去有用，
但现在照本宣科可行不通了。
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-5，探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：罗兰的.38特制手枪、掩盖罪证、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 遵照流程和规则往往让罗兰感到放心。身为联邦探员，罗兰的手册在任何情况下都能派上用场，这真是令他宽慰。但最近，他的联邦探员手册在任务里完全派不上用场。无论多么努力，罗兰也找不到哪里提及了遭遇奇怪生物、时空之门，和魔法咒文的对策。要不是亲眼所见，他自己也绝不会相信……他的上峰也是绝不会明白的。罗兰知道，这次他可得靠自己了。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Roland's .38 Special, Cover Up, 1 random basic weakness.

name: 黛西·沃克
text:
你可以在自己回合期间执行额外一个行动，该行动只能用于[[书籍]]的[action]能力。
[elder_sign]效果：+0。如果你检定成功，你每控制一个[[书籍]]，抽取1张卡牌。
real_text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used on [[Tome]] [action] abilities.
[elder_sign] effect: +0. If you succeed, draw 1 card for each [[Tome]] you control.
flavor: “我知道有些书强大无比，甚至能改写现实。”
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：黛西的手提包、死灵之书：约翰·迪伊译本、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 黛西是米斯卡塔尼克大学里受人尊敬的图书馆员，她一直都觉得自己生命里最重要的就是书。恐怖、暴力、惊俱，这些日常生活中嫌恶的东西，她在书里倒是看得津津有味。她随即一头陷进了约翰·迪伊翻译的《死灵之书》。这是亵渎、污秽，毛骨悚然、难以置信。但根据自己对神秘事物和密教主题的研究，黛西知道，这本书里事实大于虚构。她开始好奇，在奥恩图书馆的限制区里，还藏着什么其他秘密……
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Daisy’s Tote Bag, The Necronomicon (John Dee Translation), 1 random basic weakness.

name: “倒霉蛋”奥图尔
text:
[free]在你回合期间，花费2资源：你本回合可以进行额外1次行动。(每回合仅限一次)
[elder_sign]效果：+2。如果你成功，获得2资源。
real_text:
[fast] During your turn, spend 2 resources: You may take an additional action this turn. (Limit once per turn.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. If you succeed, gain 2 resources.
flavor: “我从狱中出来，可不是为了看世界末日的。”
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-5，守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：在逃中、医院债务、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: “倒霉蛋”本来想做个好人。但有的时候，要对得起自己的良心，就得不干不净。尽管他要钱是为了妈妈的手术，但这些条子可不会管。就在他服刑的第二年，妈妈因病去世。但狱友布拉德·霍林告诉他，还有比死亡更糟糕的事。他每晚都无声地嘶喊“古神”之事，把自己梦到的奇异旅程都告诉“倒霉蛋”。“倒霉蛋”本来没当回事，直到有一晚，他起夜看到了狱友烧成了灰。等到终于出狱的时候，“倒霉蛋”回到了阿卡姆寻求答案。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): On the Lam, Hospital Debts, 1 random basic weakness.

name: 艾格尼丝·贝克
text:
[reaction]有恐惧放置到艾格尼丝·贝克后：对你所在地点的1个敌人造成1点伤害。(每阶段仅限一次)
[elder_sign]效果：艾格尼丝·贝克每有1点恐惧，+1。
real_text:
[reaction] After 1 or more horror is placed on Agnes Baker: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. (Limit once per phase.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each horror on Agnes Baker.
flavor: “我记得另一段人生，满是巫术和征服。”
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：希波利尔传家宝、黑暗回忆、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 艾格尼丝·贝克今生可能只是个毕恭毕敬的侍应，但在超越现代世界想象的前生，她可是个强大的女巫。一切都源自她在自家阁楼那堆落满灰的传家宝里发现的奇怪神器一一大概是某种钥匙。她触碰的时候，记忆如潮水般涌来，一同奔流的还有另一个词：“希波利尔”。越是深入幻景和前世的记忆，她的力量也就越强大……但她也就更加害怕。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Heirloom of Hyperborea, Dark Memory, 1 random basic weakness.

name: 温蒂·亚当斯
text:
[reaction]在你揭示一个混乱标记时，选择并弃掉你1张手牌：取消该混乱标记并将其放回混乱袋。揭示一个新的混乱标记。(每次检定/能力仅限一次)
[elder_sign]效果：+0。如果温蒂的护身符在场，改为你自动成功。
real_text:
[reaction] When you reveal a chaos token, choose and discard 1 card from your hand: Cancel that chaos token and return it to the bag. Reveal a new chaos token. (Limit once per test/ability.)
[elder_sign] effect: +0. If Wendy's Amulet is in play, you automatically succeed instead.
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-5，流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：温蒂的护身符、被抛弃的孤单、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 温蒂还小的时候，妈妈常让她玩自己的项链。妈妈会讲她的故事，温蒂则转着项链，看它闪闪发光。然后，话就说到爸爸在海上失踪，妈妈也开始行为古怪，在房子里用粉笔画满了反常的符号。妈妈被带到了疯人院，温蒂则去了孤儿院。但妈妈在被带走前，把项链留给了温蒂，说是能“保护她”。温蒂在孤儿院里待了几年，然后溜了出来，她决定能靠自己活得更好。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Wendy's Amulet, Abandoned and Alone, 1 random basic weakness.

name: 罗兰 的.38特制手枪
text: 罗兰·班克斯牌库专用。 使用(4子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+1[combat](如果你所在地点至少有1个线索，改为你得到+3[combat])。本次攻击造成+1伤害。
real_text: Roland Banks deck only. Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack (if there are 1 or more clues on your location, you get +3 [combat], instead). This attack deals +1 damage.
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械

name: 掩盖罪证
text: 显现 - 将掩盖罪证放置入场，放到你的威胁区域，并在上面放置3个线索。 [reaction]在你将要发现你所在地点的至少1个线索时：改为弃掉掩盖罪证上同等数量的线索。 强制 - 在游戏结束时，如果掩盖罪证上有线索：你承受1点精神创伤。
real_text: Revelation - Put Cover Up into play in your threat area, with 3 clues on it. [reaction] When you would discover 1 or more clues at your location: Discard that many clues from Cover Up instead. Forced - When the game ends, if there are any clues on Cover Up: You suffer 1 mental trauma.

name: 黛西的手提包
text:
黛西·沃克牌库专用。
你拥有额外2个手部槽位，只可以用来携带[[书籍]]支援。
real_text:
Daisy Walker deck only.
You have 2 additional hand slots, which can only be used to hold [[Tome]] assets.

name: 死灵之书
text: 显现 - 将死灵之书放置入场，放到你的威胁区域，带有3点恐惧。死灵之书上有恐惧时不能离场。 将你揭示的每个混乱标记上的[elder_sign]视为[auto_fail]。 [action]：将死灵之书的1点恐惧移动到黛西·沃克上。然后，如果死灵之书没有恐惧，将其弃掉。
real_text: Revelation - Put The Necronomicon into play in your threat area, with 3 horror on it. It cannot leave play while it has 1 or more horror on it. Treat each [elder_sign] you reveal on a chaos token as a [auto_fail]. [action]: Move 1 horror from The Necronomicon to Daisy Walker. Then, if The Necronomicon has no horror on it, discard it.

name: 在逃中
text:
“倒霉蛋”奥图尔牌库专用。
快速。在你回合开始后打出。
直到本轮结束，非[[精英]]敌人不能攻击你。
real_text:
"Skids" O'Toole deck only.
Fast. Play after your turn begins.
Until the end of the round, non-[[Elite]] enemies cannot attack you.
flavor: 我不会再进局子了。

name: 医院债务
text: 显现 - 将医院债务放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 [free]：将你资源池的1资源移动到医院债务。(每轮限制两次。) 强制 - 在游戏结束时，如果医院债务的资源少于6：你本场冒险少取得2点经验值。
real_text: Revelation - Put Hospital Debts into play in your threat area. [fast]: Move 1 resource from your resource pool to Hospital Debts. (Limit twice per round.) Forced - When the game ends, if Hospital Debts has fewer than 6 resources on it: You earn 2 fewer experience for this scenario.

name: 希波利尔传家宝
text:
艾格尼丝·贝克牌库专用。
[reaction]你打出一张[[法术]]卡后：抽取1张卡牌。
real_text:
Agnes Baker deck only.
[reaction] After you play a [[Spell]] card: Draw 1 card.
flavor: 这表面的刻痕日日生变，甚至我不经意间的时时刻刻都在变。

name: 黑暗回忆
text: 在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果能导致当前密谋推进。 强制 - 如果当你回合结束时，黑暗回忆在你手中：将其揭示并受到2点恐惧。
real_text: Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance. Forced - If Dark Memory is in your hand at the end of your turn, reveal it and take 2 horror.
flavor: 不……别再来了！

name: 温蒂的护身符
text: 温蒂·亚当斯牌库专用。 你可以打出你弃牌堆最顶部的事件，如同其是你的手牌。 强制 - 你打出一张事件后或者从场上弃掉一张事件后：不将其放入你的弃牌堆，改为将其放到你的牌库底。
real_text: Wendy Adams deck only. You may play the topmost event in your discard pile as if it were in your hand. Forced - After you play an event or discard an event from play: Place it on the bottom of your deck instead of in your discard pile.

name: 被抛弃的孤单
text: 显现 - 受到2点直接恐惧并将你弃牌堆的所有卡牌从游戏中移除。
real_text: Revelation - Take 2 direct horror and remove all cards in your discard pile from the game.
flavor: 我不需要他们。我不需要任何人。

name: 专业的直觉
text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
发现你所在地点的1个线索。
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Discover 1 clue at your location.

name: 屏障
text: 附属到你所在地点。 非[[精英]]敌人不能移动进入附属的地点。 强制 - 在一位调查员离开附属地点时：弃掉屏障。
real_text: Attach to your location. Non-[[Elite]] enemies cannot move into attached location. Forced - When an investigator leaves attached location: Discard Barricade.

name: 推理
text: 如果调查一个地点时本技能检定成功，额外发现该地点的1个线索。
real_text: If this skill test is successful while investigating a location, discover 1 additional clue at that location.
flavor: 我知道我看过这个符号。我必须赶在一切太迟之前警告其他人！

name: 放大镜
text:
快速。
你在调查时得到+1[intellect]。
[free]如果你所在地点没有线索：将放大镜返回你的手牌。
real_text:
Fast.
You get +1 [intellect] while investigating.
[fast] If there are no clues on your location: Return Magnifying Glass to your hand.
flavor: 透镜映照出平时看不见的世界，揭示的一切你却并不想看见。

name: 伊察姆纳圆盘
text: [reaction]在非[[精英]]敌人生成在你所在地点时，弃掉伊察姆纳圆盘：弃掉该敌人。
real_text: [reaction] When a non-[[Elite]] enemy spawns at your location, discard Disc of Itzamna: Discard that enemy.
flavor: 他们是害怕护身符对他们的效果？还是说，他们是害怕护身符对你的效果？

name: 百科全书
text: [action]横置百科全书：选择你所在地点的一位调查员。直到本阶段结束，该调查员得到一项技能值(由你选择)+2。
real_text: [action] Exhaust Encyclopedia: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator gets +2 to a skill of your choice until the end of the phase.
flavor: 这本该包罗万象，但我越在书页中寻找，就越是发现我们其实对字宙一无所知。

name: 隐秘的研究
text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
选择你所在地点的一位调查员。该调查员抽取3张卡牌。
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator draws 3 cards.

name: 弹簧刀
text: 快速。 [action]：攻击。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，本次攻击造成+1伤害。
real_text: Fast. [action]: Fight. If you succeed by 2 or more, this attack deals +1 damage.
traits: 道具. 武器. 近战. 违法

name: 夜盗
text: [action]横置夜盗：调查。如果你检定成功，不发现线索，改为获得3资源。
real_text: [action] Exhaust Burglary: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, gain 3 resources.

name: 扒窃
text: [reaction]在你躲避1个敌人后，横置扒窃：抽取1张卡牌。
real_text: [reaction] After you evade an enemy, exhaust Pickpocketing: Draw 1 card.

name: .41短口手枪
text: 使用(3子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，本次攻击造成+1伤害。
real_text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed by 2 or more, this attack deals +1 damage.
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法

name: 里奥·德·卢卡
text: 在你回合期间，你可以进行额外一次行动。
real_text: You may take an additional action during your turn.
flavor: “其实我出生在密西西比。路易斯安那只是更好听。”

name: 沉重打击
text:
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[combat]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility]。
real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.

name: 逃避隐藏
text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
和每个与你交战的敌人解除交战，并移动到一个没有敌人的已揭示地点。
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Disengage from each enemy engaged with you and move to a revealed location with no enemies.

name: 背刺
text: 攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[agility]。本次攻击造成+2伤害。
real_text: Fight. This attack uses [agility] instead of [combat]. This attack deals +2 damage.

name: 偷袭
text: 对你所在地点的1个横置敌人造成2点伤害。
real_text: Deal 2 damage to an exhausted enemy at your location.

name: 机会主义者
text:
只能投入你正在执行的技能检定。
如果你检定成功且超过难度至少3点，在本次检定后不将机会主义者弃掉，改为将其返回你的手牌。
real_text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing.
If you succeed by 3 or more, return Opportunist to your hand after this test instead of discarding it.

name: 里奥·德·卢卡
text: 在你回合期间，你可以进行额外一次行动。
real_text: You may take an additional action during your turn.
flavor: “其实我出生在密西西比。路易斯安那只是更好听。”

name: 飞贼
text:
你得到+1[agility]。
[action]横置飞贼：和每个与你交战的敌人解除交战，并移动到一个连接地点。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
real_text:
You get +1 [agility].
[action] Exhaust Cat Burglar: Disengage from each enemy engaged with you and move to a connecting location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: 老千手法
text:
快速。在你揭示一个带有负值修正的混乱标记后打出。
将该标记的“-”变为“+”。
real_text:
Fast. Play after you reveal a chaos token with a negative modifier.
Switch that token's "-" to a "+".

name: 百战百胜
text: 获得10资源。
real_text: Gain 10 resources.
flavor: “我又赢咯！抱歉，甜心，你只是今晚运气有点差。”

name: 禁忌知识
text:
使用(4秘密)。如果禁忌知识没有秘密，将其弃掉。
[free]横置禁忌知识并受到1点恐惧：将禁忌知识上的1秘密移动到你的资源池，作为资源。
real_text:
Uses (4 secrets). If Forbidden Knowledge has no secrets, discard it.
[fast] Exhaust Forbidden Knowledge and take 1 horror: Move 1 secret from Forbidden Knowledge to your resource pool, as a resource.

name: 圣玫瑰珠
text: 你得到+1[willpower]。
real_text: You get +1 [willpower].
flavor: 无论是平常小物还是玄奥神器，蕴含在信仰之中的真正力量都是一样。

name: 皱缩术
text: 使用(4充能)。 [action]花费1充能：攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]，并造成+1伤害。如果本次攻击期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，受到1点恐惧。
real_text: Uses (4 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat] and deals +1 damage. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this attack, take 1 horror.

name: 探知术
text:
使用(3充能)。
[action]横置探知术并花费1充能：查看任意一位调查员的牌库顶或遭遇牌库顶3张卡牌。将其以任意顺序放回该牌库顶。
real_text:
Uses (3 charges).
[action] Exhaust Scrying and spend 1 charge: Look at the top 3 cards of any investigator's deck or the encounter deck. Return them to the top of that deck in any order.

name: 神秘研究
text:
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[intellect]。
real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test.

name: 新晋术士
text: 强制 - 在新晋术士入场后：在上面放置1个毁灭标记。 [free]横置新晋术士：查找你牌库顶的3张卡牌，找出一张[[法术]]卡牌并将其抽取。混洗你的牌库。
real_text: Forced - After Arcane Initiate enters play: Place 1 doom on it. [fast] Exhaust Arcane Initiate: Search the top 3 cards of your deck for a [[Spell]] card and draw it. Shuffle your deck.

name: 飞蛾扑火
text: 抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。然后，发现你所在地点的2个线索。
real_text: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. Then, discover 2 clues at your location.
flavor: “我们生活在无限的黑海上，重重迷雾中一个名为无知的孤岛。但这并不意味着我们就该远航。”<cite>——H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《克苏鲁的呼唤》</cite>

name: 守护结界
text:
快速。在你抽取一张非弱点的诡计卡牌时打出。
取消该卡牌的显现效果。然后，受到1点恐惧。
real_text:
Fast. Play when you draw a non-weakness treachery card.
Cancel that card's revelation effect. Then, take 1 horror.

name: 眩光一闪
text: 躲避。本次躲避尝试不使用[agility]，改为使用[willpower]。如果你检定成功，对刚躲避的敌人造成1点伤害。如果本次躲避尝试期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，本回合失去1个行动。
real_text: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to the enemy just evaded. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this evasion attempt, lose 1 action this turn.

name: 无所畏惧
text: 如果本次技能检定成功，治愈1点恐惧。
real_text: If this skill test is successful, heal 1 horror.
flavor: 只有在黑暗面前站稳脚步，才能活着看到明天的太阳。

name: 记忆抹消
text:
快速。在一个阶段开始后打出。
选择你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人。将所选敌人的印刷文本框视为如同空白(除[[特性]]外)，直到本阶段结束。
real_text:
Fast. Play after a phase begins.
Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. Treat the chosen enemy's printed text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]) until the end of the phase.

name: 眩光一闪
text: 躲避。这次躲避尝试不使用[agility]，改为使用[willpower]。如果你检定成功，对刚躲避的敌人造成2点伤害。如果本次躲避尝试期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，本回合失去1个行动并受到1点恐惧。
real_text: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. If you succeed, deal 2 damage to the enemy just evaded. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this evasion attempt, lose 1 action this turn and take 1 horror.

name: 影之书
text:
你拥有额外1个法术槽位。
[action]横置影之书：为你控制的一个[[法术]]支援增加1充能。
real_text:
You have 1 additional arcane slot.
[action] Exhaust Book of Shadows: Add 1 charge to a [[Spell]] asset you control.

name: 诡秘石像
text:
使用(4充能)。如果诡秘石像没有充能，将其弃掉。
[reaction]在你将要揭示一个混乱标记时，花费1充能：改为揭示2个混乱标记，而非1个。选择其中1个标记结算，并忽略另一个。
real_text:
Uses (4 charges). If Grotesque Statue has no charges, discard it.
[reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token, spend 1 charge: Reveal 2 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose 1 of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the other.

name: 皮大衣
flavor: 皮大衣可能不是最时尚的选择，但又厚又大，非常抗寒、可靠。

name: 拾荒
text: [reaction]在你成功调查，且超过难度至少2点后，横置拾荒：在你的弃牌堆中选择一张[[道具]]卡牌，将其加入你的手中。
real_text: [reaction] After you successfully investigate by 2 or more, exhaust Scavenging: Choose an [[Item]] card in your discard pile and add it to your hand.

name: 球棒
text: [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。本次攻击造成+1伤害。如果本次攻击期间揭示了[skull]或[auto_fail]符号，在攻击结算后弃掉球棒。
real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. If a [skull] or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this attack, discard Baseball Bat after the attack resolves.
traits: 道具. 武器. 近战

name: 幸运兔脚
text: [reaction]在你技能检定失败后，横置幸运兔脚：抽取1张卡牌。
real_text: [reaction] After you fail a skill test, exhaust Rabbit's Foot: Draw 1 card.
flavor: 他们说这能给我带来好运。我本来不信。但现在我觉得，要是丢了它，我可真要倒霉了。

name: 野猫
text: [free]弃掉野猫：自动躲避你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人。
real_text: [fast] Discard Stray Cat: Automatically evade a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location.
flavor: 他向来无视你的呼唤。看来他总是有自己的密谋。

name: 深挖
text:
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility]。
real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.

name: 调虎离山
text: 躲避。自动躲避你所在地点的所有敌人。
real_text: Evade. Automatically evade all enemies at your location.
flavor: 这应该能为我们争取点时间。

name: “看看我发现了什么！”
text:
快速。你调查时，技能检定失败且低于难度2点及以内后打出。
发现你所在地点的2个线索。
real_text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 2 or less while investigating.
Discover 2 clues in your location.

name: 运气好！
text:
快速。在你技能检定将要失败时打出。
该次检定你得到技能值+2。
real_text:
Fast. Play when you would fail a skill test.
Get +2 to your skill value for that test.

name: 求生本能
text: 如果尝试躲避期间本次技能检定成功，躲避的调查员可以立即和每个与其交战的其他敌人解除交战，并可以移动到一个连接地点。
real_text: If this skill test is successful during an evasion attempt, the evading investigator may immediately disengage from each other enemy engaged with him or her, and may move to a connecting location.

name: 安奎娜
text: [reaction]在敌人攻击你时，横置安奎娜并对她造成1点恐惧：改为对你所在地点的另一个敌人造成该敌人的伤害。(你依然受到此次攻击的恐惧。)
real_text: [reaction] When an enemy attacks you, exhaust Aquinnah and deal 1 horror to her: Deal that enemy's damage to another enemy at your location, instead. (You still take horror dealt by the attack.)
flavor: “不要害怕你所看到的。害怕你看不到的。”

name: 千钧一发
text:
快速。在你所在地点的一个非弱点、非[[精英]]敌人被躲避后打出。
将该敌人混洗入遭遇牌库。
real_text:
Fast. Play after a non-weakness, non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location is evaded.
Shuffle that enemy into the encounter deck.

name: 运气好！
text:
快速。在你技能检定将要失败时打出。
该次检定你得到技能值+2。抽取1张卡牌。
real_text:
Fast. Play when you would fail a skill test.
Get +2 to your skill value for that test. Draw 1 card.

name: 生存意志
text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
你执行的所有技能检定都不揭示混乱标记，直到你回合结束。
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Until the end of your turn, do not reveal chaos tokens for any skill tests you perform.

name: 刀子
text: [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+1[combat]。 [action]弃掉刀子：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。本次攻击造成+1伤害。
real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. [action] Discard Knife: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage.
traits: 道具. 武器. 近战

name: 手电筒
text: 使用(3补给)。 [action]花费1补给：调查。本次调查你所在地点的隐藏值-2。
real_text: Uses (3 supplies). [action] Spend 1 supply: Investigate. Your location gets -2 shroud for this investigation.

name: 应急物品
text: 获得3资源。
real_text: Gain 3 resources.
flavor: 有备无患，多多益善。

name: 胆识
text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
如果本次检定成功，抽取1张卡牌。
real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card.
flavor: 退后！我会搞定的！

name: 洞察力
text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
如果本次检定成功，抽取1张卡牌。
real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card.
flavor: 终于，我找到了！

name: 压制
text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
如果本次检定成功，抽取1张卡牌。
real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card.
flavor: 死吧，你这怪物！

name: 心灵手巧
text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
如果本次检定成功，抽取1张卡牌。
real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card.
flavor: 易如反掌。

name: 绝处逢生
text: 每次技能检定最多投入1张。
real_text: Max 1 committed per skill test.
flavor: 有时候，最意想不到的地方会有最无私的举动。

name: 防弹衣
flavor: 子弹是一回事……十二英寸长的尖牙又是另一回事了。

name: 远古印记护身符
flavor: 这东西在我家里代代相传。好好关照它，它也会好好关照你的。

name: 失忆
text: 显现 - 选择并弃掉你的手牌，只剩1张。
real_text: Revelation - Choose and discard all but 1 card from your hand.
flavor: 等等……我在哪？我在干吗？

name: 妄想症
text: 显现 - 弃掉你全部资源。
real_text: Revelation - Discard all your resources.
flavor: 那噪音是什么？

name: 恶灵附身
text: 显现 - 将恶灵附身加入你的威胁区域。 你得到每项技能-1。 [action][action]：弃掉恶灵附身。
real_text: Revelation - Add Haunted to your threat area. You get -1 to each of your skills. [action][action]: Discard Haunted.

name: 神经紊乱
text: 显现 - 将神经素乱加入你的威胁区域。 强制 - 你受到恐惧后：受到1点直接伤害。 [action][action]：弃掉神经紊乱。
real_text: Revelation - Add Psychosis to your threat area. Forced - After you take 1 or more horror: Take 1 direct damage. [action][action]: Discard Psychosis.

name: 忧郁症
text: 显现 - 将忧郁症加入你的威胁区域。 强制 - 你受到伤害后：受到1点直接恐惧。 [action][action]：弃掉忧郁症。
real_text: Revelation - Add Hypochondria to your threat area. Forced - After you take 1 or more damage: Take 1 direct horror. [action][action]: Discard Hypochondria.

name: 黑帮打手
text: 猎物 - 仅对承受者。 猎手。 [action] 花费4资源：谈判。弃掉黑帮打手。
real_text: Prey - Bearer only. Hunter. [action] Spend 4 resources: Parley. Discard Mob Enforcer.
flavor: 你知道自己不该跟欧巴尼恩帮借钱的。看起来他们总是挑你最糟的时候收债。

name: 银暮秘社僧侣
text: 猎物 - 仅对承受者。 猎手。 强制 - 在银暮秘社僧侣攻击后：在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。
real_text: Prey - Bearer only. Hunter. Forced - After Silver Twilight Acolyte attacks: Place 1 doom on the current agenda.
traits: 类人. 异教徒. 銀暮结社
flavor: 你永远也忘不了，自己得知银暮秘社核心圈真正秘密的那一天。这真相太过可怕，秘社不会任你活着。

name: 固执的侦探
text: 猎物 - 仅对承受者。 猎手。 固执的侦探和你位于同一地点时，将你的调查员视为印刷文本框如同空白([[特性]]除外)。
real_text: Prey - Bearer only. Hunter. While Stubborn Detective is at your location, treat your investigator as if his or her printed text box were blank (except for [[Traits]]).
flavor: 费尽口舌，他还是觉得你跟这些谋杀案有关。

name: 急救
text:
使用(4补给)。如果急救没有补给，将其弃掉。
[action]花费1补给：治愈你所在地点的一位调查员或一个[[盟友]]支援1点伤害和1点恐惧。
real_text:
Uses (4 supplies). If First Aid has no supplies, discard it.
[action] Spend 1 supply: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset in your location.

name: “我见过更糟的……”
text:
快速。在你受到伤害和/或恐惧时打出。
取消你刚受到的伤害和/或恐惧中最多5点。然后，获得同等数量的资源。
real_text:
Fast. Play when you are dealt damage and/or horror.
Cancel up to 5 damage and/or horror just dealt to you. Then, gain that many resources.

name: 寻找答案
text: 调查。如果你成功，不发现你所在地点的一个线索，改为发现你所在地点和连接地点的总计2个线索。
real_text: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering a clue at your location, discover 2 total clues from among your location and connecting locations.
flavor:
有人不惜一切代价也要知道真相。
但有些真相比利刃更伤人。

name: 智慧古书
text:
使用(2秘密)。
[action]横置智慧古书：选择你所在地点的一位调查员。该调查员查找其牌库顶3张卡牌，找出一张将其抽取，并将剩余卡牌混洗入自己牌库。然后，你可以花费1秘密，使该调查员立即打出该卡牌，其费用-2。
real_text:
Uses (2 secrets).
[action] Exhaust Old Book of Lore: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator searches the top 3 cards of their deck for a card, draws it, and shuffles their deck. Then, you may spend 1 secret to have that investigator immediately play that card, reducing its cost by 2.

name: 撬锁工具
text: 使用(3补给)。如果撬锁工具没有补给，将其弃掉。 [action]横置撬锁工具：调查。本次调查将你的[agility]值加入你的技能值。如果你未超过难度至少2点并成功，从撬锁工具移除1补给。
real_text: Uses (3 supplies). If Lockpicks has no supplies, discard it. [action] Exhaust Lockpicks: Investigate. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this investigation. If you do not succeed by at least 2, remove 1 supply from Lockpicks.
traits: 道具. 工具. 违法

name: .41短口手枪
text: 使用(3子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少1点，本次攻击造成+1伤害。每回合一次，如果你检定成功且超过难度至少3点，你本回合可以进行额外一次行动。
real_text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed by 1 or more, this attack deals +1 damage. Once per turn, if you succeed by 3 or more, you may take an additional action this turn.
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法

name: 礼寻术
text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]花费1充能：调查。本次调查不使用[intellect]，改为使用[willpower]。你本次检定得到+2[willpower]。如果检定成功，你发现所在地点额外1个线索。如果本次检定期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，本次检定结算后，失去所有剩余的行动，立即结束你的回合。
real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using [willpower] instead of [intellect]. You get +2 [willpower] for this test. If you succeed you discover 1 additional clue at this location. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this test, after this test resolves lose all remaining actions and immediately end your turn.

name: 探知术
text:
使用(3充能)。
[free]横置探知术并花费1充能：查看任意一位调查员的牌库顶或遭遇牌库顶3张卡牌。将其以任意顺序放回该牌库顶。如果查看的卡牌中有[[恐怖]]或[[征兆]]卡牌，受到1点恐惧。
real_text:
Uses (3 charges).
[fast] Exhaust Scrying and spend 1 charge: Look at the top 3 cards of any investigator's deck, or the encounter deck. Return them to the top of that deck, in any order. If a [[Terror]] or [[Omen]] card is among the looked-at cards, take 1 horror.

name: 安奎娜
text: [reaction]在敌人攻击你时，横置安奎娜并对她造成1点恐惧：改为对你所在地点的任意一个敌人造成该敌人的伤害。(你依然受到此次攻击的恐惧。)
real_text: [reaction] When an enemy attacks you, exhaust Aquinnah and deal 1 horror to her: Deal that enemy's damage to any enemy at your location, instead. (You still take horror dealt by the attack.)
flavor: “不要害怕你所看到的。害怕你看不到的。”

name: 美满结局
text:
快速。在技能检定期间，你揭示一个混乱标记，且该标记将要令你的技能值减少到0时打出(包括[auto_fail]标记)。
取消该标记并改为将其视作[elder_sign]标记。
real_text:
Fast. Play when you reveal a chaos token that would reduce your skill value to 0 during a skill test (including the [auto_fail] token).
Cancel that token and treat it as an [elder_sign] token, instead.

name: 应急物品
text: 获得3资源并抽取1张卡牌。
real_text: Gain 3 resources and draw 1 card.
flavor: 有备无患，多多益善。

name: 魅力超凡
text:
永久。
你拥有额外1个盟友槽位。
real_text:
Permanent.
You have 1 additional ally slot.
flavor: 魅力光芒万丈，全城为之闪亮。

name: 宝物猎人
text:
永久。
你拥有额外1个饰品槽位。
real_text:
Permanent.
You have 1 additional accessory slot.
flavor: 翻石破砖苦，殚精竭虑忙。旧宝传千古，妙手一扫光。

name: 马克·哈里根
text: 你开始游戏时把索菲(深切的思念)放置入场。 [reaction]有伤害放置到你控制的卡牌上后：抽取1张卡牌。(每阶段仅限一次)。 [elder_sign]效果：马克·哈里根身上每有一点伤害，+1。
real_text: You begin the game with Sophie (In Loving Memory) in play. [reaction] After damage is placed on a card you control: Draw 1 card. (Limit once per phase.) [elder_sign] effect: +1 for each damage on Mark Harrigan.
flavor: 如果有必要，他可以烧了整座城，但他不会再让那些怪物夺走任何人的生命。
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，[[策略]]卡牌等级0。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：保卫后方、炮弹休克、索菲、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 有无数人拖着残缺的身体和受伤的心灵从战场回到家乡。但马克·哈里根见证的恐怖却是他无法解释的。当他写信回家时，把自己的见闻告诉了他心爱的索菲，她对此深信不疑——残杀人类的不是人类，而是些不明生物。他回家看她时，终于发现为什么她那么相信自己了：这种生物就寄宿在她体内，从内部啃食着她，从她体内破肚而出。在无助和恐惧之下，马克看着那个生物享用完它的美餐，看着索菲尖叫着消失在空气之中。现在所有人都觉得马克·哈里根疯了。也许他是疯了，但他知道那些怪物是真实存在的，除非消灭所有这些怪物，否则他永远不会罢手。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, [[Tactic]] cards level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): The Home Front, Shell Shock, Sophie, 1 random basic weakness.

name: 潘明
text:
[reaction]你所在地点的调查员在技能检定中投入一张卡牌后：直到本次技能检定结束，该卡牌获得一个[wild]图标。(每位调查员每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。本次技能检定结束后，你可以选择投入本次技能检定的一张技能卡牌返回其所有者的手牌。
real_text:
[reaction] After an investigator at your location commits a card to a skill test: That card gains a [wild] icon until the end of the test. (Limit once for each investigator per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may choose a skill card committed to this skill test to return to its owner's hand after this test ends.
flavor: “相信我，我可以带你穿越未知的领域。”
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-2。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：镇密分析、黄衣之王(第一幕)、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 潘明感觉自己从未融入美国。在移居之前，她居住在日本统治下的韩国，那时作为越南人的她生活更为艰难。她始终不忘自己的父母做出了多大牺牲才举家迁来美国，于是她勤奋学习，考取了大学文凭。终于有一天，她父亲结识了一位来自阿卡姆的托马斯先生，对方邀请她来自己公司工作。起初托马斯先生对她非常和善一一但自从他开始阅读《黄衣之王》后，他性情大变。他把书借给潘明，但她看完第一章后就始终不敢继续阅读。三个星期后，人们发现托马斯先生自杀身亡…而真相就隐藏在这本《黄衣之王》中。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Analytical Mind, The King in Yellow (Act 1), 1 random basic weakness.

name: 赛菲娜·卢梭
text: 强制 - 在你将要抽取起始手牌时：改为抽取13张卡牌。选择最多5张事件放在本卡牌底下，并保留8张卡牌作为你的起始手牌。弃掉其余卡牌。(你不能重调。) [action]：选择并抽取本卡牌底下的一张事件。不会触发趁乱攻击。 [elder_sign]效果：+3。你可以选择并抽取本卡牌底下的一张事件。
real_text: Forced - When you would draw your opening hand: Draw 13 cards, instead. Choose up to 5 events to place beneath this card and keep 8 cards as your opening hand. Discard the rest. (You cannot mulligan.) [action]: Choose an event beneath this card and draw it. Does not provoke attacks of opportunity. [elder_sign] effect: +3. You may choose an event beneath this card and draw it.
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：33。 牌库构建选项：流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-2。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：3张画中世界、1张毕宿星团、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 打小开始，赛菲娜漂亮的画就吸引了许多人的眼球。后来，一位巴黎的艺术收藏家来到塔希提岛，发现了赛菲娜，给了她一份工作，但要求她为他绘制赝品。赛菲娜敏锐的眼光和稳健的巧手让她成为这份工作不二的人选，而她也发现造假工艺比她想象中更能激发她的热情。最近一位腰缠万贯的匿名陌生人给了她一份活，要她重绘出一座奇怪的异星城市的全景图。当她完成最后一笔时，她猛地被拖入了画中的世界。筋疲力竭之下，她昏厥了过去，差一点当场暴毙。她醒来时，已身处自己的画室，这时她知道，一切都是真实的。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 33. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 3 copies of The Painted World, 1 copy of Stars of Hyades, 1 random basic weakness.

name: 阿喀琦·奥耶莉
text:
你带有“使用(充能)”的支援入场时带有额外1点充能。
[elder_sign]效果：+1。你控制的一张带有“使用(充能)”的支援增加1点充能。
real_text:
Your assets with "uses (charges)" enter play with 1 additional charge on them.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Add 1 charge to an asset with "uses (charges)" you control.
flavor:
“我会渡越彼岸。
我不惧怕它们。”
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，带有“使用(充能)”的卡牌等级0-4，[[密教]]卡牌等级0。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：灵言者、怒灵、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 阿喀琦来自尼日利亚，她从小就和他人格格不入。她经常与空气对话，也不和其他孩子一起玩耍，所以村里人觉得她疯了。而村子的先知第一个发现了她的潜力。他相信神灵选中了阿喀琦是需要她去成就大事，于是他教会了她如何发挥潜力与神灵交流。在他的教导下，阿喀琦迅速成长为一名年轻睿智的领袖，不仅她所在的村子，所有她帮助过的社群都对她尊敬有加。现在她要踏上征途，运用她独有的知识去解决那些只有她能解决的非自然问题。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, cards with "uses (charges)" level 0-4, [[Occult]] cards level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Spirit-Speaker, Angered Spirits, 1 random basic weakness.

name: 威廉·约里克
text: [reaction]在你击败敌人后：从你的弃牌堆(支付其费用)打出一张支援。(每轮仅限一次。) [elder_sign]效果：+2。如果本次检定成功，将你弃牌堆中的1张卡牌返回你的手牌。
real_text: [reaction] After you defeat an enemy: Play an asset from your discard pile (paying its cost). (Limit once per round.) [elder_sign] effect: +2. If this test is successful, return 1 card from your discard pile to your hand.
flavor: “我不过是这场剧中的一个演员，但如果运气好，我会活着看到落幕。”
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-2。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：挖土深埋、墓地食尸鬼、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 威廉·约里克从没想过要当一个挖墓人。他早年学习演艺，在波士顿当了多年演员，承接所有角色。莎士比亚的剧当然精彩，但是过了那么多年却没有接到几个角色的他也不得不承认舞台不是他的归宿。挖墓是一件沉闷的工作，但死者却是最好的观众，而威廉最喜欢的就是戏剧独白。但当他发现一群堕落的生物在啃食墓地里的尸体时，一切又变得不同了。自从那一晚起，为了保护死者，约里克用尽了各种手段驱赶那些生物。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Bury Them Deep, Graveyard Ghouls, 1 random basic weakness.

name: 萝拉·海耶斯
text: 强制 - 你抽取起始手牌后：选择一个角色([survivor]、[guardian]、[seeker]、[rogue]、[mystic]或中立)。 你能打出、投入或触发能力的卡牌只限于中立卡牌和你所选角色的卡牌。 [free]：切换你的角色。(每轮仅限一次。) [elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以切换角色。
real_text: Forced - After you draw your opening hand: Choose a role ([survivor], [guardian], [seeker], [rogue], [mystic], or Neutral). You can only play, commit, or trigger abilities on Neutral cards or cards of your role. [fast]: Switch your role. (Limit once per round.) [elder_sign] effect: +2. You may switch roles.
flavor: 也许这次是她东山再起的最好时机。
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：35。 牌库构建选项：求生者、守卫者、探求者、流浪者和潜修者卡牌([survivor]、[guardian]、[seeker]、[rogue]、[mystic])等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：2张即兴表演、2张身份危机、1张随机基础弱点。 附加需求：你的牌库必须包含3个不同职阶([survivor]、[guardian]、[seeker]、[rogue]、[mystic])，每个职阶至少7张卡牌。
back_flavor: 萝拉在全球各地出演剧目时，戏票每每都被抢购一空，但从没有一部剧像《黄衣之王》一般不详而诡异。就连排练期间，戏班子都连遭厄运。一天，与她联袂出演的米里亚姆被人发现浮尸于塞纳河上，她终于崩溃了，提笔写下辞职信，告诉导演下一场就是自己的告别演出。现在她回到自己的家乡阿卡姆，准备最后一次演出，她也希望这一次能永远告别这出可怕的戏剧。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 35. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor, Guardian, Seeker, Rogue, and Mystic cards ([survivor], [guardian], [seeker], [rogue], and [mystic]) level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 2 copies of Improvisation, 2 copies of Crisis of Identity, 1 random basic weakness. Additional Requirements: Your deck must include at least 7 cards each from 3 different classes ([survivor], [guardian], [seeker], [rogue], or [mystic]).

name: 保卫后方
text:
马克·哈里根牌库专用。
如果攻击期间本次技能检定成功，将马克哈里根上的1点伤害移动到被攻击敌人上。
real_text:
Mark Harrigan deck only.
If this skill test is successful during an attack, move 1 damage from Mark Harrigan to the attacked enemy.
flavor: 真正的战争现在才开始。

name: 炮弹休克
text: 显现 - 你身上每有2点伤害，受到1点恐惧。
real_text: Revelation - For every 2 damage on you, take 1 horror.
flavor: 战争永远不会改变。

name: 索菲
text: 马克·哈里根牌库专用。 索菲不能离场。 [free]受到1点直接伤害：你本次技能检定得到技能值+2。 强制 - 如果马克·哈里根身上有5点或更多伤害：将索菲翻面。
real_text: Mark Harrigan deck only. Sophie cannot leave play. [fast] Take 1 direct damage: You get +2 to your skill value for this skill test. Forced - If Mark Harrigan has 5 or more damage on him: Flip Sophie.
back_text: 索菲不能離場。 你每項技能-1。 強制 - 如果馬克·哈里根身上有4點或更少傷害：將索菲翻面。

name: 索菲
text: 索菲不能离场。 你得到每项技能-1。 强制 - 如果马克·哈里根身上有4点或更少伤害：将索菲翻面。
real_text: Sophie cannot leave play. You get -1 to each of your skills. Forced - If Mark Harrigan has 4 or less damage on him: Flip Sophie.

name: 缜密分析
text:
潘明牌库专用。
每次其他地点的调查员执行技能检定，你都可以投入1张卡牌。
[reaction]你在技能检定中投入正好1张卡牌后，横置缜密分析：抽取1张卡牌。
real_text:
Minh Thi Phan deck only.
You may commit 1 card to each skill test performed by an investigator at another location.
[reaction] After you commit exactly 1 card to a skill test, exhaust Analytical Mind: Draw 1 card.

name: 黄衣之王
text: 显现 - 将黄衣之王放置入场，放到你的威胁区城。除非通过以下[reaction]能力，否则它不能离场。 你不能在技能检定中投入正好1或2张卡牌。 [reaction]技能检定成功且潘明投入至少6个与该次检定对应的技能图标后：弃掉黄衣之王。
real_text: Revelation - Put The King in Yellow into play in your threat area. It cannot leave play except through the [reaction] ability below. You cannot commit exactly 1 or 2 cards to a skill test. [reaction] After a skill test is successful in which Minh Thi Phan has committed at least 6 matching skill icons for that test: Discard The King in Yellow.

name: 画中世界
text:
赛菲娜·卢梭牌库专用。
不能放在赛菲娜·卢梭底下。
将画中世界作为赛菲娜·卢梭底下的一张非卓越事件打出。不要弃掉画中世界，改为将其从游戏中移除。
real_text:
Sefina Rousseau deck only.
Cannot be placed beneath Sefina Rousseau.
Play The Painted World as an exact copy of a non-exceptional event that is beneath Sefina Rousseau. Remove The Painted World from the game instead of discarding it.

name: 毕宿星团
text: 显现 - 随机选择赛菲娜·卢梭底下的一张事件，将其从游戏中移除。如果你不能这么做，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。如果你的牌库有5张或以上卡牌，不要弃掉毕宿星团，改为将其洗回你的牌库。
real_text: Revelation - Randomly choose an event beneath Sefina Rousseau and remove it from the game. If you cannot, take 1 damage and 1 horror. If your deck has 5 or more cards in it, shuffle Stars of Hyades back into your deck instead of discarding it.

name: 灵言者
text: 阿喀琦·奥耶莉牌库专用。 [free]横置灵言者：选择你控制的一张带有“使用(充能)”的支援。将该支援返回你的手牌，或将该支援上的所有充能(作为资源)移动到你的资源池井弃掉该支援。
real_text: Akachi Onyele deck only. [fast] Exhaust Spirit-Speaker: Choose an asset you control with "uses (charges)." Either return that asset to your hand, or move all charges from that asset to your resource pool (as resources) and discard that asset.

name: 怒灵
text: 显现 - 将怒灵放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 [free]横置一张[[法术]]支援：将该支援上的1充能移动到怒灵上。 强制 - 在游戏结束时，如果怒灵上的充能少于4：你承受1点肉体创伤。
real_text: Revelation - Put Angered Spirits into play in your threat area. [fast] Exhaust a [[Spell]] asset: Move 1 charge from that asset to Angered Spirits. Forced - When the game ends, if Angered Spirits has fewer than 4 charges on it: You suffer 1 physical trauma.

name: 挖土深埋
text: 威廉·约里克牌库专用。 快速。你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人被击败后打出。 将该敌人(和本卡牌)加入胜利区。
real_text: William Yorick deck only. Fast. Play after a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location is defeated. Add that enemy (and this card) to the victory display.
flavor: “这些虽然是疯话，却有深意在内。”<cite>威廉·莎士比亚，《哈姆雷特》</cite>

name: 墓地食尸鬼
text: 猎物 - 仅对威廉·约里克。 猎手。 墓地食尸鬼与你交战时，你弃牌堆中的卡牌不能离开弃牌堆。
real_text: Prey - William Yorick only. Hunter. While Graveyard Ghouls is engaged with you, cards cannot leave your discard pile.
traits: 类人. 怪物. 食尸鬼
flavor: “地狱空荡荡，魔鬼在人间。”<cite>威廉·莎士比亚，《暴风雨》</cite>

name: 即兴表演
text:
萝拉·海耶斯牌库专用。
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
切换你的角色。直到你的回合结束，你打出的下一张你所选角色的卡牌资源费用减少3点。抽取1张卡牌。
real_text:
Lola Hayes deck only.
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Switch your role. Until the end of your turn, reduce the resource cost of the next card you play of your role by 3. Draw 1 card.

name: 身份危机
text: 显现 - 弃掉你控制的全部你当前角色的卡牌。然后，弃掉你牌库顶1张卡牌。将你的角色切换到该弃掉的卡牌职阶(如果弃掉的卡牌是弱点，切换到中立角色)。
real_text: Revelation - Discard all cards you control of your current role. Then, discard the top card of your deck. Switch your role to the class of the discarded card (if the discarded card is a weakness, switch your role to neutral).
flavor: “我演过那么多角色，就算疯了也是正常的。”

name: .32柯尔特手枪
text: 使用(6子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击造成+1伤害。
real_text: Uses (6 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You deal +1 damage for this attack.
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械
flavor: 虽然发明了半自动枪械，但许多警官和私有枪支持有者仍然相信左轮手枪更为可靠。

name: 勇气过人
text: 你所在地点的其他调查员受到的伤害可以分配给勇气过人。
real_text: True Grit may be assigned damage dealt to other investigators at your location.
flavor: 只是轻伤。

name: “放着我来！”
text:
快速。另一位调查员抽取了一张非险境遭遇卡牌后，结算该卡牌效果前打出。
改为视为你抽取了该遭遇卡牌。结算该卡牌的显现效果时，你得到每项技能+2。
real_text:
Fast. Play after another investigator draws a non-peril encounter card, but before resolving that card's effects.
You are considered to have drawn that encounter card, instead. You get +2 to each of your skills while resolving that card's revelation effect.

name: 时刻警惕
text: 依次从你手中打出最多3张支援，每张资源费用减少1点。
real_text: One at a time, play up to 3 assets from your hand, reducing the resource cost of each by 1.
flavor: 不得不说，洛根这家伙对世界末日真的留了一手。

name: 实地调查
text: [reaction]你移动到一个地点后，如果该地点至少有1个线索，横置实地调查：本阶段你执行的下一次技能检定得到技能值+2。
real_text: [reaction] After you move to a location, if that location has at least 1 clue on it, exhaust Fieldwork: You get +2 skill value for the next skill test you perform this phase.
flavor: 要是这都不能让吉尼进入探险家俱乐部，那就没可能了。

name: 古代雕文
text: [action]弃掉你手牌中一张含有至少1个[intellect]技能图标的卡牌：从供应堆拿取1资源放到古代雕文上，作为秘密。 强制 - 第三个秘密放到古代雕文上后：弃掉古代雕文并获得5资源。在你的剧本日志上记录下“你翻译出了雕文”。
real_text: [action] Discard a card with at least 1 [intellect] skill icon from your hand: Place 1 resource on Archaic Glyphs from the token pool, as a secret. Forced - After the third secret is placed on Archaic Glyphs: Discard Archaic Glyphs and gain 5 resources. Record in your Campaign Log that "you have translated the glyphs."
traits: 道具. 密教. 书籍

name: 殚精竭虑
text: 选择你所在地点的一位调查员。该调查员查找其牌库顶6张卡牌，找出一张卡牌，将其抽取，并混洗其牌库。
real_text: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator searches the top 6 cards of his or her deck for a card, draws it, and shuffles his or her deck.

name: 掌握内幕
text: 使用(3秘密)。 [action]花费1秘密：调查。调查场上任意一个已揭示的地点，如同你在该地点。
real_text: Uses (3 secrets). [action] Spend 1 secret: Investigate. Investigate any revealed location in play as if you were at that location.

name: 潜行
text: [action]横置潜行：躲避。所选敌人本次躲避尝试得到-2躲避。如果你成功躲避该敌人，与它解除交战但不要横置它。直到你回合结束，该敌人不能与你交战。
real_text: [action] Exhaust Stealth: Evade. The chosen enemy gets -2 evade for this evasion attempt. If you successfully evade the enemy, disengage with it but do not exhaust it. Until the end of your turn, that enemy cannot engage you.

name: 障眼戏法
text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
将你手牌中的一张[[道具]]支援放置入场。当你的回合结束时，如果该支援依然在场，将其返回你手牌。
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Put an [[Item]] asset into play from your hand. At the end of your turn, if that asset is still in play, return it to your hand.

name: 艺高胆大
text:
快速。在你技能检定将要成功时打出。
你本次检定得到+2技能值。
real_text:
Fast. Play when you would succeed at a skill test.
You get +2 skill value for this test.
flavor:
“麦克格林，你想让我们两个都送命吗？”
“这次不会了，伙计。这次不会了。”

name: 撬锁工具
text: 使用(3补给)。如果撬锁工具没有补给，将其弃掉。 [action]横置撬锁工具：调查。本次调查将你的[agility]值加入你的技能值。如果你未超过难度至少2点并成功，从撬锁工具移除1补给。
real_text: Uses (3 supplies). If Lockpicks has no supplies, discard it. [action] Exhaust Lockpicks: Investigate. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this investigation. If you do not succeed by at least 2, remove 1 supply from Lockpicks.
traits: 道具. 工具. 违法

name: 炼金转化
text:
使用(3充能)。
[action]横置炼金转化，花费1充能：检定[willpower](1)。你检定成功且每超过难度1点，获得1资源(最多3个)。如果本次检定期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，受到1点伤害。
real_text:
Uses (3 charges).
[action] Exhaust Alchemical Transmutation, spend 1 charge: Test [willpower] (1). For each point you succeed by, gain 1 resource (to a maximum of 3). If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this test, take 1 damage.

name: 解锢灵魂
text: 从你手牌打出一张[[法术]]或[[仪式]]卡牌，其资源费用减少3点。
real_text: Play a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] card from your hand, reducing its resource cost by 3.
flavor: 力量攫获了她，让她浑身战栗，痉挛。能量与她融为一体，然后，她睁开了双眼……

name: 星界旅行
text: 移动。移动到任意一个已揭示的地点并从混乱袋随机揭示一个标记。如果你揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，你必须弃掉一张你控制的[[道具]]或[[盟友]]支援(如果你不能这么做，受到1点伤害)。
real_text: Move. Move to any revealed location and reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, you must discard an [[Item]] or [[Ally]] asset you control (if you cannot, take 1 damage).
flavor: 跨维度的旅行存在风险，这他很清楚。但谁能抗拒那超越时空的疆域呢？

name: 灵力祭祀刀
text: [free]在[[法术]]卡牌的技能检定期间，横置灵力祭祀刀：你本次检定得到+2技能值。 [action]横置灵力祭祀刀：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。
real_text: [fast] During a skill test on a [[Spell]] card, exhaust Spirit Athame: You get +2 skill value for this test. [action] Exhaust Spirit Athame: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 武器. 近战

name: 提灯
text: [action]：调查。本次调查你所在地点的隐藏值-1。 [action]弃掉提灯：对你所在地点的一个敌人造成1点伤害。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
real_text: [action]: Investigate. Your location gets -1 shroud for this investigation. [action] Discard Lantern: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: 挖墓人的铲子
text: [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。 [action]弃掉挖墓人的铲子：发现你所在地点的1个线索。
real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. [action] Discard Gravedigger's Shovel: Discover 1 clue at your location.
traits: 道具. 工具. 武器. 近战
flavor: 我知道我不应该再挖了，但我就是停不下来。

name: 藏身地点
text: 快速。将藏身地点附属到任意一个地点上。 位于被附属地点的每个非[[精英]]敌人获得冷漠。 强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时，如果有重整敌人在被附属地点：弃掉藏身地点。
real_text: Fast. Attach Hiding Spot to any location. Each non-[[Elite]] enemy at attached location gains aloof. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if a ready enemy is at attached location: Discard Hiding Spot.
flavor: 一只羊、两只羊……

name: 急中生智
text: 如果本次技能检定成功，选择你弃牌堆中一张名称不是急中生智的[survivor]卡牌。将所选卡牌加入你的手牌。
real_text: If this skill test is successful, choose a [survivor] card not named Resourceful in your discard pile. Add the chosen card to your hand.

name: 头脑发热
text: 显现 - 抽取遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。该卡牌获得涌动。
real_text: Revelation - Draw the top card of the encounter deck. That card gains surge.
flavor: “不要担心，现在局势完全在我掌控之下！”

name: 涂绘印记
text: 显现 - 将涂绘印记放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你的手牌上限减少5张。(FAQ v1.6) [action][action]：弃掉涂绘印记。
real_text: Revelation - Put Drawing the Sign into play in your threat area. Your maximum hand size is reduced by 5. [action][action]: Discard Drawing the Sign.

name: 随行鬼影
text: 生成 - 距离你最远的地点。 猎物 - 仅对承受者。 猎手。 强制 - 在随行鬼影将要被击败时：改为将其洗入承受者的牌库。
real_text: Spawn - Location farthest from you. Prey - Bearer only. Hunter. Forced - When The Thing That Follows would be defeated: Instead shuffle it into its bearer's deck.
flavor: 无论天涯海角，始终不离不弃。

name: 英勇救援
text:
快速。在一个非[[精英]]敌人将要攻击你所在地点的另一位调查员时打出。
改为你与该敌人交战并对你结算它的攻击。然后，对其造成1点伤害。
real_text:
Fast. Play when a non-[[Elite]] enemy would attack another investigator at your location.
Engage that enemy and resolve its attack against you instead. Then, deal it 1 damage.

name: 战斗训练
text:
快速。[[沉稳]]卡牌场上仅限1张。
非直接恐惧在分配到你的调查员卡牌之前，必须先分配给战斗训练。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[combat]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility]。
real_text:
Fast. Limit 1 [[Composure]] in play.
Non-direct horror must be assigned to Combat Training before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.

name: 解剖图表
text:
快速。在任意调查员的回合期间打出。仅当你剩余神智值为5点或以上才可打出。
选择你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人。直到当前调查员的回合结束，该敌人得到-2攻击和-2躲避。
real_text:
Fast. Play during any investigator's turn. Play only if you have 5 or more remaining sanity.
Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. Until the end of the active investigator's turn, that enemy gets -2 fight and -2 evade.
flavor: 它们再怎么样也只是动物。但那只是我们的想法。

name: 科学理论
text:
快速。[[沉稳]]卡牌场上仅限1张。
非直接恐惧在分配到你的调查员卡牌之前，必须先分配给科学理论。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[intellect]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[combat]。
real_text:
Fast. Limit 1 [[Composure]] in play.
Non-direct horror must be assigned to Scientific Theory before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.

name: 指节铜环
text: [action]：攻击。本次攻击造成+1伤害。被攻击敌人本次攻击获得反击。
real_text: [action]: Fight. This attack deals +1 damage. The attacked enemy gains retaliate for this attack.
traits: 道具. 武器. 近战. 违法
flavor: 近距离贴身肉搏：内奥米的最爱。

name: 刚毅果敢
text:
快速。[[沉稳]]卡牌场上仅限1张。
非直接恐惧在分配到你的调查员卡牌之前，必须先分配给刚毅果敢。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower]。

[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.

name: 大卫·伦费尔德
text:
大卫·伦费尔德身上有至少1个毁灭标记时，你得到+1[willpower]。
[free]横置大卫伦费尔德：你可以在大卫·伦费尔德身上放置1个毁灭标记。大卫·伦费尔德身上每有一个毁灭标记，获得1资源。
real_text:
While David Renfield has at least 1 doom on him, you get +1 [willpower].
[fast] Exhaust David Renfield: You may place 1 doom on David Renfield. Gain 1 resource for each doom on David Renfield.

name: 情绪稳定
text:
快速。[[沉稳]]卡牌场上仅限1张。
非直接恐惧在分配到你的调查员卡牌之前，必须先分配给情绪稳定。
[free]在[[法术]]卡牌的技能检定期间，花费1资源：你本次检定得到技能值+1。

Fast. Limit 1 [[Composure]] in play.
Non-direct horror must be assigned to Grounded before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
[fast] During a skill test on a [[Spell]] card, spend 1 resource: You get +1 skill value for this test.

name: 珍爱纪念
flavor: 帕特森先生一直告诉温蒂一切都会好起来的。但帕特森先生终究只是一只泰迪熊，他什么都不懂。

name: 有胆有识
text:
快速。[[沉稳]]卡牌场上仅限1张。

每次技能检定最多投入1张。

name: 双刃短刀
text: 你执行的交战行动不会触发趁乱攻击。 [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+X[combat]。X为与你交战的敌人数量。
