flavor: 它经历的暴力事件比大部分人一辈子见过的都要多。

name: 埋伏
text: 附属到你所在地点。 如果被附属地点没有调查员，弃掉理伏。 强制 - 有敌人生成在被附属地点后：对该敌人造成2点伤害并弃掉埋伏。
real_text: Attach to your location. If there are no investigators at attached location, discard Ambush. Forced - After an enemy spawns at attached location: Deal 2 damage to that enemy and discard Ambush.

name: 查尔斯·罗斯大人
text:
你可以花费资源来支付你所在地点的其他调查员打出的[[道具]]支援。
[free]横置查尔斯·罗斯大人：下一张你所在地点的调查员打出的[[道具]]支援的费用减少1点。
real_text:
You may spend resources to pay for [[Item]] assets played by other investigators at your location.
[fast] Exhaust Charles Ross, Esq.: Reduce the cost of the next [[Item]] asset played by an investigator at your location by 1.

name: 预先警告
text:
快速。在你抽取一张非弱点的诡计卡牌时打出。
将你的1个线索放到你所在地点。然后，取消该卡牌的显现效果。
real_text:
Fast. Play when you draw a non-weakness treachery card.
Place 1 of your clues on your location. Then, cancel that card's revelation effect.
flavor: 知己知彼者，百战不殆。

name: 达里奥·埃尔阿明
text:
你拥有10点或更多资源时，你得到+1[willpower]和+1[intellect]。
[action]如果你所在地点没有敌人，横置达里奥·埃尔阿明：获得2资源。
real_text:
While you have 10 or more resources, you get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
[action] If there are no enemies at your location, exhaust Dario El-Amin: Gain 2 resources.

name: 偷袭
text: 对你所在地点的一个未与你交战的敌人造成2点伤害。
real_text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy not engaged with you at your location.

name: 灵力风暴
text: 攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。如果你检定成功，本次攻击不造成标准伤害，改为对被攻击敌人所在地点的每个敌人造成2点伤害(所有额外伤害只对被攻击敌人造成)。如果本次攻击期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，对被攻击敌人所在地点的每位调查员造成1点伤害。(FAQ v2.0)
real_text: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. If you succeed, instead of its standard damage, this attack deals 2 damage to each enemy at the attacked enemy's location (any additional damage is dealt to the attacked enemy). If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] token is revealed during this attack, deal 1 damage to each investigator at the attacked enemy's location.

name: 影之书
text: [action]横置影之书并花费1资源：为你控制的一个[[法术]]支援增加1充能。
real_text: [action] Exhaust Book of Shadows and spend 1 resource: Add 1 charge to a [[Spell]] asset you control.

name: 战斗或逃跑
text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
直到本轮结束，你得到+X[combat]和+X[agility]，其中X为你身上的恐俱数量。
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Until the end of the round, you get +X [combat] and +X [agility], where X is the amount of horror on you.

name: 意志考验
text:
快速。在你所在地点的一位调查员抽取一张非弱点诡计卡牌时打出。
取消该卡牌的显现效果。放逐意志考验。
real_text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location draws a non-weakness treachery card.
Cancel that card's revelation effect. Exile A Test of Will.
flavor: 无论是否看得到希望，你所能做的只有抵抗。

name: 吉人天相
text:
快速。在你受到伤害和/或恐惧时打出。
取消你刚受到的伤害和/或恐惧中最多10点。放逐吉人天相。
real_text:
Fast. Play when you are dealt damage and/or horror.
Cancel up to 10 damage and/or horror just dealt to you. Exile Devil's Luck.
flavor: “那可是我最喜欢的帽子！”

name: 施恩求报
text: 选择一张你控制的[[盟友]]支援并将其返回你的手牌。然后，查找你牌库顶9张卡牌，找出1张[[盟友]]支援并将其打出，其费用减少X点。X为返回你手牌的[[盟友]]支援的费用。混洗你的牌库。
real_text: Choose an [[Ally]] asset you control and return it to your hand. Then, search the top 9 cards of your deck for an [[Ally]] asset and play it, reducing its cost by X. X is the cost of the [[Ally]] asset returned to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
flavor: “接线员，麻烦你把电话挂断。”

name: “同归于尽！”
text: 击败与你交战的每个非[[精英]]敌人。你被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
real_text: Each non-[[Elite]] enemy engaged with you is defeated. You are defeated and suffer 1 physical trauma. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
flavor: 他点燃了打火机，内心平静了下来。

name: .45自动手枪
text: 使用(4子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。本次攻击造成+1伤害。本次攻击忽略反击关键词。
real_text: Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. Ignore the retaliate keyword for this attack.
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械

name: 逻辑推理
text:
仅当你至少拥有1个线索才可打出。
选择你所在地点的一位调查员。该调查员治愈2点恐惧或弃掉其威胁区域中的一张[[恐怖]]卡牌。
real_text:
Play only if you have at least 1 clue.
Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator either heals 2 horror or discards a [[Terror]] card from his or her threat area.
flavor: “我是活着的最智慧的人，因为我知道一件事，那就是我知道我一无所知。”<cite>——柏拉图，《理想国》</cite>

name: 古代雕文
text: 研究完成。(FAQ v2.0)使用(3充能)。 [action]花费1充能：调查。你检定成功且每超过难度2点，发现你所在地点的额外1个线索。
real_text: Researched. Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. For every 2 points you succeed by, discover 1 additional clue at your location.

name: 古代雕文
text: 研究完成。(FAQ v2.0)使用(3充能)。 [action]花费1充能：调查。如果你检定成功，你可以自动躲避一个与你交战的敌人。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
real_text: Researched. Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. If you succeed, you may automatically evade an engaged enemy. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: 暗中偷袭
text: 攻击。本次攻击将你的[agility]值加入你的技能值。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，自动躲避被攻击敌人。
real_text: Fight. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this attack. If you succeed by 2 or more, automatically evade the attacked enemy.
flavor: “瞄准眼晴。”他们这么告诉我的。

name: 扒窃
text:
快速。
[reaction]在你躲避一个敌人后，横置扒窃：抽取1张卡牌或获得1资源。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，改为执行以上两项。
real_text:
Fast.
[reaction] After you evade an enemy, exhaust Pickpocketing: Draw 1 card or gain 1 resource. If you succeeded by 2 or more, do both instead.

name: 量子通量
text: 将你的弃牌堆洗入你的牌库并抽取1张卡牌。将量子通量从游戏中移除。
real_text: Shuffle your discard pile into your deck and draw 1 card. Remove Quantum Flux from the game.

name: 重新充能
text: 选择你所在地点的一位调查员控制的一张[[法术]]或[[遗物]]支援，并从混乱袋随机揭示一个混乱标记。如果你揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，弃掉所选支援。否则，为所选支援增加3充能。
real_text: Choose a [[Spell]] or [[Relic]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location and reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, discard the chosen asset. Otherwise, add 3 charges to the chosen asset.

name: 拉布兰奇夫人
text:
[free]如果你没有手牌，横置拉布兰奇夫人：抽取1张卡牌。
[free]如果你没有资源，横置拉布兰奇夫人：获得1资源。
real_text:
[fast] If you have no cards in your hand, exhaust Madame Labranche: Draw 1 card.
[fast] If you have no resources, exhaust Madame Labranche: Gain 1 resource.

name: 诱捕陷阱
text: 附属到你所在地点。每个地点仅限1张。 强制 - 在一个非[[精英]]敌人进入被附属地点后：横置该敌人，它与所有调查员解除交战，井将诱捕陷阱附属到它上。 强制 - 在被附属敌人将要重整时：改为弃掉诱捕陷阱。
real_text: Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location. Forced - After a non-[[Elite]] enemy enters attached location: Exhaust that enemy, disengage it from all investigators, and attach Snare Trap to it. Forced - When attached enemy would ready: Instead, discard Snare Trap.

name: 身先士卒
text: 如果本次技能检定成功，重整你所在地点的一个[[盟友]]支援并治愈其1点伤害或1点恐惧。
real_text: If this skill test is successful, ready an [[Ally]] asset at your location and heal 1 damage or 1 horror from it.
flavor: “安德森对手下确实狠。他平时把朗姆酒都锁起来，还经常天一亮就把我们叫起来。但现在，在这种不毛之地，我就希望他能打头阵。”

name: 单打独斗
text:
只可作为你的第一个行动打出。
对与你交战的一个敌人造成1点伤害。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
real_text:
Play only as your first action.
Deal 1 damage to an enemy engaged with you. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: 急救
text:
使用(4补给)。如果急救没有补给，将其弃掉。
[action]花费1补给：治愈你所在地点的一位调查员或一个[[盟友]]支援1点伤害和1点恐惧。
real_text:
Uses (4 supplies). If First Aid has no supplies, discard it.
[action] Spend 1 supply: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset in your location.

name: 重大发现
text: 如果本次技能检定成功，执行本次检定的调查员查找其牌库顶3张卡牌，找出一张卡牌，将其抽取，并混洗其牌库。
real_text: If this skill test is successful, the investigator performing this test searches the top 3 cards of his or her deck for a card, draws it, and shuffles his or her deck.

name: 捷径
text: 快速。只能在你回合期间打出。 附属到你所在地点。被附属地点获得：“[free]横置捷径：移动(到一个连接地点)。”位于该地点的所有调查员均可以触发此能力。(FAQ v1.4)
real_text: Fast. Play only during your turn. Attach to your location. Attached location gains: "[fast] Exhaust Shortcut: Move (to a connecting location). Any investigator at this location may trigger this ability."
flavor: 你对这座小镇了如指掌。

name: “吃我一招！”
text:
只能投入你正在执行的技能检定。作为将“吃我一招！”投入技能检定的额外费用，花费最多3资源。
如果你检定成功且超过难度至少1点，获得两倍数量的该资源。
real_text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing. As an additional cost to commit "Watch this!" to a skill test, spend up to 3 resources.
If you succeed by 1 or more, gain twice that many resources.
flavor: 赤裸裸的炫耀。

name: .41短口手枪
text: 使用(3子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少1点，本次攻击造成+1伤害。每回合一次，如果你检定成功且超过难度至少3点，你本回合可以进行额外一次行动。
real_text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed by 1 or more, this attack deals +1 damage. Once per turn, if you succeed by 3 or more, you may take an additional action this turn.
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法

name: 力量洪流
text:
作为将力量洪流投入技能检定的额外费用，从你控制的所有支援上花费最多3充能。
每以此方式花费1充能，力量洪流获得[willpower][wild]。
real_text:
As an additional cost to commit Torrent of Power to a skill test, spend up to 3 charges from among assets you control.
For each charge spent in this way, Torrent of Power gains [willpower] [wild].

name: 探知术
text:
使用(3充能)。
[free]横置探知术并花费1充能：查看任意一位调查员的牌库顶或遭遇牌库顶3张卡牌。将其以任意顺序放回该牌库顶。如果查看的卡牌中有[[恐怖]]或[[征兆]]卡牌，受到1点恐惧。
real_text:
Uses (3 charges).
[fast] Exhaust Scrying and spend 1 charge: Look at the top 3 cards of any investigator's deck, or the encounter deck. Return them to the top of that deck, in any order. If a [[Terror]] or [[Omen]] card is among the looked-at cards, take 1 horror.

name: 中途伏击
text: 选择你所在地点一个处于横置状态的非[[精英]]敌人并检定[agility](X)，其中X为该敌人的躲避值。如果你检定成功，击败该敌人。
real_text: Choose an exhausted non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location and test [agility] (X), where X is that enemy's evade value. If you succeed, defeat that enemy.
flavor: “结……结束了吗？”她跪倒在地，双手颤抖不止，“终于结束了吗？”

name: 不期而遇
text: 选择任意玩家弃牌堆中的一个印刷资源费用为X的[[盟友]]支援。将该支援放置入场，放到你的控制之下。
real_text: Choose an [[Ally]] asset with printed resource cost X in any player's discard pile. Put that asset into play under your control.

name: 应急物品
text: 获得4资源或将4补给标记分配给你所在地点的调查员控制的支援(或以任意方式组合，总计4点)。
real_text: Gain 4 resources or place 4 supply tokens among assets controlled by investigators at your location, or any combination thereof.
flavor: 有备无患，多多益善。

name: 追猎行动
text:
快速。在神话阶段期间你将要抽取一张遭遇卡牌时打出。
改为查找遭遇牌库顶9张卡牌，找出一个敌人，不将该敌人生成在其通常的生成地点，改为生成并与你交战，并混洗遭遇牌库。如果你不能这么做，抽取遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。
real_text: Fast. Play when you would draw an encounter card during the mythos phase. Instead, search the top 9 cards of the encounter deck for an enemy, spawn it engaged with you (instead of its normal spawn location), and shuffle the encounter deck. If you cannot, draw the top card of the encounter deck.

name: 原定计划
text: 永久。卓越。 [reaction]你抽取起始手牌前：查找你的牌库，找出最多3张不同的[[策略]]和/或[[供给]]事件，并将其正面朝下附属到原定计划。混洗你的牌库。 附属到原定计划的卡牌可以被打出，如同其在你手中。作为打出一张附属卡牌的额外费用，横置原定计划。(FAQ v2.0)
real_text:
Permanent. Exceptional.
[reaction] Before you draw your opening hand: Search your deck for up to 3 different [[Tactic]] and/or [[Supply]] events, and attach them facedown to Stick to the Plan. Shuffle your deck.
Cards attached to Stick to the Plan may be played as if they were in your hand. As an additional cost to play an attached card, exhaust Stick to the Plan.

name: 指导
text: 选择你所在地点的另一位本轮尚未进行其回合的调查员。该调查员可以在本轮自己回合期间进行额外一次行动。
real_text: Choose another investigator at your location who has yet to take his or her turn this round. That investigator may take an additional action during his or her turn this round.

name: 奥术洞察
text:
使用(3充能)。
[free]一位调查员进行自己的回合时，花费1充能：直到本回合结束，你所在地点的隐藏值-2。(每回合仅限一次。)
real_text:
Uses (3 charges).
[fast] While an investigator is taking his or her turn, spend 1 charge: Your location gets -2 shroud until the end of this turn. (Limit once per turn.)

name: 侥幸逃脱
text:
快速。在敌人对你进行趁乱攻击时打出。
取消该次攻击。本回合中你下次执行的技能检定得到技能值+2。
real_text:
Fast. Play when an enemy makes an attack of opportunity against you.
Cancel that attack. You get +2 skill value for the next skill test you perform this turn.
flavor: “下次让我来开车！”

name: 建议
text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]横置建议：躲避。本次躲避尝试将你的[willpower]值加入你的技能值。如果你未超过难度至少2点并成功，从建议移除1充能。 [reaction]在一个非[[精英]]敌人将要攻击你时，花费1充能：取消该次攻击。
real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Exhaust Suggestion: Evade. Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If you do not succeed by at least 2, remove 1 charge from Suggestion. [reaction] When a non-[[Elite]] enemy would attack you, spend 1 charge: Cancel that attack.

name: 圣胡伯的钥匙
text:
你得到+1[willpower]、+1[intellect]和-2神智值。
[reaction]在你将要由于恐惧被击败时，弃掉圣胡伯的钥匙：立刻治愈2点恐惧。
real_text:
You get +1 [willpower], +1 [intellect], and -2 sanity.
[reaction] When you would be defeated by horror, discard St. Hubert's Key: Immediately heal 2 horror.

name: 守护结界
text:
快速。在位于任意地点的一位调查员抽取一张非弱点诡计卡牌时打出。
取消该卡牌的显现效果。然后，受到1点恐惧。
real_text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at any location draws a non-weakness treachery card.
Cancel that card's revelation effect. Then, take 1 horror.

name: 新晋术士
text: 强制 - 在新晋术士入场后：在上面放置1个毁灭标记或2点恐惧。 [free]横置新晋术士：查找你牌库顶3张卡牌，找出一张[[法术]]卡牌并将其抽取。混洗你的牌库。
real_text: Forced - After Arcane Initiate enters play: Place 1 doom or 2 horror on it. [fast] Exhaust Arcane Initiate: Search the top 3 cards of your deck for a [[Spell]] card and draw it. Shuffle your deck.

name: “放马过来！”
text:
有敌人与你交战才能投入到技能检定。
每有一个与你交战的敌人，“放马过来！”获得[willpower][combat][agility]。
real_text:
Commit to a skill test only if you are engaged with an enemy.
For each enemy engaged with you, "Not without a fight!" gains [willpower] [combat] [agility].

name: 求生高手
text: 将你弃牌堆中的3张[[天性]]技能返回你的手牌。
real_text: Return 3 [[Innate]] skills from your discard pile to your hand.

name: “吃枪子吧！”
text: 快速。在你激活[[枪械]]支援上的攻击能力时打出。 你可以花费该支援上的额外X子弹标记。在你为本次攻击揭示混乱标记时，额外揭示X个混乱标记。选择其中一个结算并忽略其余标记。
real_text: Fast. Play when you activate the Fight ability on a [[Firearm]] asset. You may spend X additional ammo tokens from that asset. When you reveal chaos tokens for this attack, reveal X additional chaos tokens. Choose one to resolve and ignore the rest.

name: 阿登护甲
text: [reaction]在分配伤害给阿登护甲时，横置阿登护甲：取消该伤害中的1点。
real_text: [reaction] When damage is assigned to Armor of Ardennes, exhaust Armor of Ardennes: Cancel 1 of that damage.
traits: 道具. 护甲. 遗物

name: 遗觉记忆
text: 将遗觉记忆作为任意调查员弃牌堆中的一张[[洞察]]事件打出(包括其资源费用)。将该事件从游戏中移除。不要弃掉遗觉记忆，改为将其从游戏中移除。
real_text: Play Eidetic Memory as an exact copy of an [[Insight]] event in any investigator's discard pile (including its resource cost). Remove that event from the game. Remove Eidetic Memory from the game instead of discarding it.

name: 殚精竭虑
text:
快速。在任意[free]玩家时间段期间打出。
选择你所在地点的一位调查员。该调查员查找其牌库，找出一张卡牌，将其抽取，并混洗其牌库。
real_text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] player window.
Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator searches his or her deck for a card, draws it, and shuffles his or her deck.

name: 卡戎的银币
text: 永久。卓越。 在冒险结局期间取得经验值时，如果该次冒险期间你没有被击败，你取得额外2点经验。如果该次冒险期间你被击败，你阵亡。
real_text: Permanent. Exceptional. When earning experience during the resolution of a scenario, if you were not defeated during that scenario, you earn 2 additional experience. If you were defeated during that scenario, you are killed.

name: 短管猎枪
text: 使用(2子弹)。 打出短管猎枪不会触发趁乱攻击。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+1[combat]并造成+1伤害。如果短管猎枪是本回合入场的，你本次攻击得到额外+1[combat]并造成额外+1伤害。
real_text: Uses (2 ammo). Playing Lupara does not provoke attacks of opportunity. [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If Lupara entered play this turn, you get an additional +1 [combat] and deal an additional +1 damage for this attack.
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法

name: 死里逃生
text:
快速。在你将要被击败时打出。
和与你交战的每个敌人解除交战，弃掉你威胁区域中的全部卡牌，治愈2点恐惧和2点伤害，并移动到任意一个没有敌人的已揭示地点。如果现在是你的回合，结束你的回合。将死里逃生从游戏中移除。
real_text:
Fast. Play when you would be defeated.
Disengage from each enemy engaged with you, discard all cards in your threat area, heal 2 horror and 2 damage, and move to any revealed location with no enemies. If it is your turn, end your turn. Remove Cheat Death from the game.

name: 时间曲折
text: 快速。你所在地点的一位调查员在其回合期间结算完毕一次行动后立刻打出。 撤销该行动(游戏返回到该行动执行之前的状态，但仍然视作你打出了时间曲折，且该卡牌打出的费用不会返还)。(FAQ v1.4)
real_text: Fast. Play immediately after an investigator at your location finishes resolving an action during his or her turn. Undo that action (return the game state to exactly the way it was before that action was performed, except for the playing of Time Warp and its costs).

name: 远古印记封印
text:
本次检定不要从混乱袋中揭示混乱标记。本次检定揭示的混乱标记视为[elder_sign]。
在本次检定结束时，将远古印记封印从游戏中移除。
real_text:
Do not reveal chaos tokens from the chaos bag for this test. Treat the chaos token revealed for this test as an [elder_sign].
When this test ends, remove Seal of the Elder Sign from the game.

name: 报纸
text:
你调查时如果没有线索，得到+2[intellect]。
[reaction]在你将要发现你所在地点的至少1个线索时，如果你没有线索：发现你所在地点的额外1个线索。
real_text:
You get +2 [intellect] while investigating if you have no clues.
[reaction] When you would discover 1 or more clues at your location, if you have no clues: Discover an additional clue at your location.
flavor: 新闻头条里丝毫没有提到你目击的恐怖事件。但讣告栏里的名字却多得让人心中发怵。

name: 内讧
text:
快速。敌军阶段开始后打出。
取消本阶段所有非[[精英]]敌人对你的攻击。
real_text:
Fast. Play after the enemy phase begins.
Cancel all attacks made by non-[[Elite]] enemies against you this phase.

name: 伊苏之匙
subname: 让暴风雨来得更猛烈些吧
text: 伊苏之匙上每有一点恐惧，你得到每项技能+1。 强制 - 在任意数量的恐惧将要放置到你身上时：将其中1点恐惧放置到伊苏之匙上。 强制 - 在伊苏之匙离场时：弃掉你牌库顶10张卡牌。
real_text: You get +1 to each of your skills for each horror on Key of Ys. Forced - When any amount of horror would be placed on you: Place 1 of that horror on Key of Ys. Forced - When Key of Ys leaves play: Discard the top 10 cards of your deck.

name: 里奥·安德森
text:
[reaction]在你的回合开始后：打出一张[[盟友]]支援卡牌，其费用减1。
[elder_sign]效果：+2。查找你牌库顶3张卡牌，找出一张[[盟友]]支援卡牌并将其抽取。混洗你的牌库。
real_text:
[reaction] After your turn begins: Play an [[Ally]] asset, reducing its cost by 1.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. Search the top 3 cards of your deck for an [[Ally]] asset and draw it. Shuffle your deck.
flavor: 继续前进。要死你就自己死去，别误了大伙。
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-5，流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：米奇·布朗、血的代价、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 里奥·安德森穷其一生，出入于地球上最为凶险、隐蔽之地。在这一路上，他曾失去伙伴。他常常质疑自己，这样的学术追求是否值得付出生命的代价。他最近一次探险是前往南马都尔寻找奥卢索尔历书，那是一场不幸的探险，结局简直是场灾难。他的探险小队只有米奇活了下来，或者换句话说，只有他仍保有人性。里奥再也不愿理葬伙伴的尸身，他们生前是那么信任里奥。但现在他知道探险并不仅是出于学术目的一一在完成使命之前，他绝不却步。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Mitch Brown, Bought in Blood, 1 random basic weakness.

name: 厄休拉·唐斯
text:
[reaction]在你移动到一个地点后：进行一次调查行动。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。在本次检定结束后，你可以移动到一个连接地点。
real_text:
[reaction] After you move to a location: Take an investigate action. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. After this test ends, you may move to a connecting location.
flavor: “发现易，领悟难。”
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，[[遗物]]卡牌等级0-4，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建(不计入卡牌张数)：杰克·威廉斯、未知的呼唤、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 没多少人能说自己攀登过每一块大陆的高山，能说自己曾从食人族部落里偷走黄金神像的人就更少了。在男性占主导地位的社会中，厄休拉是唯一能够发出如此豪言的女性。当她还是个小女孩的时候，厄休拉就已打破了规限自己的条条框框，她爬树、在泥地里玩要、到森林里探索，做许多“年轻女孩不该做”的事情。在波士顿取得考古学学位后，她一直在世界各地找寻失落的文明。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, [[Relic]] cards level 0-4, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Jake Williams, Call of the Unknown, 1 random basic weakness.

name: 芬恩·爱德华兹
text:
你可以在自己回合期间进行额外一个行动，该行动只能用于躲避。
[elder_sign]效果：场上每有一个处于横置状态的敌人，+1。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，你可以发现你所在地点的1个线索。
real_text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to evade.
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each exhausted enemy in play. If you succeed by 2 or more, you may discover 1 clue at your location.
flavor: “别忘了给自己留条后路，也别把货给忘了”
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：[[违法]]卡牌等级0-5，流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5，其它的探求者和/或求生者卡牌([seeker]和/或[survivor])等级0最多5张。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：走私货物、芬恩可靠的.38手枪、当场抓获、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 对于芬思·爱德华兹而言，禁酒令简直就是天赐良机。在实施禁酒之前，他的生活漂泊无定，到处打些零工。但在那以后，人们对酒精的渴望臻至狂热，他便通过规避法律来满足人们的需求，赖以为生。他崭新的活法恰恰与他的个性不谋而合，在刀尖上过活，赚得盆满钵满。他从来不会被抓，也不会弄丢一趟货。现在他被卷入了某种超自然的阴谋之中，但最终他还是坚守着一贯的原则：安全走货，免遭逮捕。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: [[Illicit]] cards level 0-5, Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other level 0 Seeker and/or Survivor cards ([seeker] and/or [survivor]). Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Smuggled Goods, Finn's Trusty .38, Caught Red-handed, 1 random basic weakness.

deck_options.error: You cannot have more than 5 Seeker and/or Survivor cards

name: 马泰奥神父
text:
[reaction]在一位调查员揭示[auto_fail]混乱标记时：取消该标记并改为将其视作[elder_sign]标记。(每场游戏仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：你检定自动成功。在本次检定结束后，选择一项：
- 抽取1张卡牌并获得1资源。
- 如果此时是你的回合，你本回合可以进行额外一次行动。
real_text:
[reaction] When an investigator reveals an [auto_fail] chaos token: Cancel that token and treat it as an [elder_sign] token, instead. (Limit once per game.)
[elder_sign] effect: You automatically succeed. After this test ends, either (choose one):
 - Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource.
 - If it is your turn, you may take an additional action this turn.
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，[[祝福]]卡牌等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：古代抄本、伊格蛇族、1张随机基础弱点。 额外经验值：剧本开始时你有额外5点经验值(这不影响你在单场冒险模式必须拿取的弱点数量)。
back_flavor: 马泰奥·卡斯提尔自从成为神父后，日子一直不好过。近十年来，墨西哥深受动乱与冲突之苦。马泰奥神父一面希望守住自己的信仰，一面为了布道，有时不得不忽视法律，但这并不是马泰奥信仰动摇的主要原因。如他所料，周围发生的凶杀案和绑架案，其动机与政治因素无关。在这场精心酝酿的纷争背后，一个可怕而恐怖的邪教逐渐壮大。马泰奥想知道，仁慈而可亲的上帝怎能容许他那晚所见的事情发生呢？
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, [[Blessed]] cards level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): The Codex of Ages, Serpents of Yig, 1 random basic weakness. Bonus Experience: You begin the campaign with 5 additional experience (does not affect the number of weaknesses you must take in Standalone Mode).

name: 加尔文·怀特
text:
你身上每有一点恐惧，你得到+1[willpower]和+1[intellect]。
你身上每有一点伤害，你得到+1[combat]和+1[agility]。
[elder_sign]效果：+0。你可以治愈1点伤害或恐惧，或受到1点直接伤害或直接恐惧。
real_text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect] for each horror on you.
You get +1 [combat] and +1 [agility] for each damage on you.
[elder_sign] effect: +0. You may either heal 1 damage or horror, or take 1 direct damage or direct horror.
flavor: “你要是伤了他，我就杀了你。”
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-5，[[勇气]]卡牌等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：时间尽头、信使之声、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 有的时候，生活会让你做选择：接受被安排的命运，或者为自我和信仰而坚持。加尔文选择后者。当他倒在泥路边上，血流不止，濒临死亡时，他看见了幻象一一地球变得四分五裂，令人胆颤，而他的毕生挚爱一一乔亚在熊熊烈火的旋涡之中化为灰烬。随后，加尔文做了另一个决定。他伸手触及黑暗，将其引入自己体内。他不会死，至少今天不会。世界需要他，乔亚也是。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, [[Spirit]] cards level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Until the End of Time, Voice of the Messenger, 1 random basic weakness.

name: 米奇·布朗
text:
里奥·安德森牌库专用。
你拥有额外2个盟友槽位，只可以用来携带非独特盟友。
real_text:
Leo Anderson deck only.
You have 2 additional ally slots, which can only be used to hold non-unique allies.
flavor: “你得带上我，里奥，所以不妨跟我说说发生了什么事。”

name: 血的代价
text: 显现 - 你必须从场上弃掉你控制的一张[[盟友]]支援卡牌，或弃掉手牌中的所有[[盟友]]支援。如果没有因本效果弃掉的支援，将血的代价洗回你的牌库。
real_text: Revelation - You must either discard an [[Ally]] asset you control from play, or discard each [[Ally]] asset from your hand. If no assets are discarded by this effect, shuffle Bought in Blood back into your deck.
flavor: 我们为自己获得的知识付出了惨痛的代价。那值得吗？

name: 杰克·威廉斯
text:
厄休拉·唐斯牌库专用。
你每回合执行的第一个移动或调查行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
[reaction]在你揭示一个地点或放置一个新的地点入场后，横置杰克·威廉斯：抽取1张卡牌。
real_text:
Ursula Downs deck only.
The first move or investigate action you perform each turn does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
[reaction] After you reveal a location or put a new location into play, exhaust Jake Williams: Draw 1 card.

name: 未知的呼唤
text: 显现 - 将未知的呼唤放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 当你的回合开始时：选择你所在地点以外的一个地点。在你的回合结束时，如果本回合你没能成功调查所选地点，受到2点恐惧并将未知的呼唤洗回你的牌库。
real_text: Revelation - Put Call of the Unknown into play in your threat area. Forced - At the beginning of your turn: Choose a location other than your location. When your turn ends, if you did not successfully investigate the chosen location this turn, take 2 horror and shuffle Call of the Unknown back into your deck.

name: 走私货物
text:
芬恩·爱德华兹牌库专用。
你所在地点没有处于重整状态的敌人才能打出。
查找你的弃牌堆或你牌库顶9张卡牌，找出一张[[违法]]卡牌并将其抽取。如果你查找了你的牌库，将走私货物洗入你的牌库。
real_text:
Finn Edwards deck only.
Play only if there are no ready enemies at your location.
Search either your discard pile or the top 9 cards of your deck for an [[Illicit]] card and draw it. If you searched your deck, shuffle Smuggled Goods into your deck.

name: 芬恩可靠的.38手枪
text: 芬恩·爱德华兹牌库专用。快速。使用(3子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。如果被攻击敌人未与你交战，你本次攻击造成+1伤害。
real_text: Finn Edwards deck only. Fast. Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If the attacked enemy is not engaged with you, you deal +1 damage for this attack.
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法
flavor: 这是一把旧枪——有磨损与划痕，用了好一阵子——但这杆枪从来没让他失望。

name: 当场抓获
text: 显现 - 重整你所在地点或一个连接地点的所有敌人。连接地点上的每个猎手敌人向你移动1个地点。如果没有敌人以此效果移动，将当场抓获洗回你的牌库。
real_text: Revelation - Ready each enemy at your location or a connecting location. Each hunter enemy at a connecting location moves 1 location toward you. If no enemies move as a result of this effect, shuffle Caught Red-Handed back into your deck.

name: 古代抄本
text: 马泰奥神父牌库专用。封印([elder_sign])。 有标记被封印在此时，你得到+1[willpower]。 [reaction]在你将要从混乱袋中揭示一个混乱标记时，弃掉古代抄本：结算封印在此的[elder_sign]标记，如同刚刚从混乱袋中揭示该标记(而不是从混乱袋中揭示一个标记)。
real_text: Father Mateo deck only. Seal ([elder_sign]). You get +1 [willpower] while there is a token sealed here. [reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token from the chaos bag, discard The Codex of Ages: Resolve the [elder_sign] token that was sealed here as if it were just revealed from the chaos bag (instead of revealing a token from the chaos bag).
traits: 道具. 遗物. 书籍. 祝福

name: 伊格蛇族
text: 猎物 - 仅限马泰奥神父。 猎手。 显现 - 从混乱袋中查找[elder_sign]混乱标记并将其封印在伊格蛇族上。
real_text: Prey - Father Mateo only. Hunter. Revelation - Search the chaos bag for the [elder_sign] chaos token and seal it on Serpents of Yig.
traits: 类人. 怪物. 蛇族
flavor: “我不知道伊格是什么，但我知道我伤了它的子嗣。”<cite>马泰奥神父，《诡镇奇谈的调查员们》</cite>

name: 时间尽头
text:
加尔文·怀特牌库专用。
直接伤害和直接恐惧可以被分配到时间尽头上。
real_text:
Calvin Wright deck only.
Direct damage and direct horror may be assigned to Until the End of Time.
flavor: 他坚决反抗自己的命运，不屈不挠，永不妥协。

name: 信使之声
text: 显现 - 你必须(选择以下一项)： - 受到1点直接伤害并承受1点肉体创伤。 - 受到1点直接恐惧并承受1点精神创伤。
real_text: Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Take 1 direct damage and suffer 1 physical trauma. - Take 1 direct horror and suffer 1 mental trauma.

name: 求生匕首
text: [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+1[combat]。 [reaction]在敌军阶段期间，在敌人的攻击对你造成伤害后，横置求生匕首：攻击。本次攻击以刚刚发起攻击的敌人为目标。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]并造成+1伤害。
real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. [reaction] After an enemy attack deals damage to you during the enemy phase, exhaust Survival Knife: Fight. This attack targets the attacking enemy. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.
traits: 道具. 武器. 近战

name: 冒险家
text:
使用(3补给)。
[free]花费1补给并横置冒险家：在你所在地点一位调查员控制的一个支援上放置1补给或子弹。
real_text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[fast] Spend 1 supply and exhaust Venturer: Place 1 supply or ammo on an asset controlled by an investigator at your location.

name: 肝胆相照
text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
附属到你控制的一个[[盟友]]支援。
附属的支援得到+1生命值和+1神智值。
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to an [[Ally]] asset you control.
Attached asset gets +1 health and +1 sanity.

name: 值得信赖
text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
附属到你控制的一个[[道具]]支援。
结算附属的支援上的触发能力时，你得到每项技能+1。
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to an [[Item]] asset you control.
While resolving a triggered ability on attached asset, you get +1 to each of your skills.

name: 爱丽·霍洛维兹博士
text: [reaction]在爱丽·霍洛维兹博士入场后：查找你牌库顶的9张卡牌，找出一张[[遗物]]支援卡牌，将其附属到爱丽·霍洛维兹博士上。混洗你的牌库。 附属在爱丽·霍洛维兹博士上的每张[[遗物]]支援卡牌均不占用任何槽位(这些卡牌仍视为在场上并由你控制)。
real_text: [reaction] After Dr. Elli Horowitz enters play: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Relic]] asset and attach it to her. Shuffle your deck. Each [[Relic]] asset attached to Dr. Elli Horowitz does not take up any slots (it is still considered to be in play and under your control).

name: 古代巨石
text: [action]：调查。本次调查你所在地点的隐藏值+3。如果你检定成功，发现你所在地点额外1个线索，弃掉古代巨石，并在剧本日志中记录“你鉴定了古代巨石”。在记下的文字旁边以括号形式记录下本次技能检定难度。
real_text: [action]: Investigate. Your location gets +3 shroud for this investigation. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at your location, discard Ancient Stone, and record in your Campaign Log that "you have identified the stone." Next to this, in parentheses, record the difficulty of this skill test.

name: 埃茲特里之牙
text:
结算诡计卡牌上的能力时，你得到+1[willpower]和+1[agility]。
[reaction]在你结算诡计卡牌上的能力时技能检定成功后，横置埃兹特里之牙：抽取1张卡牌。
real_text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [agility] while resolving an ability on a treachery card.
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test while resolving an ability on a treachery card, exhaust Tooth of Eztli: Draw 1 card.

name: 发掘古物
text: 调查。选择你手中的一张[seeker]支援卡牌。本次技能检定难度等于所选支援的印刷费用。如果你检定成功，不发现线索，改为将该所选支援放置入场。如果该支援有[[遗物]]特性，抽取1张卡牌。
real_text: Investigate. Choose a [seeker] asset in your hand. The difficulty of this skill test is equal to the chosen asset's printed cost. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, put the chosen asset into play. If that asset has the [[Relic]] trait, draw 1 card.

name: 寻宝猎人
text: 你得到+1[intellect]。 强制 - 当补给阶段结束时：你必须支付1资源或弃掉寻宝猎人。
real_text: You get +1 [intellect]. Forced - At the end of the upkeep phase: You must either pay 1 resource or discard Treasure Hunter.

name: 彩饰骷髅
text: 使用(0充能)。 [reaction]在你所在地点有调查员、[[盟友]]支援或敌人被击败后：在彩饰骷髅上放置1资源(从供应堆拿取)，作为充能。 [action]花费1充能：抽取1张卡牌并获得1资源。
real_text: Uses (0 charges). [reaction] After an investigator, [[Ally]] asset, or enemy at your location is defeated: Place 1 resource (from the token bank) on Decorated Skull, as a charge. [action] Spend 1 charge: Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 诅咒萦绕

name: 窃听
text: 选择你所在地点的一个未处于交战状态的敌人。检定[intellect](X)，其中X为所选敌人的躲避值。如果你检定成功，发现你所在地点的2个线索。
real_text: Choose an unengaged enemy at your location. Test [intellect] (X), where X is the evade value of the chosen enemy. If you succeed, discover 2 clues at your location.

name: “交给你了！”
text:
快速。在你抽取了一张非险境遭遇卡牌后，结算该卡牌效果前打出。
选择另一位调查员。改为视为该调查员抽取了该遭遇卡牌。获得1资源。
real_text:
Fast. Play after you draw a non-peril encounter card, but before resolving that card's effects.
Choose another investigator. That investigator is considered to have drawn that encounter card instead. Gain 1 resource.

name: 拉莱耶迷雾
text: 使用(4充能)。 [action]花费1充能：躲避。本次躲避尝试不使用[agility]，改为使用[willpower]。如果你检定成功，在躲避所选敌人后，你可以移动到一个连接地点。如果本次躲避尝试期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，从你手牌中选择并弃掉一张卡牌。
real_text: Uses (4 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. If you succeed, after evading the chosen enemy, you may move to a connecting location. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this evasion attempt, choose and discard a card from your hand.

name: 钻地魔虫之石
text: 封印([skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing])。 强制 - 你在技能检定中揭示[auto_fail]符号后：将钻地魔虫之石返回你的手牌。
real_text: Seal ([skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing]). Forced - After you reveal an [auto_fail] symbol during a skill test: Return The Chthonian Stone to your hand.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 诅咒萦绕
flavor: 它的留存必定出于某种目的。

name: 保护咒语
text: 团队仅限2张保护咒语在场。 封印(除[auto_fail]以外的任何标记)。 强制 - 当你的回合结束时：你必须花费1资源或弃掉保护咒语。
real_text: Group limit 2 copies of Protective Incantation in play. Seal (any except [auto_fail]). Forced - At the end of your turn: You must either spend 1 resource or discard Protective Incantation.

name: 黑暗预言
text:
快速。在你将要揭示一个混乱标记时打出。
改为揭示5个混乱标记，而非1个。选择其中一个带有[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号的标记结算并忽略其余标记。(如果没有揭示上述标记，从这些标记中选择任意一个标记结算，忽略其余标记。)
real_text:
Fast. Play when you would reveal a chaos token.
Reveal 5 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose one of those tokens with a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol to resolve, and ignore the rest. (If no such token is revealed, choose any one of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the rest.)
flavor: 真相就写在星辰之间。

name: 临时武器
text: 你可以从你的弃牌堆中打出临时武器。如果你这么做，结算效果后将其洗入你的牌库。 攻击。被攻击敌人本次攻击得到-1攻击值。(如果你从弃牌堆中打出了临时武器，本次攻击造成+1伤害。)
real_text: You may play Improvised Weapon from your discard pile. If you do, shuffle it into your deck after resolving its effects. Fight. The attacked enemy gets -1 fight for this attack. (If you played Improvised Weapon from your discard pile, this attack deals +1 damage.)

name: 狗屎运
text:
快速。你对非[[精英]]敌人进行躲避尝试期间，技能检定失败且低于难度2点及以内后打出。
将该敌人放到遭遇牌库顶。
real_text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 2 or less during an evasion attempt against a non-[[Elite]] enemy.
Place that enemy on top of the encounter deck.
flavor: 傻人有傻福。

name: 雅沃托
text:
[free]横置雅沃托：在本次技能检定期间，你每项技能得到加成，加成的点数等于你弃牌堆顶上的一张卡牌的对应技能图标数([wild]图标不计算在内)。
[free]：弃掉你牌库顶的一张卡牌。(每阶段仅限一次。)
real_text:
[fast] Exhaust Yaotl: During this skill test, you get a bonus to each skill equal to the number of matching skill icons on the top card of your discard pile (not counting [wild] icons).
[fast]: Discard the top card of your deck. (Limit once per phase.)

name: 殊死一搏
text:
在一次未投入其他卡牌的技能检定中，才能投入本卡牌。该次技能检定不能投入其他卡牌。
你手牌中每有一张卡牌，殊死一搏失去[wild]。
real_text:
Commit only to a skill test with no other cards committed to it. Other cards cannot be committed to this skill test.
Last Chance loses [wild] for each card in your hand.

name: 背包
text:
[reaction]在背包入场后：查找你牌库顶的6张卡牌，找出最多3张非弱点[[道具]]或[[供给]]卡牌，正面朝下附属到背包上。混洗你的牌库。
附属到背包的卡牌可以被打出，如同其在你手中。如果没有卡牌附属在背包，弃掉背包。
real_text:
[reaction] After Backpack enters play: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for up to 3 non-weakness [[Item]] or [[Supply]] cards, and attach them facedown to Backpack. Shuffle your deck.
Cards attached to Backpack may be played as if they were in your hand. If there are no cards attached to Backpack, discard it.

name: 黑暗契约
text: 剧本模式专用。 对你所在地点的一位调查员造成2点伤害。 强制 - 在游戏结束或你退场时，如果黑暗契约仍在你手牌中：将黑暗契约从你的牌库中移除。查找收藏，找出失败的代价，并将其加入你的牌库。
real_text: Campaign Mode only. Deal 2 damage to an investigator at your location. Forced - When the game ends or you are eliminated, if Dark Pact is still in your hand: Remove Dark Pact from your deck. Search the collection for The Price of Failure and add it to your deck.

name: 失败的代价
text: 显现 - 受到2点伤害和2点恐惧。在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记(本效果能导致当前密谋推进)。将失败的代价从你的牌库中移除。查找收藏，找出黑暗契约，并将其放入你的弃牌堆。
real_text: Revelation - Take 2 damage and 2 horror. Place 1 doom on the current agenda (this effect can cause the current agenda to advance). Remove The Price of Failure from your deck. Search the collection for Dark Pact and place it in your discard pile.

name: 厄运降临
text: 剧本模式专用。 显现 - 受到1点恐惧。在剧本日志中，你的调查员取得的剧情支援/弱点下方，记录“厄运降临”。如果已经有此条记录，将厄运降临从你的牌库中移除，查找收藏，找出被诅咒的命运并将它放到你的牌库底。
real_text: Campaign Mode only. Revelation - Take 1 horror. In your Campaign Log, under your investigator's earned story assets/weaknesses, record that "doom approaches." If this was already recorded, remove Doomed from your deck, search the collection for Accursed Fate, and place it on the bottom of your deck.

name: 被诅咒的命运
text: 显现 - 受到2点恐惧。在剧本日志中，你的调查员取得的剧情支援/弱点下方，记录“时间到”。如果已经有此条记录，将被诅咒的命运从你的牌库中移除，查找收藏，找出丧钟敲响并将它放到你的牌库底。
real_text: Revelation - Take 2 horror. In your Campaign Log, under your investigator's earned story assets/weaknesses, record that "the hour is nigh." If this was already recorded, remove Accursed Fate from your deck, search the collection for The Bell Tolls, and place it on the bottom of your deck.

name: 丧钟敲响
text: 显现 - 你的死期到了。你阵亡了。
real_text: Revelation - The hour of your demise has arrived. You are killed.
flavor:
丧钟为你而鸣。
一如既往。

name: 犯罪现场
text:
只能作为你的第一个行动打出。
发现你所在地点的1个线索(如果该地点有敌人，改为发现2个线索)。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
real_text:
Play only as your first action.
Discover 1 clue at your location (2 clues instead if there is an enemy at that location). This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: 枪法如神
text: 快速。在你激活[[枪械]]或[[远程]]支援上的攻击能力时打出。 本次攻击可以选择一个连接地点上的一个敌人作为目标。本次攻击忽略冷漠和反击关键词。如果本次攻击的敌人未与你交战，且你攻击成功，本次攻击造成+1伤害。
real_text: Fast. Play when you activate the Fight ability on a [[Firearm]] or [[Ranged]] asset. This attack can target an enemy at a connecting location. Ignore the aloof and retaliate keywords for this attack. If this attack succeeds against an enemy not engaged with you, the attack deals +1 damage.

name: 劝服
text: 谈判。选择你所在地点的一个非弱点[[类人]]敌人并检定[intellect](3)。本次检定得到+X难度，X等于该敌人的恐惧值。如果你检定成功，将所选敌人洗入遭遇牌库。如果所选敌人为[[精英]]，改为自动躲避它。
real_text: Parley. Choose a non-weakness [[Humanoid]] enemy at your location and test [intellect] (3). This test gets +X difficulty, where X is that enemy's horror value. If you succeed, shuffle the chosen enemy into the encounter deck. If the chosen enemy is [[Elite]], automatically evade it instead.

name: 老练分析
text: 永久。每套牌库仅限1张。 每当你升级带有(未鉴定)或(未翻译)副标题的卡牌时，你可以多升级一张同名卡牌，无需花费经验值。如果你这么做，从符合条件的选项中随机选择该卡牌的两张升级版本。(你仍需满足所有的牌库构建限制。)
real_text: Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Anytime you upgrade a card with the (Unidentified) or (Untranslated) subtitle, you may upgrade a second copy of that card at no experience cost. If you do, the two upgraded versions are chosen at random from among the eligible options. (You must still meet all deckbuilding restrictions.)

name: 幸运烟盒
text: [reaction]你在一次技能检定中成功且超过难度2点或更多后，横置幸运烟盒：抽取1张卡牌。
real_text: [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more, exhaust Lucky Cigarette Case: Draw 1 card.
flavor: “其实没那么幸运，只是想抽根烟。”

name: 销赃贩子
text: [reaction]你在你的回合期间打出[[违法]]卡牌时，横置销赃贩子：该[[违法]]卡牌获得快速。如果该卡牌已有快速，改为降低其费用1点。
real_text: [reaction] When you play an [[Illicit]] card during your turn, exhaust Fence: The [[Illicit]] card gains fast. If it was already fast, reduce its cost by 1 instead.
flavor: “别担心，我认识一个人。”<cite>——里奥·德·卢卡</cite>

name: 奥术研究
text:
永久。
在你购买奥术研究时，承受1点精神创伤。
在一个剧本的每个冒险结束后，在下一场冒险之前，你升级的第一张[[法术]]卡牌经验值费用减1。
real_text:
Permanent.
When you purchase Arcane Research, suffer 1 mental trauma.
After each scenario of a campaign, reduce the experience cost of the first [[Spell]] card you upgrade before the next scenario by 1.

name: 反击法术
text: 快速。在你所在地点的技能检定期间揭示[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]混乱标记时打出。 取消该混乱标记。(不揭示新的混乱标记以替换。)
real_text: Fast. Play when a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] chaos token is revealed during a skill test at your location. Cancel that chaos token. (Do not reveal a new chaos token to replace it.)
flavor: “有我在，不用担心。”

name: 坚韧不拔
text:
快速。在你将被分配伤害和/或恐惧，且其数值足够击败你时打出。
取消该伤害和/或恐惧中的最多4点。
real_text:
Fast. Play when you are assigned damage and/or horror that would defeat you.
Cancel up to 4 of that damage and/or horror.
flavor: 她只需要一双长满茧子的手，还有一颗坚定的心。

name: 晕眩重击
text: 如果攻击期间本次技能检定成功，自动躲避被攻击敌人。
real_text: If this skill test is successful during an attack, automatically evade the attacked enemy.
flavor: 砰。

name: 恢复元气
text:
只能作为你的第一个行动打出。
治愈1点伤害(如果你本轮抽取了一张诡计卡牌，改为治愈2点伤害)。然后，抽取1张卡牌。
real_text:
Play only as your first action.
Heal 1 damage (2 instead if you drew a treachery this round). Then, draw 1 card.

name: 占据先机
text:
只能投入你正在执行的技能检定。
任意调查员在本阶段每完成一个行动，占据先机失去[wild]。
real_text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing.
Take the Initiative loses [wild] for each action that has been completed by any investigator this phase.

name: 准备万全
text: [free]横置准备万全：选择你控制的一张支援卡牌。你本次技能检定得到+X技能值，X为所选支援上对应的技能图标数量。
real_text: [fast] Exhaust Well Prepared: Choose an asset you control. You get +X skill value for this skill test, where X is the number of matching skill icons on the chosen asset.

name: 去伪存真
text:
你所在地点有线索才能打出。
在你控制的一张支援卡牌上放置2秘密。
real_text:
Play only if there is a clue on your location.
Place 2 secrets on an asset you control.
flavor:
“你怎么知道我是疯的？”爱丽丝说。“你肯定疯了。”柴郡猫说，“不然你不会到这儿来。”
——路易斯·卡罗尔，《爱丽丝梦游仙境》

name: 参透真谛
text:
只能投入冒险卡牌上印刷能力中的技能检定。
如果本次技能检定成功，你发现你所在地点的1个线索。
real_text:
Commit only to a skill test from an ability printed on a scenario card.
If this skill test is successful, discover 1 clue at your location.

name: 一目十行
text: [free]将你的1个线索放到你所在地点并横置一目十行：你本次技能检定得到+3技能值。
real_text: [fast] Place 1 of your clues on your location and exhaust Quick Study: You get +3 skill value for this skill test.

name: 职业杀手
text: 如果在躲避尝试期间进行本技能检定，且检定成功，则在本回合中，成功躲避的该敌人下次受到伤害时，对其造成额外1点伤害。
real_text: If this skill test is successful during an evasion attempt, the next time the evaded enemy takes damage this turn, deal it 1 additional damage.
flavor: 喝多了的人才会主动找欧巴尼恩的茬。

name: 挥金如土
text: [free]花费3资源并横置挥金如土：你本次技能检定得到+2技能值。如果你检定成功，获得3资源。
real_text: [fast] Spend 3 resources and exhaust High Roller: You get +2 skill value for this skill test. If you succeed, gain 3 resources.
flavor: 赌得越大，运势越旺

name: 如痴如醉
text: 如果调查期间本次技能检定成功，在你控制的一张支援卡牌上放置1充能或秘密。
real_text: If this skill test is successful during an investigation, place 1 charge or secret on an asset you control.
flavor: 远远地驶离我们那名为无知的平静小岛。

name: 追忆未来
text: [reaction]在你正在执行的技能检定开始时，如果追忆未来处于重整状态，指定一个混乱标记：如果本次技能检定期间揭示了指定的混乱标记，横置追忆未来。然后，你本次技能检定得到+2技能值。
real_text: [reaction] When a skill test you are performing begins, if Recall the Future is ready, name a chaos token: If the named chaos token is revealed during this skill test, exhaust Recall the Future. Then, you get +2 skill value for this skill test.

name: 反复尝试
text:
使用(3次数)。如果反复尝试沒有次数，弃掉本卡牌。
[reaction]在技能检定失败后，如果有投入到该检定的技能卡牌归你所有，横置反复尝试并花费1次数：将这些技能卡牌中的一张返回你的手牌。
real_text:
Uses (3 tries). If Try and Try Again has no tries, discard it.
[reaction] After a skill test is failed, if a skill card you own is committed to that test, exhaust Try and Try Again and spend 1 try: Return that skill card to your hand.

name: 围困
text: [free]弃掉你1张手牌：你本次技能检定得到+2技能值。(每次检定仅限一次。)
real_text: [fast] Discard 1 card from your hand: You get +2 skill value for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)
flavor: 面临绝境之时，勇气油然而生。

name: 英勇无畏
text: 如果本次技能检定成功，将英勇无畏加入你的游戏区域，作为一张带有以下文字的支援卡牌：“你得到+1[intellect]、+1[combat]和+1[agility]。 强制 - 当一轮结束时：弃掉英勇无畏。”
real_text: If this skill test is successful, add Intrepid to your play area as an asset with the text: "You get +1 [intellect], +1 [combat], and +1 [agility]. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Intrepid."

name: 特制弹药
text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
附属到你所在地点的一位调查员控制的[[枪械]]支援上。在该支援上放置2子弹。每个支援仅限1张。
附属的支援对[[怪物]]敌人执行攻击时造成+1伤害。
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to a [[Firearm]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location. Place 2 ammo on that asset. Limit 1 per asset.
Attacks performed by attached asset deal +1 damage against [[Monster]] enemies.
traits: 升级. 供给. 祝福
flavor: “你让我求福？给什么求福？”

name: 异界罗盘
text: [action]横置异界罗盘：调查。本次调查你所在地点的隐藏值-X。X为与你所在地点相互连接、且已揭示的地点数量。
real_text: [action] Exhaust Otherworldly Compass: Investigate. Your location gets -X shroud for this investigation. X is the number of revealed locations connected to your location.
flavor: 它总是指向你不愿去的地方。

name: 暴露弱点
text:
快速。在任意[free]玩家时间段期间打出。
选择你所在地点的一个敌人。检定[intellect](X)，其中X等于该敌人的攻击值。如果你检定成功，本阶段下次对该敌人执行的攻击中，将该敌人的攻击值视为0。抽取1张卡牌。
real_text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] player window.
Choose an enemy at your location. Test [intellect] (X), where X is that enemy's fight value. If you succeed, treat that enemy's fight value as if it were 0 for the next attack performed against it this phase. Draw 1 card.

name: 萝拉·桑提亚哥
text:
你得到+1[intellect]和+1[agility]。
[free]横置萝拉·桑提亚哥并花费X资源：发现你所在地点的1个线索。X为你所在地点的隐藏值。
real_text:
You get +1 [intellect] and +1 [agility].
[fast] Exhaust Lola Santiago and spend X resources: Discover 1 clue at your location. X is the shroud value of your location.
flavor: “我从事的行业会碰上许多所谓的‘诅咒’。我不想讨论这个话题。”

name: 奥利芙·麦克布莱德
text: [reaction]在你将要揭示一个混乱标记时，横置奥利芙·麦克布莱德：改为揭示3个混乱标记，而非1个。选择其中2个标记结算，并忽略其余标记。
real_text: [reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token, exhaust Olive McBride: Reveal 3 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose 2 of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the other.
flavor: 你必须对每种法术全情投入。有时就是字面的意思。

name: 逆反
text: 忽略本次技能检定期间所有[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]和[elder_thing]符号的效果(包括其修正值)。
real_text: Ignore the effects of all [skull], [cultist], [tablet], and [elder_thing] symbols during this test (including their modifiers).

name: 危险预感
text: 快速。在任意[free]玩家时间段期间打出。 将危险预感放置入场，从混乱袋中随机揭示一个混乱标记，并将其封印在危险预感上。 强制 - 在将要从混乱袋中揭示一个混乱标记时：改为结算封印在此的标记，如同刚刚从混乱袋中揭示该标记。然后，弃掉危险预感。
real_text: Fast. Play during any [fast] player window. Put Premonition into play, reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag, and seal it on Premonition. Forced - When a chaos token would be revealed from the chaos bag: Resolve the token sealed here as if it were just revealed from the chaos bag, instead. Then, discard Premonition.

name: 学无止境
text: 快速。在你技能检定失败且完毕后(结算该次技能检定的所有效果后)打出。 再次尝试该次检定。你本次检定得到+2技能值。
real_text: Fast. Play after a skill test you failed ends (after resolving all effects from the failed test). Attempt that test again. You get +2 skill value for this test.

name: 重拾信念
text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
你可以将重拾信念投入任意类型的检定。
如果本次检定失败，执行检定的调查员抽取2张卡牌并获得2资源。
real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
You may commit Take Heart to any type of test.
If this test fails, the performing investigator draws 2 cards and gains 2 resources.

name: 勇斗异劫
text:
快速。在你执行一次技能检定，且检定难度高于你的基础技能值时打出。
本次技能检定额外揭示X个混乱标记。选择其中一个结算并忽略其余标记。X为本次检定难度和你基础技能值的差值。
real_text:
Fast. Play when you perform a skill test with a difficulty higher than your base skill value.
Reveal X additional chaos tokens for this skill test. Choose one to resolve and ignore the rest. X is the difference between the test's difficulty and your base skill value.

name: 战壕大衣
text: 你在躲避尝试期间得到+1[agility]。
real_text: You get +1 [agility] during evasion attempts.
flavor:
罗兰松开了他的领带，帽子弄得歪斜，翻起大衣的领子，将自己的模样弄得邋里邋遢才去开门。
——格里姆·戴维斯，《理性的挽歌》

name: 华饰弓

real_text: Uses (1 ammo). Limit 1 ammo on Ornate Bow. [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. This attack uses [agility] instead of [combat]. You get +2 [agility] and deal +2 damage for this attack. [action]: You nock another arrow. Place 1 ammo on Ornate Bow.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 武器. 远程

name: M1918勃朗宁自动步枪

real_text: Uses (8 ammo). [action] Spend 1-5 ammo: Fight. You get +X [combat] for this attack. Instead of its standard damage, this attack deals X damage. X is the amount of ammo spent as part of this ability's cost.

real_text:
Researched. Uses (X secrets). X is the number in parentheses next to "you have identified the stone."

name: 献祭贡品
text: 弃掉你控制的一张[mystic]支援卡牌。然后，抽取3张卡牌或获得3资源，或以任何方式组合(卡牌和/或资源的总数为3)。
real_text: Discard a [mystic] asset you control. Then, draw 3 cards or gain 3 resources, or any combination thereof.
flavor: 万事开头难。

name: 远古印记结晶

封印(+1或[elder_sign])。
你得到+1[willpower]、+1[intellect]、+1[combat]和+1[agility]。
real_text:

You get +1 [willpower], +1 [intellect], +1 [combat], and +1 [agility].
traits: 道具. 遗物. 祝福
flavor: 真正的无价之宝

text:
每位调查员仅限1张。

Limit 1 per investigator.

If you succeed, attach Handcuffs to the just-evaded enemy. If the attached enemy is non-[[Elite]], it cannot ready and doom cannot be placed on it.

real_text: As an additional cost to play Blood Eclipse, take up to 3 damage. Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. You get +1 [willpower] and deal +1 damage for this attack for each damage taken as part of this card's cost.

text: 对你所在地点的一个敌人造成1点伤害。如果本效果击败该敌人，抽取1张卡牌。如果现在是你的回合，结束你的回合。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
real_text: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. If this effect defeats that enemy, draw 1 card. If it is your turn, end your turn. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
flavor: 两发子弹击穿了这个生物的头颅。然后又是一发，砰。继续，砰。再来，砰。

name: 骷髅钥匙
text:
卓越。快速。
[action]：如果骷髅钥匙在你的游戏区域，将其附属到你所在地点。如果骷髅钥匙已经附属到你所在地点，改为将其解除附属并放回你的游戏区域。
将所附属地点的隐藏值设为1。
real_text:
Exceptional. Fast.
[action]: If the Skeleton Key is in your play area, attach it to your location. If it is already attached to your location, detach it and return it to your play area instead.
Set the attached location's shroud value to 1.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 诅咒萦绕

real_text: Uses (5 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. You get +3 [willpower] for this evasion attempt. If you succeed, after evading the chosen enemy, you may move to a connecting location. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this evasion attempt, choose and discard a card from your hand.

real_text: You may play Winging It from your discard pile. If you do, shuffle it into your deck after resolving its effects. Investigate. Your location gets -1 shroud for this investigation. (If you played Winging It from your discard pile, discover 1 additional clue if you succeed.)

real_text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +3 [combat] and deal +2 damage for this attack. If a [skull] or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this attack, the rifle jams. (This attack automatically fails. Before you can activate this ability again, you must perform the following ability: "[action]: You clear the jam.")
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械

name: 暖水瓶
text:
使用(3补给)。

[action]花费1补给，横置暖水瓶：治愈你所在地点一位调查员1点恐惧(如果该调查员有至少2点精神创伤，改为治愈2恐惧)。
real_text:

[action] Spend 1 supply, exhaust Thermos: Heal 1 horror from an investigator at your location (2 horror instead if he or she has 2 or more mental trauma).

text:
你当前所在地点与至少2个其他地点相互连接时，你得到+1[willpower]和+1[intellect]。
你当前所在地点与至少4个其他地点相互连接时，你得到额外+1[willpower]和+1[intellect]。
real_text:
While your current location is connected to at least 2 other locations, you get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
While your current location is connected to at least 4 other locations, you get an additional +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].

name: 古旧锈剑
text: [action]如果古旧锈剑处于重整状态：攻击。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]并造成+1伤害。 [action]横置古旧锈剑：攻击。本次攻击将你的[willpower]加入你的技能值。本次攻击造成+3伤害。如果本次攻击击败了[[精英]]敌人，抽取3张卡牌。(每场游戏最多一次。)
real_text: [action] If Timeworn Brand is ready: Fight. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. [action] Exhaust Timeworn Brand: Fight. Add your [willpower] to your skill value for this attack. This attack deals +3 damage. If this attack defeats an [[Elite]] enemy, draw 3 cards. (Max once per game.)
traits: 道具. 遗物. 武器. 近战

name: 煤油
text:
使用(3补给)。如果煤油没有补给，将其弃掉。
[action]如果本轮一个敌人在本地点被击败，横置煤油并花费1补给：治愈你所在地点的调查员和[[盟友]]支援总计最多2点恐惧。
real_text:
Uses (3 supplies). If Kerosene has no supplies, discard it.
[action] If an enemy was defeated at this location this round, exhaust Kerosene and spend 1 supply: Heal up to 2 horror from among investigators and [[Ally]] assets at your location.

name: 火焰喷射器
text: 使用(4子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。本次攻击选择的敌人必须是与你交战的敌人中攻击值最高的。你本次攻击得到+4[combat]。如果本次攻击成功，你可以不对其造成基础伤害，改为对所有与你交战的敌人分配总计最多4点伤害(如有任意额外的伤害，则加到此伤害上)。
real_text: Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. The enemy chosen for this attack must be the enemy engaged with you with the highest fight. You get +4 [combat] for this attack. If this attack is successful, instead of its standard damage, you may assign up to 4 damage among enemies engaged with you (any additional damage adds to this total).
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械

name: 有利位置
text:
快速。在一个地点入场或在一位调查员的回合期间被揭示后打出。
直到当前调查员的回合结束，该地点隐藏值-1。你可以将其他任何地点上的1个线索移动到该地点上。

Until the end of the active investigator's turn, that location gets -1 shroud. You may move 1 clue to that location from any other location.

name: 纳克特手稿
text:
使用(3秘密)。
[reaction]在你所在地点的一位调查员将要在显现效果期间执行一次技能检定时，花费1秘密：本次检定不揭示混乱标记。

real_text:
Uses (3 secrets).
[reaction] When an investigator at your location would perform a skill test during a revelation effect, spend 1 secret: Do not reveal chaos tokens for that test.
[action] Spend 1 secret: Choose an investigator at your location. Do not reveal chaos tokens for the next skill test that investigator performs this round.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 书籍

name: 时间借取
text: 卓越。 [action]：在时间借取上放置1资源，视作一声滴答(时间借取上最多3声滴答)。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。 强制 - 在你的回合开始时：移除时间借取上所有的滴答。你本回合可以进行额外等量次的行动。
real_text: Exceptional. [action]: Place 1 resource on Borrowed Time, as a click (to a maximum of 3 clicks on Borrowed Time). Does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Forced - When your turn begins: Remove all clicks from Borrowed Time. You may take that many additional actions this turn.

name: 孤注一掷
text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
如果本次检定成功，你每超过难度1点，抽取1张卡牌，最多抽取5张。将所有以此效果抽取的弱点洗回你的牌库，不要结算它们。
real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card for each point you succeeded by, to a maximum of 5. Shuffle each weakness drawn by this effect back into your deck without resolving it.

name: 虚空碎裂

You get +2 [willpower] for this attack for each "0" token sealed on Shards of the Void. For each "0" token revealed during this attack, seal that token on Shards of the Void and this attack deals 1 additional damage.

name: 第七印记的封印
text: 封印([auto_fail])。使用(7充能)。如果第七印记的封印没有充能，或者其离场，将其从游戏中移除。 强制 - 在任何技能检定期间揭示[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]标记后：从第七印记的封印上移除1充能。
real_text: Seal ([auto_fail]). Uses (7 charges). If Seal of the Seventh Sign has no charges, or if it leaves play, remove it from the game. Forced - After a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] token is revealed during any skill test: Remove 1 charge from Seal of the Seventh Sign.

name: 临时路障
text: 你可以从你的弃牌堆中打出临时路障。如果你这么做，结算效果后将其洗入你的牌库。 躲避。所选敌人本次躲避尝试得到-1躲避值。(如果你从弃牌堆中打出了临时路障，你可以躲避同地点的额外一个躲避值不超过X的敌人。X为你检定成功且超过难度的点数。)
real_text: You may play Impromptu Barrier from your discard pile. If you do, shuffle it into your deck after resolving its effects. Evade. The chosen enemy gets -1 evade for this evasion attempt. (If you played Impromptu Barrier from your discard pile, you may evade an additional enemy at the same location with evade X or lower. X is the amount you succeed by.)

name: 改变命运
text:
快速。在任意[free]玩家时间段期间打出。
选择并弃掉场上一张没有附属到[[精英]]敌人上的非弱点诡计卡牌。
real_text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] player window.
Choose and discard from play a non-weakness treachery that is not attached to an [[Elite]] enemy.
flavor: 我们的命运由自己书写。

name: 卡洛琳·弗恩
text:
[reaction]在你的卡牌效果治愈调查员或[[盟友]]支援的恐惧后：被治愈卡牌的控制者获得1资源。
[elder_sign]效果：+1，你可以治愈你所在地点的一位调查员或一个[[盟友]]支援的1点恐惧。
real_text:
[reaction] After one of your card effects heals horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset: The healed card's controller gains 1 resource.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may heal 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.
flavor: “心灵本身是脆弱的，但是通过理解，我们就能对它加以保护。”
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5，带有“治愈……恐惧”字样的卡牌等级0-5，其他等级0-1的探求者和/或潜修者卡牌([seeker]和/或[mystic])最多15张。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：催眠疗法、理性思考、1张随机基础弱点。 额外限制：无等级1-5的[[武器]]卡牌。
back_flavor: 卡洛琳·弗恩以他人心房为居。她使用一种特殊的疗法，通过患者的梦境来研究他们的心理。在此类疗法实践的过程中，她见过也听过许多令人不安的事物。一些患者曾声称自己在睡梦中会去到其他的领域，或告诉她有可怕的生物出没于自己的梦境。她的研究将她导向一桩又一桩离奇事件，然而对于周遭世界的恐惧，她似乎并没有更多地真正了解。即便如此，卡洛琳不会停下研究，除非自己发现了这一切疯狂的根源。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5, cards that "heal horror" level 0-5, up to 15 other Seeker and/or Mystic cards level 0-1 ([seeker] and/or [mystic]). Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Hypnotic Therapy, Rational Thought, 1 random basic weakness. Additional Restrictions: No [[Weapon]] cards level 1-5.

name: 乔·戴蒙德
text: 强制 - 在调查阶段开始时：揭示你直觉牌库顶1张卡牌。直到本阶段结束，你可以以-2费用打出该卡牌，如同它是你的手牌。如果当本阶段结束时该卡牌未被打出，将其洗回你的直觉牌库。 [elder_sign]效果：+1。你可以将你弃牌堆的一张[[洞察]]事件移动到你的直觉牌库底。
real_text: Forced - When the investigation phase begins: Reveal the top card of your hunch deck. Until the end of the phase, you may play that card as if it were in your hand, at -2 cost. If it is still revealed at the end of the phase, shuffle it back into your hunch deck. [elder_sign] effect: +1. You may move an [[Insight]] event from your discard pile to the bottom of your hunch deck.
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：40 牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：侦探的柯尔特1911式手枪、悬案、1张随机基础弱点。 附加需求：你的牌库必须包括至少11张[[洞察]]事件(包括悬案)。在每场冒险的冒险设置期间，你必须从你牌库中选择11张[[洞察]]事件(其中必须包括悬案)，将其混洗为一个单独的“直觉牌库”。
back_flavor: 乔·戴蒙德是一名私家侦探，因办理他人眼中的非自然案件而闻名。他全身心地投入到每次调查中去，而且他的能力不容小觑。他既接受过有钱人的委托，也为穷苦人家办过事。不论是大案小案、奇案险案，他都不会拒绝。凭乔的经验来说，人一旦尝试接近真相，事情就会变得棘手，但这正是他想要的。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 40. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Detective's Colt 1911s, Unsolved Case, 1 random basic weakness. Additional Requirements: Your deck must include at least 11 [[Insight]] events (including Unsolved Case). During the setup of each scenario, you must choose 11 [[Insight]] events from your deck (one of which must be Unsolved Case) and shuffle them into a separate "hunch deck".

deck_options.error: Deck must have at least 11 Insights.

name: 普雷斯顿·费尔蒙特
text:
你每次从卡牌效果获得资源，不将其放在资源池，改为放在家族遗产上。
[elder_sign]效果：+0。你可以花费2资源以改为自动成功。
real_text:
Anytime you gain 1 or more resources from a card effect, place them on Family Inheritance instead of in your resource pool.
[elder_sign] effect: +0. You may spend 2 resources to automatically succeed, instead.
traits: 银暮秘社. 社会名流
flavor: “不论是我的钱、我的遗产，还是我面临的问题，让我用自己的方式来解决吧。”
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-5，求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：家族遗产、秘社“债务”、1张随机基础弱点。 牌库构建限制：无[[违法]]卡牌。
back_flavor: 普雷斯顿·费尔蒙特从没多想自己家族的钱是怎么来的。从前他只知道自己有大把的钱，只要花钱能解决问题他从不吝啬。他的父亲常常看起来很不安，曾试图向他解释他祖父经营的是什么生意、名叫“银暮秘社密会”的什么组织提出了哪些要求，但他从来没有把这放在心上。随后他父亲在一场离奇的车祸中丧生，自那以后打理家族财产的重任就落在了普雷斯顿的肩上。现在“银暮秘社”的社长卡尔·桑福德想要与普雷斯顿单独会面。这或许是普雷斯顿第一次真正开始思考他家族的财产是怎么得来的……
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Family Inheritance, Lodge "Debts," 1 random basic weakness. Deckbuilding Restrictions: No [[Illicit]] cards.

name: 黛安娜·史丹利
text:
黛安娜·史丹利底下每有一张卡牌，其得到+1[willpower]。
[reaction]你拥有的一张卡牌取消或忽略卡牌效果或游戏效果后，如果黛安娜·史丹利底下的卡牌数量少于5张：将该卡牌正面朝下放在她底下。抽取1张卡牌并获得1资源。(每阶段仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以选择黛安娜·史丹利底下的一张卡牌加入手牌。
real_text:
Diana Stanley gets +1 [willpower] for each card beneath her.
[reaction] After a card you own cancels or ignores a card effect or game effect, if there are fewer than 5 cards beneath Diana Stanley: Place that card facedown beneath her. Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource. (Limit once per phase.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may choose a card beneath Diana Stanley and add it to your hand.
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：35。 牌库构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：银暮匕首、黑暗洞察、可怕的秘密、1张随机基础弱点。 额外冒险设置：每场游戏开始时，你的起始手牌中额外有一张黑暗洞察。
back_flavor: 作为刚刚在阿卡姆营商的生意人，黛安娜·史丹利骄傲地接受了征召，加入久负盛名的银暮秘社。在那之后，她的喜悦之情变为了恐惧。受邀加入这个组织对于她的生意来说本来是件美事，但每周的会议越来越令人不安。在目睹诡异的仪式和恐怖的秘密后，黛安娜对这个结社的本质产生了怀疑。现在她确信有诸多可怕的势力齐聚于阿卡姆，且银暮秘社不知何故也参与其中。黛安娜决心要从内部瓦解这个组织，不借任何代价。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 35. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Twilight Blade, Dark Insight, Terrible Secret, 1 random basic weakness. Additional Setup: You begin each game with Dark Insight as an additional card in your opening hand.

name: 丽塔·杨
text:
[reaction]在你躲避一个敌人后：对该敌人造成1点伤害，或移动到一个连接地点。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+2。直到本轮结束，忽略以上[reaction]能力的限制。
real_text:
[reaction] After you evade an enemy: Either deal 1 damage to that enemy, or move to a connecting location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. Until the end of the round, ignore the limit on the above [reaction] ability.
flavor: “你有意见？我不介意。我把你甩在后头可不需要得到你的批准。”
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，[[技巧]]卡牌等级0-3。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：“我不会再逃了！”、兜帽人、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 时间是不会说谎的。在过去，有人曾对丽塔恶语相加。他们威胁她，认为她低人一等。但自从丽塔开始参加赛跑，她在意的只有时间。秒表读数显示，丽塔跑得比所有人都快。还看得出她比过去更加强壮，经受了更为刻苦的训练。现在，她或许要为自己的生命而战。有人在追着她。她对这一点十分确定。虽然她不知道追赶自己的是什么人，也不知道他们的来意，但有过好几个奇怪的人在她的宿舍周围徘徊。他们打算拿她杀一儆百，但前提是得先抓到她，而秒表读数显示，他们追不上丽塔。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, [[Trick]] cards level 0-3. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): "I'm done runnin'!," Hoods, 1 random basic weakness.

name: 玛丽·朗博
text:
你控制的卡牌上有至少1个毁灭标记时，你可以在自己的回合期间进行一个额外行动，但该额外行动只能用于打出[[法术]]卡牌或激活[[法术]][action]能力。
[elder_sign]效果：+1。你可以在你控制的一张卡牌上增加或移除1个毁灭标记。
real_text:
While you have 1 or more doom among cards you control, you may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to play [[Spell]] cards or activate [[Spell]] [action] abilities.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may add 1 doom to or remove 1 doom from a card you control.
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：[[法术]]卡牌等级0-5，潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5，[[密教]]卡牌等级0，其他等级0的探求者和/或求生者卡牌([seeker]和/或[survivor])最多5张。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：神秘乐曲、安息日男爵、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 多少人渴望听玛丽·朗博唱上一曲。人们把她叫做“烟熏天鹅绒”，称她是为演唱爵士乐而生，唱功如同魔法一一他们说的也许是真的。毕竟自祖母去世后，玛丽在梦里会听到一些她从未听过的歌曲。歌声听起来不像地球上使用的任何一种语言，曲调弯弯绕绕。玛丽永远也不会知道，她的祖母当年为什么从新奥尔良搬到了阿卡姆。人们过去把她的祖母叫做女巫。或许流淌在玛丽血液里的不止是爵士乐，毕竟……
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: [[Spell]] cards level 0-5, Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5, [[Occult]] cards level 0, up to five other level 0 Seeker and/or Survivor cards ([seeker] and/or [survivor]). Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Mystifying Song, Baron Samedi, 1 random basic weakness.
