name: 催眠疗法
text:
卡洛琳·弗恩牌库专用
[action]横置催眠疗法：检定[intellect](2)。如果你检定成功，治愈你所在地点一位调查员1点恐惧。然后，该调查员可以抽取1张卡牌。
[reaction]在你的其他卡牌效果治愈调查员的恐惧后，横置催眠疗法：该效果治愈额外1点恐惧。
real_text:
Carolyn Fern deck only.
[action] Exhaust Hypnotic Therapy: Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, heal 1 horror from an investigator at your location. Then, that investigator may draw 1 card.
[reaction] After one of your other card effects heals horror from an investigator, exhaust Hypnotic Therapy: That effect heals 1 additional horror.

name: 理性思考
text: 显现 - 将理性思考放置入场，放到你的威胁区域，带有4点恐惧。理性思考上的恐惧可以被治愈，如同其在卡洛琳·弗恩上。如果理性思考上没有恐惧，将其弃掉。 你不能治愈理性思考以外卡牌上的恐惧。你不能从卡洛琳·弗恩的[reaction]能力获得资源。
real_text: Revelation - Put Rational Thought into play in your threat area, with 4 horror on it. Horror on Rational Thought may be healed as if it were on Carolyn Fern. If there is no horror on Rational Thought, discard it. You cannot heal horror from cards other than Rational Thought. You cannot gain resources from Carolyn Fern's [reaction] ability.

name: 侦探的柯尔特1911式手枪
text: 乔·戴蒙德牌库专用。使用(4子弹)。 你控制的最多2张[[工具]]支援不占用手部槽位。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+1[combat]并造成+1伤害。如果本次攻击击败了敌人，你可以将你弃牌堆的一张[[洞察]]事件移动到你的直觉牌库底。
real_text: Joe Diamond deck only. Uses (4 ammo). Up to 2 [[Tool]] assets you control do not take up hand slots. [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If this attack defeats an enemy, you may move an [[Insight]] event from your discard pile to the bottom of your hunch deck.
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械

name: 悬案
text: 将你的1个线索放在隐藏值最高的地点上。将悬案从游戏中移除。 强制 - 如果悬案将要洗入你的直觉牌库：改为将它加入你的威胁区域。直到游戏结束，它获得：“强制 - 在游戏结束时：乔·戴蒙德本场冒险少取得2点经验值。”
real_text: Place 1 of your clues on the location with the highest shroud. Remove Unsolved Case from the game. Forced - If Unsolved Case would be shuffled into your hunch deck: Add it to your threat area instead. For the remainder of the game, it gains: "Forced - When the game ends: Joe Diamond earns 2 fewer experience for this scenario."

name: 家族遗产
text: 永久。普雷斯顿·费尔蒙特牌库专用。 [action]：将本卡牌上的所有资源移动到你的资源池。 强制 - 在你的回合开始时：在本卡牌上放置4资源(从供应堆拿取)。本卡牌上的资源可以被花费，如同在你的资源池中。当你的回合结束时，弃掉本卡牌上的所有资源。
real_text: Permanent. Preston Fairmont deck only. [action]: Move all resources from this card to your resource pool. Forced - When your turn begins: Place 4 resources (from the token pool) on this card. Resources on this card may be spent as if they were in your resource pool. Discard all resources from this card at the end of your turn.

name: 秘社“债务”
text: 将秘社“债务”从游戏中移除。 强制 - 在游戏结束或你退场时，如果秘社“债务”仍在你手牌中：你承受1点精神创伤。
real_text: Remove Lodge "Debts" from the game. Forced - When the game ends or you are eliminated, if Lodge "Debts" is still in your hand: You suffer 1 mental trauma.
flavor: 他谈到了契约和他背负的债务，显然他要付出的不只是金钱。<cite>《诡镇奇谈的调查员们》</cite>

name: 银暮匕首
text: 黛安娜·史丹利牌库专用。 [action]：攻击。你本次攻击可以不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。你可以打出或投入黛安娜·史丹利底下的事件和技能，如同其在你的手牌中。作为以此方式打出或投入卡牌的额外费用，横置银暮匕首。以此方式打出或投入卡牌时，你不能触发黛安娜·史丹利的[reaction]能力。
real_text: Diana Stanley deck only. [action]: Fight. You may use [willpower] instead of [combat] for this attack. You may play or commit events and skills beneath Diana Stanley as if they were in your hand. As an additional cost to play or commit a card in this way, exhaust Twilight Blade. You cannot trigger Diana Stanley's [reaction] ability while playing or committing a card in this way.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 武器

name: 黑暗洞察
text: 黛安娜·史丹利牌库专用。 快速。在你所在地点的一位调查员抽取一张遭遇卡牌或弱点时打出。 取消该卡牌的全部效果并将其洗回其牌库。(不抽取一张新卡牌以替换。)
real_text: Diana Stanley deck only. Fast. Play when an investigator at your location draws an encounter card or a weakness. Cancel all of that card's effects and shuffle it back into its deck. (Do not draw a new card to replace it.)

name: 可怕的秘密
text: 显现 - 如果黛安娜·史丹利底下没有卡牌，将可怕的秘密洗回你的牌库。否则，黛安娜·史丹利底下每有一张卡牌，你必须弃掉该卡牌或受到1点恐惧。不能取消。
real_text: Revelation - If there are no card beneath Diana Stanley, shuffle Terrible Secret back into your deck. Otherwise, for each card beneath Diana Stanley, you must either discard that card or take 1 horror. Cannot be canceled.

name: “我不会再逃了！”
text: 丽塔·杨牌库专用。 快速。只能在你回合期间打出。 你所在地点的所有敌人重整并与你交战。你回合的剩余时间内，每当你躲避一个敌人，你可以不横置该敌人也不与其解除交战，而 是改为对其造成1点伤害。(成功躲避的其他所有效果仍然有效。)
real_text: Rita Young deck only. Fast. Play only during your turn. Ready and engage all enemies at your location. For the remainder of your turn, whenever you evade an enemy, instead of exhausting and disengaging from that enemy, you may deal it 1 damage. (All other effects of the successful evasion still apply.)

name: 兜帽人
text: 猎物 - 仅对丽塔·杨。 警戒。猎手。 强制 - 在你躲避兜帽人后：其攻击你。
real_text: Prey - Rita Young only. Alert. Hunter. Forced - After you evade Hoods: It attacks you.
flavor: “你们这些该死的胆小鬼，总是蒙着脸。你们就像混账三K党一样，不敢让人们知道自己是谁……”<cite>格雷厄姆·麦克尼尔，《米斯卡塔尼克的食尸鬼》</cite>

name: 神秘乐曲
text:
玛丽·朗博牌库专用。
快速。在密谋将要因为达到毁灭阈值而推进时打出。
直到本阶段结束，密谋不能因为达到毁灭阈值而推进。将神秘乐曲从游戏中移除。
real_text:
Marie Lambeau deck only.
Fast. Play when the agenda would advance by reaching its doom threshold.
Until the end of the phase, the agenda cannot advance by reaching its doom threshold. Remove Mystifying Song from the game.

name: 安息日男爵
text: 显现 - 将安息日男爵放置入场。他身上有少于3个毁灭标记时，他不能离场。 强制 - 在任意数量的伤害被放置到安息日男爵所在地点的调查员上时：在该调查员上放置额外1点伤害。 [free]横置安息日男爵：在安息日男爵上放置1个毁灭标记。如果他身上有至少3个毁灭标记，将他弃掉。
real_text: Revelation - Put Baron Samedi into play. He cannot leave play while he has less than 3 doom on him. Forced - When any amount of damage is placed on an investigator in Baron Samedi's location: Place 1 additional damage on that investigator. [fast] Exhaust Baron Samedi: Place 1 doom on Baron Samedi. If he has 3 or more doom on him, discard him.

name: 拷问
text: 谈判。选择你所在地点的一个[[类人]]敌人并检定[combat](3)。本次检定得到+X难度，其中X为所选敌人的伤害值。如果你检定成功，发现你所在地点的1个线索和其他任意一个地点的1个线索。
real_text: Parley. Choose a [[Humanoid]] enemy at your location and test [combat] (3). This test gets +X difficulty, where X is the chosen enemy's damage value. If you succeed, discover 1 clue at your location and 1 clue at any other location.
flavor: 他在隐瞒着什么……但他为什么要隐瞒？

name: 劫数延后
text: 快速。只能在你回合期间打出。附属到你所在地点的一位调查员，置于该调查员控制之下。 [reaction]在你受到伤害和/或恐惧时：弃掉劫数延后并取消你刚受到的全部伤害和/或恐惧。 强制 - 在神话阶段结束时：你必须花费2资源或弃掉劫数延后。
real_text: Fast. Play only during your turn. Attach to an investigator at your location, under his or her control. [reaction] When you are dealt damage and/or horror: Discard Delay the Inevitable and cancel all damage and/or horror just dealt. Forced - When the mythos phase ends: You must either spend 2 resources or discard Delay the Inevitable.
traits: 洞察. 勇气. 策略

name: 坚定不移
text: 你剩余生命值和剩余神志值总和至少为5时，坚定不移获得[willpower][combat](你剩余生命值和剩余神志值总和至少为10时，改为坚定不移获得[willpower][willpower][combat][combat])。
real_text: While you have 5 or more total remaining health and sanity, Steadfast gains [willpower] [combat] (while you have 10 or more total remaining health and sanity, Steadfast gains [willpower] [willpower] [combat] [combat], instead).
flavor: 勇敢和愚蠢之间只有一线之隔。

name: 宝剑王牌
text:
你得到+1[combat]。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果宝剑王牌在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
real_text:
You get +1 [combat].
[reaction] When the game begins, if Ace of Swords is in your opening hand: Put it into play.
flavor: 单刀直入。

name: 指纹采集工具
text: 使用(3补给)。 [action]横置指纹采集工具并花费1补给：调查。你本次调查得到+1[intellect]。如果你检定成功，发现你所在地点额外1个线索。
real_text: Uses (3 supplies). [action] Exhaust Fingerprint Kit and spend 1 supply: Investigate. You get +1 [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, you discover 1 additional clue at your location.

name: 串联线索
text:
快速。你发现所在地点的最后一个线索后打出。
发现一个地点的2个线索，该地点的印刷隐藏值须低于你所在地点。
real_text:
Fast. Play after you discover the last clue at your location.
Discover 2 clues at a location with a lower printed shroud value than your location.
flavor: 他们曾认为你变得不可理喻。偏执。妄想。但结果证明，你一直以来都是对的。

name: 好奇心
text: 你至少有4张手牌时，好奇心获得[willpower][intellect](你至少有7张手牌时，改为好奇心获得[willpower][willpower][intellect][intellect])。
real_text: While you have 4 or more cards in hand, Curiosity gains [willpower] [intellect] (while you have 7 or more cards in hand, Curiosity gains [willpower] [willpower] [intellect] [intellect], instead).
flavor: 如果你就是被好奇心害死的那只猫呢？

name: 死神·XIII
text:
你得到+1[intellect]。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果死神·XIII在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
real_text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] When the game begins, if Death • XIII is in your opening hand: Put it into play.
flavor: 让往事如风，拥抱新生。

name: 良好人脉
text:
每位调查员仅限1张。
[free]横置良好人脉：你每有5资源，你本次技能检定得到技能值+1。
real_text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[fast] Exhaust Well Connected: You get +1 skill value for this skill test for every 5 resources you have.
flavor: 有的时候，有关系比有本事强。

name: 金钱万能
text:
快速。在你发动技能检定时打出。
本次检定不是其标识的技能类型([willpower]、[intellect]、[combat]或[agility])，而是改为资源技能检定。本次检定你的基础技能值等于你资源池内资源数的一半(向下取整)。
real_text:
Fast. Play when you initiate a skill test.
Instead of the skill type indicated for this test ([willpower], [intellect], [combat], or [agility]), this is a resource skill test. Your base skill value for this test is equal to half the number of resources in your resource pool (rounded down).
flavor: 钱买不来幸福，但你可以买到除此之外的一切好东西。

name: 狡猾
text: 你拥有至少5资源时，狡猾获得[intellect][agility](你拥有至少10资源时，改为狡猾获得[intellect][intellect][agility][agility])。
real_text: While you have 5 or more resources, Cunning gains [intellect] [agility] (while you have 10 or more resources, Cunning gains [intellect] [intellect] [agility] [agility], instead).
flavor: “别担心。”她坚持说，“我能搞定这事。”

name: 月亮·XVIII
text:
你得到+1[agility]。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果月亮·XVIII在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
real_text:
You get +1 [agility].
[reaction] When the game begins, if The Moon • XVIII is in your opening hand: Put it into play.
flavor: 张开你的双眼，倾听你的影子。

name: 否决存在
text: 快速。在遭遇卡牌或敌人攻击将要导致你执行以下一项(选择一项)时打出：弃掉手牌、失去资源、失去行动、受到伤害、受到恐惧。你忽略该效果的影响。(所有其他效果如常结算。)
real_text: Fast. Play when an encounter card or an enemy attack would cause you to do one of the following (choose one): Discard cards from hand, lose resources, lose actions, take damage, or take horror. You ignore that aspect of the effect. (Each other aspect resolves normally.)

name: 恐怖灵感
text:
快速。在你将要结算一张[mystic]卡牌上的效果，且该卡牌有以下触发条件时打出：在[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号揭示时；如果揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号；在[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号揭示后。
取消该效果，或额外结算一次该效果。
real_text:
Fast. Play when you would resolve an effect on a [mystic] card that triggers "when," "if," or "after" a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed.
Either cancel that effect, or resolve it an additional time.

name: 预见未来
text: 场上有至少3个毁灭标记时，预见未来获得[wild](场上有至少6个毁灭标记时，改为预见未来获得[wild][wild])。
real_text: While there are 3 or more doom in play, Prophesy gains [wild] (while there are 6 or more doom in play, Prophesy gains [wild] [wild], instead).
flavor: 末日将至。

name: 圣杯四
text:
你得到+1[willpower]。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果圣杯四在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
real_text:
You get +1 [willpower].
[reaction] When the game begins, if Four of Cups is in your opening hand: Put it into play.
flavor: 找寻你心灵与思绪的清明。

name: 钉鞋
text:
每位调查员仅限1张[[鞋子]]。
你得到+1[agility]。
[reaction]在你移动后，新到地点的敌人与你交战之前，横置钉鞋：检定[agility](3)。如果你检定成功，移动到一个连接地点。
real_text:
Limit 1 [[Footwear]] per investigator.
You get +1 [agility].
[reaction] After you move, but before enemies at your new location engage you, exhaust Track Shoes: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, move to a connecting location.
traits: 道具. 服装. 鞋子

name: 绝望之举
text: 作为打出绝望之举的额外费用，从你手牌或游戏区域选择并弃掉一张占用至少1个手部槽位的[[道具]]支援。 攻击。本次攻击你得到+X[combat]并造成+1伤害，其中X为所选支援的印刷资源费用。如果你检定成功且该支援是从你游戏区域弃掉的，获得X资源。
real_text: As an additional cost to play Act of Desperation, choose and discard an [[Item]] asset that takes up at least 1 hand slot from your hand or play area. Fight. You get +X [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack, where X is the chosen asset's printed resource cost. If you succeed and that asset was in your play area, gain X resources.

name: 体格强健
text: 你控制的[[道具]]支援不超过2张时，体格强健获得[combat][agility](你控制的[[道具]]支援不超过1张时，改为体格强健获得[combat][combat][agility][agility])。
real_text: While you control 2 or fewer [[Item]] assets, Able Bodied gains [combat] [agility] (while you control 1 or fewer [[Item]] assets, Able Bodied gains [combat] [combat] [agility] [agility], instead).

name: 星币五
text:
你得到+1生命值和+1神智值。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果星币五在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
real_text:
You get +1 health and +1 sanity.
[reaction] When the game begins, if Five of Pentacles is in your opening hand: Put it into play.
flavor: 是时候重新站起来了。

name: 权杖王牌
text:
[free]在你回合期间，将权杖王牌从游戏中移除：你本回合可以进行额外1次行动，在该次行动期间你得到每项技能+2。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果权杖王牌在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
real_text:
[fast] During your turn, remove Ace of Rods from the game: You may take an additional action this turn, during which you get +2 to each of your skills.
[reaction] When the game begins, if Ace of Rods is in your opening hand: Put it into play.

name: 第十三幻象
text: 显现 - 将第十三幻象放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 你所在地点的调查员在技能检定期间，技能值等于检定难度时检定失败。 [action][action]：弃掉第十三幻象。
real_text: Revelation - Put The 13th Vision into play in your threat area. Investigators at your location fail ties during skill tests. [action][action]: Discard The 13th Vision.
flavor: 前十二个都是假象……

name: 高塔·XVI
text: 高塔·XVI在你手牌中时，你不能在技能检定投入卡牌。 如果冒险设置期间你抽取了高塔·XVI作为你起始手牌(不论在重调之前还是之后)，你不能将其替换。其必须留在你的起始手牌中。
real_text: You cannot commit cards to skill tests while The Tower • XVI is in your hand. If The Tower • XVI is drawn in your opening hand during setup (before or after taking a mulligan), you cannot replace it. It must stay in your opening hand.

name: 赴汤蹈火
text: 你所在地点的其他调查员受到的恐惧可以分配给赴汤蹈火。
real_text: Something Worth Fighting For may be assigned horror dealt to other investigators at your location.
flavor: 我不能死在这儿。现在不能，还不能。

name: 水落石出
text:
快速。一位调查员发现你所在地点的最后一个线索后打出。
位于该地点的调查员获得总计X资源，由你自行分配。X为该地点的隐藏值。
real_text:
Fast. Play after an investigator discovers the last remaining clue at your location.
Investigators at that location gain a total of X resources, distributed as you wish. X is that location's shroud value.
flavor:
“……当你排除掉一切不可能的情况后，不论剩下的有多不可思议，都一定是真相。”
——阿瑟·柯南·道尔，《白化士兵》

name: 情报报告
text:
发现你所在地点的1个线索。
[reaction]在你打出情报报告时，提升其费用2点：“发现……的1个线索”变为“发现……的2个线索”。
[reaction]在你打出情报报告时，提升其费用2点：“你所在地点”变为“与你所在地点之间连接次数不超过2的地点”
real_text:
Discover 1 clue at your location.
[reaction] When you play Intel Report, increase its cost by 2: Change "Discover 1 clue" to "Discover 2 clues."
[reaction] When you play Intel Report, increase its cost by 2: Change "at your location" to "at a location up to 2 connections away."

name: 魔法手势
text:
快速。
你拥有额外1个法术槽位，只能用来携带一张[[法术]]或[[仪式]]支援。
real_text:
Fast.
You have 1 additional arcane slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset.
flavor: 皮囊不过是意识的延伸。

name: 驱除
text: 躲避。只用于非[[精英]]敌人。本次躲避尝试不使用[agility]，改为使用[willpower]。如果你检定成功，将刚才躲避的敌人移动到场上任意一个地点。如果你检定成功且本次躲避尝试期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]符号，该敌人在下一个补给阶段期间不重整。
real_text: Evade. Use only on a non-[[Elite]] enemy. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. If you succeed, move the enemy just evaded to any location in play. If you succeed and a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbol was revealed during this evasion attempt, that enemy does not ready during the next upkeep phase.

name: 切肉刀
text: [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+1[combat](如果你剩余神智值不超过3，改为+2[combat])。如果本次攻击击败了敌人，你可以治愈1点恐惧。作为发动本能力的额外费用，你可以受到1点恐惧以使本次攻击造成+1伤害。
real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack (+2 [combat] instead if you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity). If this attack defeats an enemy, you may heal 1 horror. As an additional cost to initiate this ability, you may take 1 horror to have this attack deal +1 damage.
traits: 道具. 武器. 近战

name: .45汤姆逊冲锋枪
text: 使用(5子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]并造成+1伤害。
real_text: Uses (5 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法
flavor: 这款全自动的汤姆逊冲锋枪因为其精确度与大火力，同时受到黑帮与警察的青睐。

name: 秘密卷轴
text:
使用(3秘密)。
[action]横置秘密卷轴并花费1秘密：查看任意一位调查员的牌库底或遭遇牌库底1张卡牌。然后，弃掉该卡牌、将其加入其所有者手牌，或将其放到该牌库底或者牌库顶。
real_text:
Uses (3 secrets).
[action] Exhaust Scroll of Secrets and spend 1 secret: Look at the bottom card of any investigator's deck or the encounter deck. Then, either discard that card, add it to its owner's hand, place it on the bottom of its deck, or place it on the top of its deck.

name: 田纳西酸麦芽威士忌
text: 使用(2补给) [free]横置田纳西酸麦芽威士忌并花费1补给：你在诡计卡牌的一次技能检定中得到+2[willpower]。 [action]弃掉田纳西酸麦芽威士忌：攻击。你本次攻击得到+3[combat]。
real_text: Uses (2 supplies). [fast] Exhaust Tennessee Sour Mash and spend 1 supply: You get +2 [willpower] for a skill test on a treachery card. [action] Discard Tennessee Sour Mash: Fight. You get +3 [combat] for this attack.

name: 附魔剑
text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+1[combat]。作为发动本能力的额外费用，你可以花费1充能来为剑附魔。如果你这么做，本次攻击你得到+1[combat]并造成+1伤害。
real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. As an additional cost to initiate this ability, you may spend 1 charge to empower the blade. If you do, you get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 武器. 近战

name: 恐怖图腾
text: [reaction]在你将卡牌投入技能检定后，横置恐怖图腾：你选择该卡牌已有的任意一个技能图标，该卡牌额外获得该图标。
real_text: [reaction] After you commit a card to a skill test, exhaust Grisly Totem: That card gains another instance of one of its skill icons of your choice.
flavor: 当时应该马上把它丢掉的。但我们又怎么知道呢？

name: 爱丽丝·洛克斯雷
text:
你得到+1[intellect]。
[reaction]在你发现线索后，横置爱丽丝·洛克斯雷：对你所在地点的一个敌人造成1点伤害。
real_text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After you discover a clue, exhaust Alice Luxley: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
traits: 盟友. 侦探. 警察
flavor: “请把这事留给专业的。我要是发现你再乱来，就把你送局子里去。”

name: 妥善养护
text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
附属到你控制的一张[[道具]]支援。每个支援仅限1张。
[reaction]所附属支援被弃掉后：将该支援返回其所有者手牌，附属到该支援的其他所有[[升级]]附属也返回各自所有者的手牌。
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to an [[Item]] asset you control. Limit 1 per asset.
[reaction] After attached asset is discarded: Return it to its owner's hand, along with each other [[Upgrade]] attachment that was attached to it.

name: “老千”先生
text:
使用(3秘密)。
[free]横置“老千”先生并花费1秘密：查找你牌库顶3张、6张或9张卡牌，找出任意一张卡牌并将其抽取。如果查找的卡牌中有至少1张弱点，也抽取其中1张弱点。混洗你的牌库。
real_text:
Uses (3 secrets).
[fast] Exhaust Mr. "Rook" and spend 1 secret: Search the top 3, 6, or 9 cards of your deck for any card and draw it. If at least 1 weakness is among the searched cards, draw 1 of them, as well. Shuffle your deck.
flavor: “你确定想要知道吗？决定了就回不了头咯。”

name: 鹰眼折叠相机
text:
[reaction]你所在地点的最后一个线索被发现后：在本卡牌上放置1个资源(从供应堆拿取)，作为证据。(每场游戏每个地点仅限一次。)鹰眼折叠相机上有·····
- ……至少1个证据时，你得到+1[willpower]。
- ……至少2个证据时，你得到+1[intellect]。
- ……至少3个证据时，你得到+1神智值。
real_text: [reaction] After the last clue is discovered from your location: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on this card, as evidence. (Limit once per game at each location.) While Hawk-Eye Folding Camera has ... - ... 1 or more evidence, you get +1 [willpower]. - ... 2 or more evidence, you get +1 [intellect]. - ... 3 or more evidence, you get +1 sanity.

name: 亨利·万
text:
[action]横置亨利·万：依次从混乱袋随机揭示任意个混乱标记，直到你自己选择停下，或直到你揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号。
- 如果你选择停下，你通过本效果每揭示一个标记，你可以抽取1张卡牌或获得1资源。
- 如果你揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，无事发生。
real_text:
[action] Exhaust Henry Wan: One at a time, reveal random tokens from the chaos bag until you choose to stop, or until you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol.
- If you chose to stop, for each token revealed via this effect, you may either draw 1 card or gain 1 resource.
- If you revealed a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, do nothing.

name: 反应灵敏
text:
快速。在任意调查员的回合期间(不含行动期间)打出。
立即进行一次行动，如同现在是你的回合。此行动不计入你每回合能够进行的行动数量。
real_text:
Fast. Play during any investigator's turn, except during an action.
Immediately take an action as if it were your turn. This action does not count toward the number of actions you can take each turn.

name: 凋零术
text: [action]：攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。如果本次攻击期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]符号，被攻击敌人在本回合剩余时间内得到-1攻击值和-1躲避值，最低减至1。
real_text: [action]: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbol is revealed during this attack, the attacked enemy gets -1 fight and -1 evade for the remainder of the turn (to a minimum of 1).

name: 第六感
text: [action]：调查。本次调查不使用[intellect]，改为使用[willpower]。如果本次检定期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]符号，你可以选择与你所在地点连接的一个已揭示地点；改为如同你在所选地点调查，而不是在你当前所在地点(你可以使用两个地点中任意一个地点的隐藏值)。
real_text: [action]: Investigate. Investigate using [willpower] instead of [intellect]. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbol is revealed during this test, you may choose a revealed location connected to your location; you are now investigating as if you were at the chosen location instead of your location (you may use either shroud value).

name: 险中求胜
text: [reaction]在你发动技能检定时，横置险中求胜：此次检定的难度提升2点。获得2资源或抽取1张卡牌。
real_text: [reaction] When you initiate a skill test, exhaust Drawing Thin: Increase the difficulty of this skill test by 2. Gain 2 resources or draw 1 card.

name: 勇闯虎穴
text:
快速。在你成功躲避一个敌人且超过难度至少2点后打出。
发现该敌人所在地点的1个线索。
real_text:
Fast. Play after you successfully evade an enemy by 2 or more.
Discover 1 clue at that enemy's location.

name: .45汤姆逊冲锋枪
text: 使用(5子弹)。 从.45汤姆逊冲锋枪上花费的子弹放入你的资源池，作为资源。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]并造成+1伤害。
real_text: Uses (5 ammo). Ammo spent from .45 Thompson is placed in your resource pool, as resources. [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法

name: .45汤姆逊冲锋枪
text: 使用(5子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]并造成+1伤害。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少X点，你可以花费1子弹以对你所在地点的另一个敌人造成本次攻击的伤害，其中X为该敌人的攻击值。
real_text: Uses (5 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If you succeed by at least X, you may spend 1 ammo to deal this attack's damage to another enemy at your location, where X is that enemy's fight value.
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法

name: 秘密卷轴
text:
使用(3秘密)。
[action]横置秘密卷轴并花费1秘密：查看任意一位调查员的牌库底或遭遇牌库底3张卡牌。你可以弃掉其中1张。你可以将其中1张加入其所有者手牌。将其中剩余的卡牌以任意顺序放到该牌库顶或牌库底。
real_text:
Uses (3 secrets).
[action] Exhaust Scroll of Secrets and spend 1 secret: Look at the bottom 3 cards of any investigator's deck or the encounter deck. You may discard 1 of those cards. You may add 1 of those cards to its owner's hand. Place the rest of those cards on either the top or bottom of their deck, in any order.

name: 秘密卷轴
text:
使用(4秘密)。
[action]横置秘密卷轴并花费1秘密：查看任意一位调查员的牌库顶或牌库底1张卡牌，或遭遇牌库顶或牌库底1张卡牌。然后，弃掉该卡牌、将其加入其所有者手牌，或将其放到该牌库底或者牌库顶。
real_text:
Uses (4 secrets).
[action] Exhaust Scroll of Secrets and spend 1 secret: Look at the top or bottom card of any investigator's deck or the encounter deck. Then, either discard that card, add it to its owner's hand, place it on the bottom of its deck, or place it on top of its deck.

name: 田纳西酸麦芽威士忌
text: 快速。使用(2补给)。 [free]横置田纳西酸麦芽威士忌并花费1补给：你在诡计卡牌的一次技能检定中得到+3[willpower]。 [action]弃掉田纳西酸麦芽威士忌：攻击。本次攻击你得到+3[combat]并造成+1伤害。
real_text: Fast. Uses (2 supplies). [fast] Exhaust Tennessee Sour Mash and spend 1 supply: You get +3 [willpower] for a skill test on a treachery card. [action] Discard Tennessee Sour Mash: Fight. You get +3 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: 田纳西酸麦芽威士忌
text: 使用(3补给)。 [free]横置田纳西酸麦芽威士忌并花费1补给：你在诡计卡牌的一次技能检定中得到+2[willpower]。 [action]弃掉田纳西酸麦芽威士忌：攻击。你本次攻击得到+3[combat]。如果本次攻击对一个非[[精英]]敌人检定成功，自动躲避该敌人。
real_text: Uses (3 supplies). [fast] Exhaust Tennessee Sour Mash and spend 1 supply: You get +2 [willpower] for a skill test on a treachery card. [action] Discard Tennessee Sour Mash: Fight. You get +3 [combat] for this attack. If this attack succeeds against a non-[[Elite]] enemy, automatically evade it.

name: 附魔剑
text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。如果你检定成功，你可以花费1充能来为剑附魔，使本次攻击造成+1伤害。如果剑已附魔且本次攻击击败了敌人，抽取1张卡牌并治愈1点恐惧。
real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to empower the blade, dealing +1 damage for this attack. If the blade is empowered and this attack defeats an enemy, draw 1 card and heal 1 horror.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 武器. 近战

name: 附魔剑
text: 使用(4充能)。 [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。作为使用本能力的额外费用，你可以花费最多2充能来为剑附魔(每以此方式花费1充能，本次攻击你得到+1[combat]并造成+1伤害)。
real_text: Uses (4 charges). [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. As an additional cost to use this ability, you may spend up to 2 charges to empower the blade (for each charge spent in this way, you get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack).
traits: 道具. 遗物. 武器. 近战

name: 恐怖图腾
text: [reaction]在你将卡牌投入技能检定后，横置恐怖图腾：你选择该卡牌已有的任意一个技能图标，该卡牌额外获得该图标。如果该次技能检定成功，执行检定的调查员抽取1张卡牌。
real_text: [reaction] After you commit a card to a skill test, exhaust Grisly Totem: That card gains another instance of one of its skill icons of your choice. If that skill test is successful, the performing investigator draws 1 card.
traits: 道具. 守护. 诅咒萦绕
flavor: 当时应该马上把它丢掉的。但我们又怎么知道呢？

name: 恐怖图腾
text: [reaction]在你将卡牌投入技能检定后，横置恐怖图腾：你选择该卡牌已有的任意一个技能图标，该卡牌额外获得该图标。如果该次技能检定失败，将该卡牌返回你手牌。
real_text: [reaction] After you commit a card to a skill test, exhaust Grisly Totem: That card gains another instance of one of its skill icons of your choice. If that skill test fails, return that card to your hand.
traits: 道具. 守护. 祝福
flavor: 当时应该马上把它丢掉的。但我们又怎么知道呢？

name: 委员会的保险箱
text: 使用(1[per_investigator]锁头)。如果委员会的保险箱上没有锁头，每位调查员查找自己的牌库或弃牌堆，找出任意一张卡牌并立即将其免费打出。放逐委员会的保险箱。(每个剧本最多一次。) [action][action]：检定任意一项技能(5)。如果你检定成功，移除1锁头。你所在地点的任何调查员均可以激活本能力。 卡牌设计于阿卡姆之夜2017理事会。
real_text: Uses (1 [per_investigator] locks). If there are no locks on The Council's Coffer, each investigator searches his or her deck or discard pile for any card and immediately plays it at no cost. Exile The Council's Coffer. (Max once per campaign.) [action][action]: Test any skill (5). If you succeed, remove 1 lock. Any investigator at your location may activate this ability. Card design by The Council at Arkham Nights 2017.

name: 鸣枪示警
text:
作为打出鸣枪示警的额外费用，花费你控制的一张[[枪械]]支援的1子弹。
将你所在地点的所有非[[精英]]敌人移动到一个连接地点。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
real_text:
As an additional cost to play Warning Shot, spend 1 ammo from a [[Firearm]] asset you control.
Move all non-[[Elite]] enemies at your location to a connecting location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
flavor: “退后！”

name: 瞄准镜
text: 快速。附属到你控制的一张占用2个手部槽位的[[枪械]]支援。所附属支援不能用于攻击与你交战的敌人。 [reaction]在你用所附属支援执行攻击行动时，如果你没有与任何敌人交战，横置瞄准镜：本次攻击能够以一个连接地点上的一个非[[精英]]敌人作为对象。本次攻击忽略冷漠和反击关键词。
real_text: Fast. Attach to a [[Firearm]] asset you control that takes up two hand slots. Attached asset cannot be used to attack enemies engaged with you. [reaction] When you perform a Fight action using attached asset, if you are engaged with no enemies, exhaust Telecopic Sight: This attack can target a non-[[Elite]] enemy at a connecting location. Ignore the aloof and retaliate keywords for this attack.

name: 知识就是力量
text: 快速。只能在你回合期间打出。 选择一张你控制的[[书籍]]或[[法术]]支援，或揭示你手牌中的一张[[书籍]]或[[法术]]支援。结算该支援上的一个[action]或[free]能力，忽略所有费用(包括其[action]费用，如有)。然后，如果该支援是从你手牌中揭示的，你可以弃掉它来抽取1张卡牌。
real_text: Fast. Play only during your turn. Choose a [[Tome]] or [[Spell]] asset you control, or reveal a [[Tome]] or [[Spell]] asset from your hand. Resolve an [action] or [fast] ability on that asset, ignoring all costs (including its [action] cost, if any). Then, if that asset was in your hand, you may discard it to draw 1 card.
flavor: ……这股力量也会堕落。

name: 绝密地图集
text:
使用(4秘密)。
[action]花费1秘密并横置绝密地图集：选择一个与你所在地点之间的连接次数正好为2的已揭示地点。移动到该地点。
real_text:
Uses (4 secrets).
[action] Spend 1 secret and exhaust Esoteric Atlas: Choose a revealed location that is exactly 2 connections away from your location. Move to that location.

name: 投资
text:
使用(0补给)。投资上仅限10补给。
[free]横置投资：在上面放置1补给。
[action]横置并弃掉投资：将本卡牌上所有补给移动到你的资源池，作为资源。
real_text:
Uses (0 supplies). Limit 10 supplies on Investments.
[fast] Exhaust Investments: Place 1 supply on it.
[action] Exhaust and discard Investments: Move all supplies from it to your resource pool, as resources.

name: 诱敌
text: 躲避。自动躲避你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人。 [reaction]在你打出诱敌时，提升其费用2点：“一个非[[精英]]敌人”变为“最多2个非[[精英]]敌人”。 [reaction]在你打出诱敌时，提升其费用2点：“你所在地点”变为“与你所在地点之间连接次数不超过2的地点”。
real_text: Evade. Automatically evade a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. [reaction] When you play Decoy, increase its cost by 2: Change "a non-[[Elite]] enemy" to "up to 2 non-[[Elite]] enemies." [reaction] When you play Decoy, increase its cost by 2: Change "at your location" to "at a location up to 2 connections away."

name: 蠕虫的秘密
text: [action]横置蠕虫的秘密并在其上放置1个毁灭标记：从你的弃牌堆打出一张[[法术]]或[[洞察]]事件，其资源费用减少1点。该事件结算后，将其从游戏中移除。
real_text: [action] Exhaust De Vermis Mysteriis and place 1 doom on it: Play a [[Spell]] or [[Insight]] event from your discard pile, reducing its resource cost by 1. After that event resolves, remove it from the game.
flavor: 本书作者是路德维格·普林恩；他在巫术审判达到高潮时死于布鲁塞尔的审讯桩上。<cite>——罗伯特·布洛克，《来自星际的蹒跚者》</cite>

name: 指路鬼魂
text: 你得到+1[intellect]。 非直接恐惧在分配到你的调查员卡牌之前，必须先分配给指路鬼魂。 强制 - 在指路鬼魂因为恐惧而被击败时：将其放逐。
real_text: You get +1 [intellect]. Non-direct horror must be assigned to Guiding Spirit before it can be assigned to your investigator card. Forced - When Guiding Spirit is defeated by horror: Exile it.

name: 幸运或是注定
text:
快速。在毁灭标记将要放到任意冒险卡牌上时打出。
每场游戏最多1张。
取消将要放到该卡牌上的1个毁灭标记。放逐幸运或是注定。
real_text:
Fast. Play when doom would be placed on any scenario card.
Max 1 per game.
Cancel 1 doom just placed on that card. Exile Fortune or Fate.

name: MK1手榴弹
text: 使用(3补给)。如果MK1手榴弹没有补给，将其弃掉。 [action]花费1补给：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。如果本次攻击成功，本次攻击不造成标准伤害，改为对受攻击敌人所在地点的每个敌人和每位其他调查员造成2点伤害(所有额外伤害只对被攻击敌人造成)。
real_text: Uses (3 supplies). If Mk 1 Grenades has no supplies, discard it. [action] Spend 1 supply: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If this attack is successful, instead of its standard damage, this attack deals 2 damage to each enemy and each other investigator at the attacked enemy's location (any additional damage is dealt to the attacked enemy).
traits: 道具. 武器. 远程

name: 特工支援
text:
你所在地点其他调查员受到的伤害和/或恐惧，可以分配给特工支援。
[free]横置特工支援并对其造成1点伤害：对你所在地点的一个敌人造成1点伤害。
[free]横置特工支援并对其造成1点恐惧：发现你所在地点的1个线索。
real_text:
Agency Backup may be assigned damage and/or horror dealt to other investigators at your location.
[fast] Exhaust Agency Backup and deal 1 damage to it: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
[fast] Exhaust Agency Backup and deal 1 horror to it: Discover 1 clue at your location.

name: 恐怖揭露
text: 发现你所在地点的3个线索。将你任意数量的线索交给另一位调查员，或者在任意一个地点上放置你任意数量的线索。你被击败并承受1点精神创伤。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
real_text: Discover 3 clues at your location. Give any number of your clues to another investigator, or place any number of your clues on any location. You are defeated and suffer 1 mental trauma. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: 苦心钻研
text:
永久。
每场游戏开始时，你的起始手牌中额外有一张卡牌。
real_text:
Permanent.
You begin each game with 1 additional card in your opening hand.
flavor: 或许吉尔曼不该那样努力地钻研。<cite>——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《女巫屋中之梦》</cite>

name: 帮个小忙
text:
对你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人造成1点伤害。
[reaction]在你打出帮个小忙时，提升其费用2点：“造成1点伤害”变为“造成2点伤害”。
[reaction]在你打出帮个小忙时，提升其费用2点：“你所在地点”变为“与你所在地点之间连接次数不超过2的地点”。
real_text:
Deal 1 damage to a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location.
[reaction] When you play Small Favor, increase its cost by 2: Change "Deal 1 damage" to "Deal 2 damage."
[reaction] When you play Small Favor, increase its cost by 2: Change "at your location" to "at a location up to 2 connections away."

name: 干一天活计拿一天钱
text:
永久。
你每场游戏开始拥有额外2资源。
real_text:
Permanent.
You begin each game with 2 additional resources.
flavor: 重要的东西盯紧点。

name: 黛雅娜·艾丝帕伦斯
text: 使用(3秘密)。 [free]：将你手牌中的一张非弱点[[法术]]事件附属到黛雅娜·艾丝帕伦斯上。附属到其上的事件仅限1张。 可以打出附属的事件，如同其在你手牌中。其打出后，不放到你的弃牌堆(其仍附属在原处)。作为打出附属的事件的额外费用，横置黛雅娜·艾丝帕伦斯并花费1秘密。
real_text: Uses (3 secrets). [fast]: Attach a non-weakness [[Spell]] event from your hand to Dayana Esperence. Limit 1 event attached to her. The attached event may be played as if it were in your hand. It is not placed in your discard pile after it is played (it remains attached). As an additional cost to play the attached event, exhaust Dayana Esperence and spend 1 secret.

name: 否决存在
text:
快速。在遭遇卡牌或敌人攻击将要导致你执行以下一项(选择一项)时打出：弃掉手牌、失去资源、失去行动、受到伤害、受到恐惧。
你忽略该效果的影响。然后，对应地执行与之相反的效果(抽取卡牌、获得资源、获得额外行动、治愈伤害、治愈恐惧)。
real_text:
Fast. Play when an encounter card or enemy attack would cause you to do one of the following (choose one): Discard cards from hand, lose resources, lose actions, take damage, or take horror.
You ignore that aspect of the effect. Then, perform the opposite of that aspect (draw cards, gain resources, gain additional actions, heal damage, or heal horror, respectively).

name: 勇闯火线
text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
选择你一项技能。直到你回合结束，将该技能的基础值设为5。
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose one of your skills. Until the end of your turn, set the base value of that skill to 5.
flavor: 只有在你性命受到威胁时，你才会认识到自己能力的极限。

name: 偷梁换柱
text: 选择一项： - 躲避。如果你检定成功，且躲避的敌人非[[精英]]，躲避该敌人并将其移动到一个连接地点。 - 躲避。只用于在连接地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人。如果你检定成功，躲避该敌人并与其交换地点。
real_text: Either (choose one): - Evade. If you succeed and the enemy is non-[[Elite]], evade the enemy and move it to a connecting location. - Evade. Use only on a non-[[Elite]] enemy at a connecting location. If you succeed, evade that enemy and switch locations with it.

name: 安娜·卡斯洛
text:
你拥有额外2个塔罗牌槽位。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果安娜·卡斯洛在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
[reaction]在安娜·卡斯洛入场后：查找你的牌库，找出一张[[塔罗]]支援，并将其放置入场。
real_text:
You have 2 additional tarot slots.
[reaction] When the game begins, if Anna Kaslow is in your opening hand: Put her into play.
[reaction] After Anna Kaslow enters play: Search your deck for a [[Tarot]] asset and put it into play.

name: 圣化之镜

When Hallowed Mirror leaves play, find each of those copies of Soothing Melody (even if they are out of play) and set them aside, out of play.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 密教. 祝福

name: 舒缓旋律
text:
绑定(圣化之镜)。
治愈你所在地点的调查员和/或[[盟友]]支援的2点伤害或2点恐惧(或者以任意方式组合，总计2点)。抽取1张卡牌。
real_text:
Bonded (Hallowed Mirror).
Heal 2 damage or 2 horror (or any combination thereof) from among investigators and/or [[Ally]] assets at your location. Draw 1 card.
flavor: “……他们的歌声融入月光，融入那凄美静谧的月光……”<cite>——保罗·魏尔伦，《月光》</cite>

name: “我见过更糟的……”
text:
快速。在你受到伤害和/或恐惧时打出。
取消你刚受到的伤害和/或恐惧中最多2点。然后，获得同等数量的资源。
real_text:
Fast. Play when you are dealt damage and/or horror.
Cancel up to 2 damage and/or horror just dealt to you. Then, gain that many resources.

name: 密教辞典
text: 每套牌库仅限1张。 强制 - 在密教辞典入场后：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出3张鲜血仪式。将其中1张加入你手牌，将其余2张洗入你的牌库。在密教辞典离场时，找到所有这些鲜血仪式(即使在场外)，将它们放在一边，位于场外。

traits: 道具. 书籍. 密教

text:
绑定(密教辞典)。
抽取2张卡牌。弃掉你最多2张手牌。每有一张卡牌因此被弃掉，你可以获得1资源，或者花费1资源来对你所在地点的一个敌人造成1点伤害。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
real_text:
Bonded (Occult Lexicon).
Draw 2 cards. Discard up to 2 cards from your hand. For each card thusly discarded, you may either gain 1 resource, or spend 1 resource to deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: 窥看不思议之事
text: 将你手牌中任意数量的非弱点卡牌洗入你的牌库。抽取卡牌，直至手牌数量达到上限。将窥看不思议之事从游戏中移除。
real_text: Shuffle any number of non-weakness cards from your hand into your deck. Draw cards until you reach your maximum hand-size. Remove Glimpse the Unthinkable from the game.
flavor: 无知是福，但你无福消受。

name: “你欠我一次！”
text: 查看另一位调查员的手牌。你可以打出该调查员手牌中的一张非弱点卡牌，置于你的控制之下。如果你这么做，你和该调查员都抽取1张卡牌。
real_text: Look at another investigator's hand. You may play a non-weakness card in that investigator's hand, under your control. If you do, you and that investigator each draw 1 card.
flavor: “对、对，当然了。你之前三次也是这么说的。”

name: 超级加倍
text:
卓越。
[reaction]在你打出一张事件后，横置超级加倍：再次打出该事件，如同其在你手牌中。
real_text:
Exceptional.
[reaction] After you play an event, exhaust Double, Double: Play that event again as if it were in your hand.
flavor: 怪鸟在鸣啸：“时候到了，时候到了。”<cite>——威廉·莎士比亚，《麦克白》</cite>

name: 凋零术
text: [action]：攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。你本次攻击得到+2[willpower]。如果本次攻击期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]符号，被攻击敌人在本回合剩余时间内得到-1攻击值、-1生命值和-1躲避值，最低减至1。
real_text: [action]: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. You get +2 [willpower] for this attack. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbol is revealed during this attack, the attacked enemy gets -1 fight, -1 health, and -1 evade for the remainder of the turn (to a minimum of 1).

name: 第六感
text: [action]：调查。本次调查不使用[intellect]，改为使用[willpower]。你本次调查得到+2[willpower]。如果本次检定期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]符号，你可以选择与你所在地点之间连接次数不超过2的一个已揭示地点；如同你在所在地点调查的同时，也在所选地点调查(你可以使用两个地点中任意一个地点的隐藏值)。

If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbol is revealed during this test, you may choose a revealed location up to 2 connections away from your current location; you are now investigating as if you were at the chosen location in addition to your location (you may use either shroud value).

name: 诱敌深人
text: 附属到你所在地点或一个连接地点。 敌军阶段期间，所有要移动的敌人不照常移动，而是改为沿着最短路径，朝附属地点移动。 强制 - 附属在地点时，当一轮结束时：弃掉诱敌深入。
real_text: Attach to your location or to a connecting location. During the enemy phase, each enemy that moves does so along the shortest path toward the attached location, instead of to where it would normally move. Forced - While attached, at the end of the round: Discard Lure.

name: 美满结局
text:
快速。在技能检定期间，你揭示一个混乱标记，且该标记将要令你的技能值减少到0时打出(包括[auto_fail]标记)。
取消该标记并改为将其视作[elder_sign]标记。
real_text:
Fast. Play when you reveal a chaos token that would reduce your skill value to 0 during a skill test (including the [auto_fail] token).
Cancel that token and treat it as an [elder_sign] token, instead.

name: 托米·马尔登
text:
[reaction]在你控制的一个支援被击败时：获得X资源，其中X等于该支援上的伤害和恐惧总和。將该支援混洗回你的牌库。
[elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以将托米·马尔登上的总计最多2点伤害和/或恐惧移动到你控制的一个支援上，或者将你控制的一个支援上的总计最多2点伤害和/或恐惧移动到托米·马尔登上。
real_text:
[reaction] When an asset you control is defeated: Gain X resources, where X is the total amount of damage and horror on that asset. Shuffle that asset into your deck.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may move up to 2 damage and/or horror from Tommy Muldoon to an asset you control, or vice versa.
flavor: “保持警惕，托米。”
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，求生者卡牌([survivor])等級0-2。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：贝基、低级错误、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 马尔登家族里的大多数人都或多或少于波士顿警署任职。不久之前，马尔登家族最小的弟弟托米也得到了自己的警徽。托米有着敏锐的洞察力、过人的胆识，还有一把可靠的步枪“贝基”，他愿献身于执法事业······但当他被借调到阿卡姆的警察局之后，他发现自己对这座诡异小城里层出不穷的怪事一点心理准备都没有。即便如此，不管罪案现场是烟雾缭绕的地下酒吧，还是血迹斑驳的圣坛，托米都不会停下追查的步子，直到将罪犯绳之以法。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Becky, Rookie Mistake, 1 random basic weakness.

name: 曼蒂·汤普森
text:
[reaction] 在你所在地点的一位调查员将要查找自己的牌库或遭遇牌库，找出卡牌并结算某一效果时：该调查员可以查找额外3张卡牌，或者该次查找多结算1个目标。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+0。查找你牌库顶的3张卡牌，找出其中一张，抽取该卡牌或者将其投入本次检定(如可能)。混洗你的牌库。
real_text:
[reaction] When an investigator at your location would search their deck or the encounter deck: They may either search 3 additional cards or resolve 1 additional target of the search. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +0. Search the top 3 cards of your deck for a card and either draw it or commit it to this test, if able. Shuffle your deck.
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：当构建牌库时，选择牌库卡牌张数为30、40或50。 选择次级职阶：当构建牌库时，选择潜修者([mystic])、流浪者([rogue])或求生者([survivor])。 牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，最多10张等级0-1你选择次级职阶的事件和/或技能。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：1张神秘证据(如果你的卡牌张数为40，改为2张；如果为50，则改为3张)、惊人的发现、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 曼蒂打从小时候开始，睡不着就会看书。许多夜晚都是如此度过的。她过目不忘，擅长联系事物找出真相，因此她得到了米斯卡塔尼克大学的一份宝贵工作——研究员。她曾花上数小时翻阅那些古老的禁书，细细阅读书中的亵渎内容。在阅读过程中，她发现字里行间在有规律地暗示着一场大乱即将来临。她是不是得了妄想症？还是说真有一场灾难或是动乱将要发生？
real_back_text: Deck Size: At deck creation, choose 30, 40, or 50. Secondary Class Choice: At deck creation, choose Mystic ([mystic]), Rogue ([rogue]), or Survivor ([survivor]). Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 10 level 0-1 events and/or skills of your chosen secondary class. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 1 copy of Occult Evidence (2 copies instead if your deck size is 40; 3 copies instead if your deck size is 50), Shocking Discovery, 1 random basic weakness.

name: 托尼·摩尔根
text:
在你回合期间，你可以进行额外一次行动，该行动只能用于与带有赏金的敌人交战，或攻击带有赏金的敌人。
[elder_sign]效果：+2。在赏金合约上放置1点赏金。
real_text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to engage or fight an enemy with 1 or more bounties on it.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. Place 1 bounty on Bounty Contracts.
flavor: “等我找到那个怪物，我就把它彻底干掉。”
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 选择次级职阶：当构建牌库时，选择守卫者([guardian])、探求者([seeker])或求生者([survivor])。 牌库构建选项：流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，最多10张等级0-1你选择次级职阶的事件和/或技能。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：赏金合约、2张托尼的.38柯尔特长管手枪、托尼的猎物、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 托尼能把卑鄙的人渣从世上任何一个肮脏的角落里揪出来，但他却从来没想到，自己会在印斯茅斯杀死那样的家伙。那家伙的长相与人类有几分相似，但全身都布满了惹人生厌的鳞片和粘液，像是某种恐怖的深海生物。它的气味混杂着海水、烂鱼和血液的味道。托尼本该在它跳下水后就放手不管，但他从未让赏金打过水漂，这次自然也不会善罢甘休。在那之后，他的赏金猎物又多了一种——可能是普通匪徒，也可能是异界的怪物。只要有人付钱······他定会把目标解决。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Secondary Class Choice: At deck creation, choose Guardian ([guardian]), Seeker ([seeker]), or Survivor ([survivor]). Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 10 level 0-1 events and/or skills of your chosen secondary class. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Bounty Contracts, 2 copies of Tony's .38 Long Colt, Tony's Quarry, 1 random basic weakness.

name: 卢克·罗宾逊
text:
你以门之匣在场上开始游戏。
你每回合可以打出1张事件卡牌，如同你位于一个连接地点并且与该地点的每个敌人交战。
[elder_sign]效果：+1。在门之匣上放置1充能。
real_text:
You begin the game with Gate Box in play.
You may play one event each turn as if you were at a connecting location and engaged with each enemy at that location.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Place 1 charge on Gate Box.
traits: 入梦者. 漂泊者. 旅人
flavor: “通往幻梦境的钥匙就在我们每个人心中。”
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 牌库构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：门之匣、脱离现实，1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 在许多年之前，卢克发现了幻梦境的入口。从他叔叔留给他的礼物——不同寻常的盒子中，他掌握了进出梦境之门的方法。从那以后，他大部分时候都在梦境里徘徊，寻历奇遇。从塞勒菲斯的街道到充满无穷谜团的魔幻森林，他信步徘徊，揭开梦境和居住在此的入梦者背后的秘密。如今，古老的混沌不仅威胁着要毁灭现实世界，还要毁灭他的梦中世界。卢克绝不允许此事发生。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Gate Box, Detached from Reality, 1 random basic weakness.

name: 派翠丝·海瑟薇
text:
你的手牌上限减少3张。
在每个补给阶段期间，不抽取1张卡牌，改为弃掉你手牌中的全部非弱点卡牌，抽取卡牌，直到你有5张手牌。
[elder_sign]效果：+1。本次检定结束后，你可以将弃牌堆中的1张卡牌留下并将其余卡牌混洗回你的牌库。
real_text:
Your maximum hand size is reduced by 3.
During each upkeep phase, instead of drawing 1 card, discard all non-weakness cards in your hand and draw until you have 5 cards in hand.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. After this test ends, you may shuffle all but 1 card from your discard pile into your deck.
back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：42。 牌库构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-5，潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：派翠丝的小提琴、异次元监视者、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 派翠丝毕生都在为音乐而活。悠扬的奏鸣曲、曼妙的咏叹调、低沉洪亮的进行曲，永远是她最亲密的伙伴。但有的时候，当派翠丝拉起小提琴，她能感觉到有个超出认知的怪异存在正监视且等待着她，心急如焚。在过去的一个月里，它出现得愈发频繁，派翠丝的情绪也日渐紧绷，已开始影响她拉琴的表现。她再也无法忍受。她在阿卡姆沃德剧院举办最后一场演奏会之后，终于决定要采取行动。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 42. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Patrice's Violin, Watcher from Another Dimension, 1 random basic weakness.
