清理工具套装上的补给可以花费，如同是你控制的支援上的补给或子弹。
real_text:
Uses (3 supplies).
Supplies on Cleaning Kit may be spent as if they were supplies or ammo on assets you control.
flavor:
“清理了！搞定了！挑出顽垢，掐走旧污，光亮如新唰唰响！”
——《沙夫纳的目录》，1924年冬季版
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 武士刀
text: [action]：攻击。你本次检定得到+2[combat]。如果你检定成功且超过难度正好2点，你可以横置武士刀以使本次攻击造成+2伤害。 [free]横置武士刀：攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[agility]。
real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this test. If you succeed by exactly 2, you may exhaust Katana to deal +2 damage for this attack. [fast]Exhaust Katana: Fight. Use [agility] instead of [combat] for this attack.
traits: 道具. 武器. 近战
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 御札
text:
使用(1充能)。每轮在你的地点第一次有[bless]标记揭示时，补满此充能。
[free]选择你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人并花费1充能：该敌人失去警戒、冷漠、逃逸和反击关键词，直到本轮结束。
real_text:
Uses (1 charge). Replenish this charge the first time a [bless] token is revealed at your location each round.
[fast] Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location and spend 1 charge: That enemy loses the alert, aloof, elusive, and retaliate keywords until the end of the round.
traits: 道具. 守护. 祝福
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 狼面具
text:
每位调查员仅限1张[[面具]]。
使用(2贡品)。你与敌人交战后，补满其中的1贡品。
[free]花费1贡品：你本次技能检定得到+2[combat]或+2[agility]。(每次检定仅限一次。)
real_text:
Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
Uses (2 offerings). Replenish 1 of these offerings after you engage an enemy.
[fast] Spend 1 offering: You get +2 [combat] or +2 [agility] for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)
traits: 道具. 守护. 面具
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 赦免
text:
从混乱袋中随机揭示3个标记和额外X个标记。
每揭示一个非符号标记，在混乱袋中加入1个[bless]标记。每揭示一个[bless]标记，治愈你所在地点的调查员或[[盟友]]支援的1点恐惧。
real_text:
Reveal 3 random tokens from the chaos bag, along with X additional tokens.
For each non-symbol token revealed, add 1 [bless] token to the chaos bag. For each [bless] token revealed, heal 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 信仰指引
text: 调查。你本次调查可以不使用[intellect]，改为使用[willpower]。本次检定揭示混乱标记前，在混乱袋中加入2个[bless]标记。如果本次检定期间揭示了[bless]或[elder_sign]标记，发现你所在地点的额外1个线索。
real_text: Investigate. You may use [willpower] instead of [intellect] for this investigation. Before revealing chaos tokens for this test, add 2 [bless] tokens to the chaos bag. If a [bless] or [elder_sign] token is revealed during this skill test, discover 1 additional clue at your location.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 举起手来
text: 谈判。选择你所在地点的一个敌人和你手牌中一个[[道具]]支援。对所选敌人执行一次攻击行动。如果你检定成功，不造成伤害，改为打出所选支援，其费用减少你超过难度的点数。
real_text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and an [[Item]] asset in your hand. Perform a fight action against the chosen enemy. If you succeed, instead of dealing damage, play the chosen asset, reducing its cost by each point you succeeded by.
flavor: “把——把手举起来！”
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 特遣队
text:
作为打出特遣队的额外费用，花费一个行动。选择你所在地点的一位调查员按任意顺序依次……
- ……结算其控制的支援上的一个[action]能力，不支付其[action]费用。
- ……移动到一个连接地点。
- ……发现其所在地点的1个线索。
real_text:
As an additional cost to play Task Force, spend an action. One at a time, in any order, choose an investigator at your location to...
- ...resolve an [action] ability on an asset they control without paying its [action] cost.
- ...move to a connecting location.
- ...discover 1 clue at their location.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 修修补补
text:
快速。只能在你的回合期间打出。
将修修补补附属到你游戏区域的[[工具]]支援。每个支援仅限1张。
所附属的支援少占据1个手部或饰品槽位。
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach Tinker to a [[Tool]] asset in your play area. Limit 1 per asset.
Attached asset takes up 1 fewer hand or accessory slot.
flavor: “这东西还能叫扳手？”
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 净化
text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
你可以将净化投入任意类型的检定。
如果本次检定成功，你每超过难度1点(最多为5)，在混乱袋中加入1个[bless]标记，或从混乱袋中移除1个[curse]标记。
real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
You may commit Purified to any type of test.
If this test is successful, for each point you succeeded by (to a maximum of 5), add 1 [bless] token or remove 1 [curse] token from the chaos bag.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 手眼协调
text:
快速。只能在你的回合期间打出。
结算你控制的[[工具]]或[[武器]]支援上的一个[action]能力，不支付其[action]费用。
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Resolve an [action] ability on a [[Tool]] or [[Weapon]] asset you control without paying its [action] cost.
flavor: 盯紧目标。
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 膂力过人
text: 膂力过人投入到使用[[近战]]或[[远程]]支援的攻击时，本次攻击造成+1伤害。本次技能检定揭示混乱标记后，你可以受到1点伤害，以取消该混乱标记，将其放回混乱袋，并揭示一个新标记。(你可以执行任意次数。)
real_text: While Strong-Armed is committed to an attack using a [[Melee]] or [[Ranged]] asset, this attack deals +1 damage. After revealing chaos token(s) for this skill test, you may take 1 damage to cancel that chaos token, return it to the chaos bag, and reveal a new one. (You may do this any number of times.)
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 恢复元气
text:
只能作为你的第一个行动打出。
治愈2点伤害(如果你本轮抽取了一张诡计卡牌，改为治愈3点伤害)。抽取1张卡牌。
real_text:
Play only as your first action.
Heal 2 damage (3 damage instead if you drew a treachery this round). Draw 1 card.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 清理工具套装
text:
使用(4补给)。
清理工具套装上的补给可以花费，如同是你控制的支援上的补给或子弹。
[reaction]在花费清理工具套装的补给时，将其横置：执行检定的调查员本次检定得到技能值+2。
real_text:
Uses (4 supplies).
Supplies on Cleaning Kit may be spent as if they were supplies or ammo on assets you control.
[reaction] When a supply is spent from Cleaning Kit, exhaust it: The performing investigator gets +2 skill value for this test.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 蒙福之刃
text: [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。如果本次攻击成功，造成+1伤害。将本次攻击期间揭示的每个[bless]标记返回混乱袋。在本次攻击揭示混乱标记前，你可以横置蒙福之刃以在混乱袋中加入2个[bless]标记。
real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If this attack is successful, it deals +1 damage. Return each [bless] token revealed during this attack to the chaos bag. Before revealing chaos token(s) for this attack, you may exhaust Blessed Blade to add 2 [bless] tokens to the chaos bag.
traits: 道具. 武器. 近战. 祝福
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 瓦卢西亚之瞳
text: [action]：谈判。选择你所在地点的一个敌人。直到本轮结束，每位调查员对所选敌人攻击、躲避或谈判时得到技能值+1。在瓦卢西亚之瞳上放置1资源，作为充能。 [free]：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出幽嘶之刃，与瓦卢西亚之瞳交换，将瓦卢西亚之瞳的所有充能移动到幽嘶之刃。
real_text: [action]: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location. Until the end of the round, each investigator gets +1 skill value while fighting, evading, or parleying with the chosen enemy. Place 1 resource on Eyes of Valusia, as a charge. [fast]: Search your bonded cards for Blade of Yoth and swap it with Eyes of Valusia, moving all charges from Eyes of Valusia to Blade of Yoth.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 法术
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 幽嘶之刃
text: 绑定(瓦卢西亚之瞳)。 [action]花费1-3充能：攻击。你本次攻击可以不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。你每花费1充能作为本行动的费用，得到技能值+2并造成+1伤害。 [free]：查找你的绑定卡牌。找出瓦卢西亚之瞳，与幽嘶之刃交换，弃掉所有充能。
real_text: Bonded (Eyes of Valusia). [action] Spend 1-3 charges: Fight. For this attack, you may use [willpower] instead of [combat]. You get +2 skill value and deal +1 damage for each charge spent as part of this action's cost. [fast]: Search your bonded cards for Eyes of Valusia and swap it with Blade of Yoth, discarding all charges.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 武器. 近战
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 旋风连击
text: 你控制[[近战]]支援才能打出。作为打出旋风连击的额外费用，花费一个行动。 攻击。选择一个你控制的[[近战]]支援，使用该支援立即进行一次攻击行动(不支付其[action]费用)。你可以再重复此效果最多三次。最后一次攻击结算后，如果这是你的回合，结束你的回合。
real_text: Play only if you control a [[Melee]] asset. As an additional cost to play Flurry of Blows, spend an action. Fight. Choose a [[Melee]] asset you control and take an immediate fight action with that asset (without paying its [action] cost). You may repeat this effect up to three times. After the final attack resolves, if it is your turn, end your turn.
traits: 策略. 翻倍. 定命
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 奇迹祝愿
text:
快速。你所在地点的技能检定期间揭示了[bless]标记后打出。
查找你的绑定卡牌，找出转瞬为神，并将其放置入场。在上面放置最多X个资源，作为祝愿(最多为揭示的[bless]标记数量)。将奇迹祝愿从游戏中移除。
real_text:
Fast. Play after 1 or more [bless] tokens are revealed during a skill test at your location.
Search your bonded cards for Evanescent Ascension and put it into play. Place up to X resources on it, as wishes (to a maximum of the number of [bless] tokens revealed). Remove Miracle Wish from the game.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 转瞬为神
text: 绑定(奇迹祝愿)。如果转瞬为神没有祝愿，将其放在一边，位于场外。 [reaction]在你地点的调查员技能检定将要失败时，花费1祝愿并横置转瞬为神：结算该调查员的[elder_sign]效果(本次检定期间揭示的所有其他标记也要结算)。
real_text: Bonded (Miracle Wish). If Evanescent Ascension has no wishes, set it aside, out of play. [reaction] When an investigator at your location would fail a skill test, spend 1 wish and exhaust Evanescent Ascension: Resolve that investigator's [elder_sign] effect (in addition to all other tokens revealed during this test).
traits: 仪式. 契约. 祝福
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 化学品套装
text: [action]横置化学品套装：调查。如果你…… - ……检定失败且低于难度正好2点，弃掉化学品套装。 - ……检定成功且等于难度，获得2资源。 - ……检定成功且超过难度正好2点，抽取1张卡牌。 - ……检定成功且超过难度正好4点，发现你所在地点额外1个线索。
real_text: [action] Exhaust Chemistry Set: Investigate. If you... - ...fail by exactly 2, discard Chemistry Set. - ...succeed by exactly 0, gain 2 resources. - ...succeed by exactly 2, draw 1 card. - ...succeed by exactly 4, discover 1 additional clue at your location.
traits: 道具. 工具. 科学
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 查尔斯·威斯特三世博士
text:
你拥有额外1个手部槽位，只可以用来携带[[工具]]支援。
[reaction]在你成功调查，且超过难度正好1点或3点后，横置查尔斯·威斯特三世博士：对你所在地点的一个敌人造成1点伤害。
real_text:
You have 1 additional hand slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Tool]] asset.
[reaction] After you successfully investigate by exactly 1 or 3, exhaust Dr. Charles West III: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 显微镜
text: [reaction]你所在地点的敌人被成功躲避或击败后，横置显微镜：在显微镜上放置1资源，作为证据。 [action][action]：调查。显微镜上每有1证据，你本次调查得到+1[intellect](最多+3[intellect])。如果你检定成功，你可以花费最多2证据，以额外发现你的地点同等数量的线索。
real_text: [reaction] After an enemy at your location is successfully evaded or defeated, exhaust Microscope: Place 1 resource on Microscope, as evidence. [action][action]: Investigate. You get +1 [intellect] for this investigation for each evidence on Microscope (max +3 [intellect]). If you succeed, you may spend up to 2 evidence to discover that many additional clues at your location.
traits: 道具. 工具. 科学
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 鼠面具
text:
每位调查员仅限1张[[面具]]。
使用(2贡品)。你揭示地点或将新的地点放置入场后，补满其中的1个贡品。
[free]花费1贡品：你本次技能检定得到+2[willpower]或+2[intellect]。(每次检定仅限一次。)
real_text:
Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
Uses (2 offerings). Replenish 1 of these offerings after you reveal a location or put a new location into play.
[fast] Spend 1 offering: You get +2 [willpower] or +2 [intellect] for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)
traits: 道具. 守护. 面具
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 饥饿霉菌
text:
每套牌库仅限1张。
[action]：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出诡异疯长，并将其加入你的手牌。
[action]如果饥饿霉菌上有至少3个生长：将每个生长移动到你的资源池，作为资源。在剧本日志中，记录下“你识别了新的物种。”
real_text:
Limit 1 per deck.
[action]: Search your bonded cards for Uncanny Growth and add it to your hand.
[action] If Ravenous Myconid has 3 or more growth on it: Move each growth to your resource pool, as resources. Record in your Campaign Log that "you have classified a new species."
traits: 生物. 怪物. 植物. 科学
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 诡异疯长
text: 绑定(饥饿霉菌)。 调查。本次检定结算后，你检定成功且每超过难度1点，在饥饿霉菌上放置1资源，作为生长。将诡异疯长放在一旁，位于场外。如果你检定失败，将诡异疯长返回你的手牌。
real_text: Bonded (Ravenous Myconid). Investigate. After this test resolves, place 1 resource on Ravenous Myconid, as growth, for each point you succeed by. Set Uncanny Growth aside, out of play. If you fail, return Uncanny Growth to your hand.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 控制变量
text:
快速。有调查员在你地点的技能检定期间揭示了[curse]标记后打出。
发现你所在地点的1个线索。
real_text:
Fast. Play after an investigator reveals a [curse] token during a skill test at your location.
Discover 1 clue at your location.
traits: 洞察. 科学. 诅咒萦绕
flavor:
“他会往死去的生物血管里注射一种溶剂，如果尸体还够新鲜，就会作出奇怪的反应。”
——H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《赫伯特·威斯特——复活死者之人》
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 冲刺实验
text: 作为打出冲刺实验的额外费用，花费一个行动。 调查。按照隐藏值升序依次调查你所在地点和每个连接地点一次，直到你调查失败或成功调查了每个符合条件的地点。
real_text: As an additional cost to play Testing Sprint, spend an action. Investigate. One at a time, investigate your location and each connecting location once each in ascending order of shroud, until you either fail to investigate or successfully investigate each eligible location.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 刨根问底
text: 作为打出刨根问底的额外费用，花费一个行动。 你所在地点的调查员抽取总计5张卡牌(由你决定每位调查员各抽取几张卡牌)
real_text: As an additional cost to play Thorough Inquiry, spend an action. Investigators at your location draw a combined total of 5 cards (you decide how many cards each investigator draws).
flavor: 真相往往就在眼皮子底下。
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: “用书砸它！”
text: 攻击。选择一个你控制的[[书籍]]支援。你本次攻击得到+X[combat]，其中X为该支援的印刷费用。如果你检定成功，你可以自动躲避被攻击的敌人，或者你可以在攻击结束后结算所选支援上的一个[action]或[free]能力(忽略其[action]费用，如有)。
real_text: Fight. Choose a [[Tome]] asset you control. You get +X [combat] for this attack, where X is that asset's printed cost. If you succeed, you may either automatically evade the attacked enemy, or after the attack ends, you may resolve an [action] or [fast] ability on the chosen asset (ignoring its [action] cost, if any).
flavor: “孩子，你……你真是大大超出我的意料。”
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 原形惊变
text: 躲避。你本次躲避尝试可以不使用[agility]，改为使用[intellect]。如果你检定成功，且该敌人非[[精英]]，将原形惊变附属到该敌人。 所附属敌人获得：“庞大。不能移动。 [reaction]你躲避本敌人后：发现其所在地点的1个线索。(每轮仅限一次。)”。
real_text: Evade. You may use [intellect] instead of [agility] for this evasion attempt. If you succeed and the enemy is non-[[Elite]], attach Transmogrify to it. Attached enemy gains: "Massive. Cannot move. [reaction] After you evade this enemy: Discover 1 clue at its location. (Limit once per round.)"
flavor: “我说‘别碰它’，不是‘变膨大’！”
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 资金充裕
text: 你控制[[科学]]或[[工具]]支援时，资金充裕获得[wild](你控制至少3个[[科学]]和/或[[工具]]支援时，资金充裕改为获得[wild][wild])。
real_text: While you control a [[Science]] or [[Tool]] asset, Well-Funded gains [wild] (while you control 3 or more [[Science]] and/or [[Tool]] assets, Well-Funded gains [wild] [wild], instead).
flavor: 每一分研究经费都花在刀刃上。
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 加布里埃尔·卡里洛
text:
你得到+1[intellect]。
[reaction]当你回合开始时，在混乱袋中加入1个[curse]标记：抽取1张卡牌。
real_text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] At the start of your turn, add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag: Draw 1 card.
traits: 盟友. 学者. 诅咒萦绕
flavor: “帮这个忙可比教学生几何轻松多了。”
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 手法稳当
text:
每位调查员仅限1张。
[reaction]在你技能检定将要成功时，横置手法稳当：你成功且超过难度的点数多1点或少1点。如果你检定成功且超过难度正好2点，治愈1点恐惧。
real_text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[reaction] When you would succeed at a skill test, exhaust Steady-Handed: You either succeed by 1 more or 1 less. If you succeeded by exactly 2, heal 1 horror.
flavor: 一个小口子就会决定生死。
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 精准调配
text:
附属到你控制的[[工具]]或[[科学]]支援。每个支援仅限1张。
[reaction]所附属支援横置后，横置精准调配：重整所附属的支援。
real_text:
Attach to a [[Tool]] or [[Science]] asset you control. Limit 1 per asset.
[reaction] After attached asset exhausts, exhaust Fine Tuning: Ready attached asset.
flavor: “我保证没什么好怕的！”
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 绝密手段
text: 本次技能检定结束后，执行检定的调查员检定成功且每超出难度1点，或者检定失败且每低于难度1点，就在混乱袋中加入1个[curse]标记。
real_text: After this skill test ends, add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag for each point the performing investigator either succeeded or failed by.
flavor: 传言大学里上一位颅相学教授的教职生涯长到离谱。
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 棱相眼镜
text: [action]在混乱袋中加入1个[curse]标记：调查。你本次调查得到技能值+2。如果本次调查期间揭示了[curse]标记，你可以横置棱相眼镜以发现你所在地点的额外1个线索。
real_text: [action] Add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag: Investigate. You get +2 skill value for this investigation. If a [curse] token is revealed during this investigation, you may exhaust Prismatic Spectacles to discover 1 additional clue at your location.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 诅咒萦绕
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 云山雾罩
text: 谈判。选择你所在地点的一个敌人。检定 [intellect](X)，其中X为所选敌人的躲避值。如果你检定成功，发现你所在地点的2个线索。然后，如果所选敌人为非[[精英]]，自动躲避该敌人。其在下一个补给阶段期间不重整。
real_text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location. Test [intellect] (X), where X is the chosen enemy's evade value. If you succeed, discover 2 clues at your location. Then, if the chosen enemy is non-[[Elite]], automatically evade it. It does not ready during the next upkeep phase.
flavor: “这向来不顶用，赫伯特。”
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 显微镜
text: [reaction]你所在地点的敌人被成功躲避或击败后：在显微镜上放置1资源，作为证据。 [action][action]：调查。显微镜上每有1证据，你本次调查得到+2[intellect](最多+6[intellect])。如果你检定成功，你可以花费最多3证据，以额外发现你的地点同等数量的线索。
real_text: [reaction] After an enemy at your location is successfully evaded or defeated: Place 1 resource on Microscope, as evidence. [action][action]: Investigate. You get +2 [intellect] for this investigation for each evidence on Microscope (max +6 [intellect]). If you succeed, you may spend up to 3 evidence to discover that many additional clues at your location.
traits: 道具. 工具. 科学
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 饥饿霉菌
text:
研究完成。每套牌库仅限1张。
[free]：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出诡异疯长，并将其加入你的手牌。(每轮仅限一次。)
[reaction]在调查员抽取非弱点诡计卡牌时，如果该调查员所在地点的隐藏值不大于饥饿霉菌上的生长数：取消该诡计的效果并将其弃掉。移除饥饿霉菌上所有的生长。
real_text:
Researched. Limit 1 per deck.
[fast]: Search your bonded cards for Uncanny Growth and add it to your hand. (Limit once per round.)
[reaction] When an investigator draws a non-weakness treachery card, if their locations shroud is equal to or less than Ravenous Myconid's growth: Cancel that treachery's effects and discard it. Remove all growth from Ravenous Myconid.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 饥饿霉菌
text:
研究完成。每套牌库仅限1张。
[free]：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出诡异疯长，并将其加入你的手牌。(每轮仅限一次。)
[free]选择你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人，该敌人的剩余生命值不能大于饥饿霉菌上的生长数：击败该敌人。移除饥饿霉菌上所有的生长。
real_text:
Researched. Limit 1 per deck.
[fast]: Search your bonded cards for Uncanny Growth and add it to your hand. (Limit once per round.)
[fast] Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location with equal or fewer remaining health than the amount of growth on Ravenous Myconid: Defeat that enemy. Remove all growth from Ravenous Myconid.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 饥饿霉菌
text:
研究完成。每套牌库仅限1张。
[free]：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出诡异疯长，并将其加入你的手牌。(每轮仅限一次。)
[free]移除饥饿霉菌上所有的生长：治愈饥饿霉菌上同等数量的伤害和/或恐惧，或者从你所在地点的调查员或[[盟友]]支援身上，将同等数量的伤害和/或恐惧移动到饥饿霉菌上。
real_text:
Researched. Limit 1 per deck.
[fast]: Search your bonded cards for Uncanny Growth and add it to your hand. (Limit once per round.)
[fast] Remove all growth from Ravenous Myconid: Either heal that much damage/horror from Ravenous Myconid, or move that much damage/horror from investigators or [[Ally]] assets at your location to Ravenous Myconid.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: “咪咪”比安卡
text: 每套牌库仅限1张。使用(10资源)。 [action]横置“咪咪”比安卡：谈判。将X资源从“咪咪”比安卡移动到你的资源池。X不能大于5。检定[agility](X)。如果你检定失败，记住“你欠比安卡X资源。”然后，查找你的绑定卡牌，找出“咪咪”比安卡敌人并将她生成在你的地点。将本卡牌从游戏中移除。
real_text: Limit 1 per deck. Uses (10 resources). [action] Exhaust Bianca "Die Katz": Parley. Move X resources from Bianca "Die Katz" to your resource pool. X cannot be more than 5. Test [agility] (X). If you fail, remember "you owe Bianca X resources." Then, search your bonded cards for the Bianca "Die Katz" enemy and spawn her at your location. Remove this card from the game.
traits: 盟友. 罪犯. 社会名流
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: “咪咪”比安卡
text: 绑定(“咪咪”比安卡)。猎手。 猎物 - 仅对承受者。 [action]如果“你欠比安卡X资源”，花费X资源：谈判。将“咪咪”比安卡加入胜利区。 强制 - 在“咪咪”比安卡离场(除因上述能力外)时：将她混洗入你的牌库。
real_text: Bonded (Bianca "Die Katz"). Hunter. Prey - Bearer only. [action] If "you owe Bianca X resources," spend X resources: Parley. Add Bianca "Die Katz" to the victory display. Forced - When Bianca "Die Katz" leaves play (except by the above ability): Shuffle her into your deck.
traits: 类人. 罪犯. 社会名流
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 敲诈文件
text: [action]选择你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人：谈判。检定[willpower](X)，其中X等于该敌人的印刷生命值。如果你检定成功，该敌人与每位调查员解除交战，且获得冷漠，直到本轮结束。
real_text: [action] Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location: Parley. Test [willpower] (X), where X is that enemy's printed health value. If you succeed, that enemy disengages from each investigator and gains aloof until the end of the round.
traits: 道具. 书籍. 违法
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 不列颠斗牛犬左轮手枪
text: 使用(3子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击可以不使用[combat]，改为使用[agility]。本次攻击造成+1伤害。 [reaction]你与敌人谈判时技能检定失败后：将不列颠斗牛犬左轮手枪从你的手牌放置入场。
real_text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You may use [agility] instead of [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. [reaction] After you fail a skill test while parleying with an enemy: Put British Bull Dog into play from your hand.
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 假证
text: [action]选择你所在地点的一个敌人并横置假证：谈判。检定[intellect](1)。假证上每有1疑点，本次检定难度+1。如果你检定成功，发现你所在地点的1个线索，并在假证上放置1资源，作为疑点。如果你检定失败，你必须弃掉假证，或所选敌人攻击你。
real_text: [action] Choose an enemy at your location and exhaust Fake Credentials: Parley. Test [intellect] (1). This test gets +1 difficulty for each suspicion on Fake Credentials. If you succeed, discover 1 clue at your location and place 1 resource on Fake Credentials, as suspicion. If you fail, you must either discard Fake Credentials, or the chosen enemy attacks you.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 狐面具
text:
每位调查员仅限1张[[面具]]。
使用(2贡品)。你移动离开有敌人的地点后，补满其中的1贡品。
[free]花费1贡品：你本次技能检定得到+2[intellect]或+2[agility]。(每次检定仅限一次。)
real_text:
Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
Uses (2 offerings). Replenish 1 of these offerings after you move out of a location with an enemy.
[fast] Spend 1 offering: You get +2 [intellect] or +2 [agility] for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)
traits: 道具. 守护. 面具
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 贝壳护符
text: [action]在混乱袋中加入1-3个[curse]标记并横置贝壳护符：获得1资源。每加入1个标记，获得额外1资源。
real_text: [action] Add 1-3 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag and exhaust Scrimshaw Charm: Gain 1 resource. For each token added, gain 1 additional resource.
traits: 道具. 守护. 诅咒萦绕
flavor: “让信仰取代现实，幻想取代记忆；我自省视，我自相信。”<cite>赫尔曼·梅尔维尔，《白鲸》</cite>
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 银行劫案
text:
作为打出银行劫案的额外费用，花费一个行动。
你所在地点的调查员获得总计8资源，由你自由分配。
real_text:
As an additional cost to play Bank Job, spend an action.
Investigators at your location gain a total of 8 resources, distributed as you wish.
traits: 局势. 翻倍. 违法
flavor: “别叫名字，倒霉蛋。”“抱歉，芬恩。”
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 诈降
text: 谈判。选择你所在地点的一个敌人并打出你手牌中一个[[武器]]支援，费用减少1点。然后，你可以用该武器对所选敌人进行一次攻击行动，不使用所示技能，改为使用[agility]。
real_text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and play a [[Weapon]] asset from your hand, reducing its cost by 1. You may then take a fight action with that weapon against the chosen enemy, using [agility] instead of the skill indicated.
flavor: “你小子滑头得很。”
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 诱骗
text: 谈判。选择你所在地点的一个敌人并检定 [agility](0)。你检定成功且每超过难度1点，获得1资源(最多6)。如果你检定失败，该敌人攻击你。
real_text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and test [agility] (0). For each point you succeed by, gain 1 resource (to a maximum of 6). If you fail, that enemy attacks you.
flavor: “看！呆雁！”“哪儿呢？”“就那儿。”
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: “我肯定还！”
text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
选择你所在地点的另一位调查员。将该调查员资源池的所有资源移动到你的资源池。当本轮结束时，将你资源池的所有资源移动到该调查员的资源池。
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose another investigator at your location. Move all resources from that investigator's resource pool to your resource pool. At the end of the round, move all resources from your resource pool to that investigator's resource pool.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 把水搅浑
text: 谈判。选择你所在地点的一个敌人并检定 [intellect](X)，其中X为所选敌人的伤害值与恐惧值之和。如果你检定成功，对你所在地点的每个敌人造成2点伤害。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，本效果结算后，你可以与每个敌人解除交战并移动到一个连接地点。
real_text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and test [intellect] (X), where X is the chosen enemy's combined damage and horror values. If you succeed, deal 2 damage to each enemy at your location. If you succeed by 2 or more, after this effect resolves you may disengage from each enemy and move to a connecting location.
flavor: “他确实说了你的头发……”
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 自由表演
text: 谈判。选择你所在地点的一个敌人并检定任意技能(3)。如果你检定成功且你检定了…… - ……[willpower]，移除该敌人上的1个毁灭标记。 - ……[intellect]，发现你所在地点的1个线索。 - ……[agility]，自动躲避该敌人。如果该敌人非[[精英]]，将其移动到一个连接地点。 - ……[combat]，对该敌人造成2点伤害。
real_text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and test any skill (3). If you succeed and you tested... - ...[willpower], remove 1 doom from that enemy. - ...[intellect], discover 1 clue at your location. - ...[agility], automatically evade that enemy. If it is non-[[Elite]], move it to a connecting location. - ...[combat], deal 2 damage to that enemy.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 福倚祸伏
text: 你执行的技能检定期间，在你揭示一个[curse]标记时，你可以将福倚祸伏从手牌投入到该技能检定。如果你这么做，福倚祸伏获得[wild][wild][wild]。
real_text: When you reveal a [curse] token during a skill test you are performing, you may commit Diabolical Luck to that skill test from your hand. If you do, Diabolical Luck gains [wild][wild][wild].
flavor: “修格斯，为什么非得是修格斯？”
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 脚步轻盈
text: 如果躲避尝试期间本次技能检定成功，你可以自动躲避所在地点的另一个敌人。
real_text: If this skill test is successful during an evasion attempt, you may automatically evade another enemy at your location.
flavor:
“我今晚跑过的东西真是前所未有的可怕。希望再也不要有下次了。”
——丽塔·杨，《诡镇奇谈的调查员们》
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 不列颠斗牛犬左轮手枪
text: 使用(3子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击可以不使用[combat]，改为使用[agility]，且你得到技能值+2。本次攻击造成+1伤害。本次攻击忽略冷漠关键词。 [reaction]你与敌人谈判时技能检定失败后：将不列颠斗牛犬左轮手枪从你的手牌放置入场。
real_text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You may use [agility] instead of [combat] for this attack and you get +2 skill value. This attack deals +1 damage. Ignore the aloof keyword for this attack. [reaction] After you fail a skill test while parleying with an enemy: Put British Bull Dog into play from your hand.
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 告密
text:
快速。你谈判时技能检定成功后打出。
发现你所在地点和连接地点的总计2个线索。
real_text:
Fast. Play after you succeed at a skill test while parleying.
Discover 2 total clues from among your location and connecting locations.
flavor: “我不该告诉你这个的，但你看起来很可靠……”
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 摄魂抓魄
text:
永久。卓越。
[reaction]你抽取起始手牌前：查找你的牌库，找出最多3张不同的[[技巧]]卡牌，将其正面朝下附属到摄魂抓魄。混洗你的牌库。
[reaction]在你与敌人进入交战状态时，横置摄魂抓魄：抽取1张附属的卡牌，或者查找你牌库顶9张卡牌，找出一张附属卡牌的同名卡牌，将其抽取并混洗你的牌库。
real_text:
Permanent. Exceptional.
[reaction] Before you draw your opening hand: Search your deck for up to 3 different [[Trick]] cards, and attach them facedown to Bewitching. Shuffle your deck.
[reaction] When you engage an enemy, exhaust Bewitching: Either draw 1 attached card, or search the top 9 cards of your deck for a copy of an attached card, draw it, and shuffle your deck.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 脏活
text: 作为打出脏活的额外费用，花费一个行动。 查找你的牌库，找出一张[[违法]]支援并打出，支付其费用。然后，你可以结算该支援上的一个[action]或[free]能力，忽略所有费用(包括其[action]费用，如有)。打出本卡牌不会触发趁乱攻击。
real_text: As an additional cost to play Dirty Deeds, spend an action. Search your deck for an [[Illicit]] asset and play it, paying its cost. Then, you may resolve an [action] or [fast] ability on that asset, ignoring all costs (including its [action] cost, if any). Playing this card does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
traits: 恩惠. 翻倍. 违法
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 自由表演
text: 谈判。选择你所在地点的一个敌人和任意数量的技能，以任意顺序依次检定每项所选技能(2)。你每有一次检定成功，如果检定的是…… - ……[willpower]，移除该敌人上的1个毁灭标记。 - ……[intellect]，发现该敌人所在地点的1个线索。 - ……[agility]，自动躲避该敌人。如果该敌人非[[精英]]，将其移动到一个连接地点。 - ……[combat]，对该敌人造成2点伤害。
real_text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and any number of skills. One at a time, in any order, test each chosen skill (2). For each test you succeeded, if it was... - ...[willpower], remove 1 doom from that enemy. - ...[intellect], discover 1 clue at that enemy's location. - ...[agility], automatically evade that enemy. Move it to a connecting location if it is non-[[Elite]]. - ...[combat], deal 2 damage to that enemy.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 假证
text: [action]选择你所在地点的一个敌人：谈判。检定 [intellect](0)。假证上每有1疑点，本次检定难度+1。如果你检定成功，发现你所在地点或连接地点的1个线索，如果你检定成功但没有超过难度至少2点，在假证上放置1资源，作为疑点。如果你检定失败，将假证返回你的手牌。
real_text: [action] Choose an enemy at your location: Parley. Test [intellect](0). This test gets +1 difficulty for each suspicion on Fake Credentials. If you succeed, discover 1 clue at your location or a connecting location. If you did not succeed by 2 or more, place 1 resource on Fake Credentials, as suspicion. If you fail, return Fake Credentials to your hand.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 把水搅浑
text: 谈判。选择你所在地点的一个敌人并检定 [intellect](X)，其中X为所选敌人的伤害值与恐惧值之和。如果你检定成功，对你所在地点的每个敌人造成X点伤害。本效果结算后，你可以与每个敌人解除交战并移动到一个连接地点。
real_text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and test [intellect] (X), where X is the chosen enemy's combined damage/horror values. If you succeed, deal X damage to each enemy at your location. After this effect resolves, you may disengage from each enemy and move to a connecting location.
flavor: “……我还听到他叫你傻瓜！”
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 猫面具
text:
每位调查员仅限1张[[面具]]。

pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

name: 缥缈灵体

real_text: Evade. Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If you succeed, disengage from each other enemy engaged with you, and for the remainder of the round, you are ethereal (enemies cannot engage or be engaged with you, and you cannot attack or deal damage to enemies). If a symbol was revealed during this evasion attempt, return Ethereal Form to your hand at the end of your turn.
pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

pack_name: 毒堇谷盛宴调查员扩充

[fast] If there are more [curse] than [bless] tokens in the chaos bag, remove 1 [curse] token from the chaos bag and exhaust The Key of Solomon: Gain 2 resources.

name: 上古封印

Fast. Play after a skill test at your location ends in which at least 2 [curse] tokens or 2 [bless] tokens were revealed.

If 2 [bless] tokens were revealed, search your bonded cards for Keeper of the Key and put it into play. If 2 [curse] tokens and 2 [bless] tokens were revealed, do both instead. Remove Seal of the Elders from the game.

real_text: Bonded (Seal of the Elders). [reaction] When a [curse] token is revealed during a skill test at your location: Deal 1 damage to Servant of Brass and 2 damage to an enemy at your location or a connecting location. Forced - When Servant of Brass would leave play: Set it aside, out of play.

You may commit Long Shot to a fight or evasion test against an enemy at your location or a connecting location.

back_text: 牌库卡牌张数：30。 [[特性]]选择：当构建牌库时，选择下列一个特性：[[幸运]]、[[局势]]或[[临时制品]]。 牌库构建选项：守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，你所选[[特性]]的事件等级0-2，其他求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0最多5张。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：2张矢志不移、“我自己来”、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 父亲死后，玛利翁就从纳拉甘西特湾搬到了阿卡姆。她和朋友安娜丽丝·泰勒一同买了条船，两个人就在城里的渔业社区安下了新家。在一个海上的风暴之夜，安娜丽丝被奇怪的类鱼生物拖下了船。玛利翁跳进水里，把安娜丽丝拉出怪物的巨口——这也让玛利翁失去了右手。打那时起，她就时刻警惕大西洋的波涛，还有底下深处隐藏的古怪生物。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Trait Choice: At deck creation, choose one of the following traits: [[Fortune]], [[Gambit]], or [[Improvised]]. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, events with your chosen [[Trait]] level 0-2, up to 5 other level 0 Survivor cards ([survivor]). Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Two copies of Determined, "I'll do it myself," 1 random basic weakness.

back_flavor: 身为南方移民的卢修斯在纽约长大，他笔下的诗句如梦如幻，在哈莱姆的知识分子、艺术家和音乐人中颇有名气。但同侪们不知道，卢修斯笔下朦胧的水底城市，并非取材于纽约，而是他失踪的伴侣鲁迪的梦魇。鲁迪失踪前，提到过阿卡姆还有一伙梦中人也见过同样不安的幻象。现在，卢修斯一边在米大担任客座讲师，一边寻找自己失去的爱人，或许还有他那些可怕梦境的源头……

back_flavor: 手捏数学和心理学两门学位的阿加莎·克雷恩，向来重视循证科学。她年轻的时候就不爱听鬼故事，但证据越来越多，让阿加莎得出结论：阿卡姆历史上比比皆是的怪物和魔法传说背后，一定藏着什么确凿无疑的真相。如果这些都是真的，那肯定也遵循着一样的法则。她把这片全新领域的研究解释给任何愿意听下去的人——她的丈夫威尔伯就听过很多次——她称之为“通灵学”。阿加莎期望通过实践出真知的科学方法，弥合神话与理性、玄学与科学之间的鸿沟。

back_flavor: 迈克尔·麦克格林话不多。他也不需要多说，“快手”路易更擅长说话。这俩人是欧巴尼恩最好的打手，确保帮派在整个阿卡姆都大名鼎鼎……直到那天晚上，河里的东西把路易拖了下去，在水下撕成了碎片。迈克尔本以为，要是他把事情告诉老板，他们肯定会觉得他是疯了。但事实更糟：他们不仅相信，还让他别声张。但迈克尔不会让自己的伙伴白死，也不会放过他那晚看到的东西。他还是话不多。现在他会让他的枪说话。

[reaction]你技能检定成功且超过难度正好3点后：在奥顿·欧康纳上放置1资源，作为证据。
[free]横置奥顿·欧康纳并花费X证据：发现你所在地点的1个线索。X为你所在地点的隐藏值。
real_text:
You get +1 [agility].
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by exactly 3: Place 1 resource on Alton O'Connell, as evidence.
[fast] Exhaust Alton O'Connell and spend X evidence: Discover 1 clue at your location. X is the shroud value of your location.
traits: 盟友. 侦探. 记者

name: 艺术灵感
text:
每位调查员仅限1张。使用(1灵感)。
[free]横置艺术灵感并弃掉你1张手牌：补满本卡牌上的1灵感。
[reaction]你正在执行的技能检定期间揭示混乱标记后，花费1灵感：你本次技能检定得到技能值+1或-1。
real_text:
Limit 1 per investigator. Uses (1 inspiration).
[fast] Exhaust Artistic Inspiration and discard 1 card from your hand: Replenish 1 inspiration on this card.
[reaction] After revealing chaos tokens for a skill test you are performing, spend 1 inspiration: You get +1 or -1 skill value for this skill test.

name: 远古表盘
text:
每套牌库仅限1张。使用(0充能)。
[reaction]你所在地点的敌人被躲避后：在远古钟面上放置1充能。然后，如果远古钟面有4个或更多充能，在剧本日志里记录“你计算出了清算之日”。
real_text:
Limit 1 per deck. Uses (0 charges).
[reaction] After an enemy at your location is evaded: Place 1 charge on Dial of Ancients. Then, if there are 4 or more charges on Dial of Ancients, record in your campaign log that "you have calculated the day of reckoning."
traits: 道具. 遗物. 诅咒萦绕

name: 法医工具
text: 使用(4补给)。 [action]花费1补给：调查。本次调查你可以不使用[intellect]，改为使用[agility]，且你得到技能值+1。如果你检定成功且你所在地点有已横置的敌人，治愈1点恐惧。
real_text: Uses (4 supplies). [action] Spend 1 supply: Investigate. For this investigation, you may use [agility] instead of [intellect], and you get +1 skill value. If you succeed and there is an exhausted enemy at your location, heal 1 horror.
traits: 道具. 工具. 科学

name: 臼与杵
text:
使用(0资源)。
研钵捣杵上的资源可以被花费用来支付[[法术]]卡牌。
[reaction]你发现线索后，横置研钵捣杵：在其上放置1资源(从供应堆拿取)。
real_text: Uses (0 resources). Resources on Mortar and Pestle may be spent to pay for [[Spell]] cards. [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues, exhaust Mortar and Pestle: Place 1 resource on it (from the token pool).
traits: 道具. 工具. 科学

name: 死亡之眼
text:
使用(0证据)。
[reaction]你封印、取消，或忽略混乱标记后，横置亡者瞳眸：在其上放置1证据。
[reaction]在敌人攻击你所在地点的调查员时，花费1证据并横置亡者瞳眸：发现你所在地点的1个线索。如果该敌人有[[灵怪]]特性，对它造成1点伤害。
real_text:
Uses (0 evidence).
[reaction] After you seal, cancel, or ignore a chaos token, exhaust Oculus Mortuum: Place 1 evidence on it.
[reaction] When an enemy attacks an investigator at your location, spend 1 evidence and exhaust Oculus Mortuum: Discover 1 clue at your location. If that enemy has the [[Geist]] trait, deal 1 damage to it.
traits: 道具. 工具. 密教

name: 诡异样本
text:
多重。快速。
最多3张诡异样本卡牌共占1个法术槽位。
[reaction]在你所在地点的技能检定期间揭示[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]符号时，弃掉诡异样本：取消该混乱标记，将其放回混乱袋，并揭示一个新标记。如果本次检定成功，抽取1卡牌。
real_text:
Myriad. Fast.
Up to 3 Uncanny Specimen cards take up 1 arcane slot.
[reaction] When a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbol is revealed during a skill test at your location, discard Uncanny Specimen: Cancel that chaos token, return it to the chaos bag, and reveal a new one. If this test is successful, draw 1 card.

name: 融会贯通
text: 调查。你可以取消本次技能检定揭示的第一个混乱标记，将其放回混乱袋，并揭示一个新标记。如果你本次技能检定成功，在你所在地点调查员控制的一张支援上放置1充能或秘密(如果你检定成功且超过难度正好1点或3点，改为在该支援上放置2充能或秘密)。
real_text: Investigate. You may cancel the first chaos token revealed for this skill test, return it to the bag, and reveal a new one. If you succeed at this skill test, place 1 charge or secret on an asset controlled by an investigator at your location (if you succeed by exactly 1 or 3, place 2 charges or secrets on that asset instead).

name: 宇宙显现
text: 选择“偶数”或“奇数”。 每位调查员揭示其手中每张费用与所选选项相符的非弱点卡牌。按玩家顺序，每位调查员可以选择从自己牌库抽取1张卡牌，或打出1张自己揭示的手牌(支付其费用)。
real_text: Choose "even" or "odd". Each investigator reveals each non-weakness card in their hand with a cost matching the chosen option. In player order, each investigator may choose to either draw 1 card from their deck, or play 1 card they revealed from their hand (paying its cost).

name: 机敏
text:
多重。
你的弃牌堆没有一张其他的灵光一现，灵光一现获得[intellect][agility]。
本次技能检定结束后，你可以将你弃牌堆的每张其他的灵光一现混洗入你的牌库。
real_text:
Myriad.
Quick-Witted gains [intellect] [agility] for each other copy of Quick-Witted in your discard pile.
After this skill test ends, you may shuffle each other copy of Quick-Witted in your discard pile into your deck.

name: 误导
text:
每位调查员仅限1张。封印(+1或0)。你发现你所在地点的最后一个线索后，你可以再次结算本关键词。
[reaction]在一个敌人攻击你所在地点的一位调查员时，横置盖以诱敌并释放一个封印在此的混乱标记：取消该次攻击。然后，该调查员可以移动到一个连接地点。
real_text:
Limit 1 per investigator. Seal (+1 or 0). You may resolve this keyword again after you discover the last clue at your location.
[reaction] When an enemy attacks an investigator at your location, exhaust Misdirection and release a token sealed here: Cancel that attack. Then, that investigator may move to a connecting location.

name: 科研补助
text:
每位调查员仅限1张。
你拥有额外2个手部槽位，只可以用来携带[[科学]]和/或[[工具]]支援。
real_text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
You have 2 additional hand slots, which may only be used to hold [[Science]] and/or [[Tool]] assets.

name: 专业的直觉
text:
快速。只能在你的回合期间打出。
发现任意已揭示地点的1个线索。
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Discover 1 clue from any revealed location.

name: 远古表盘
text: 研究完成。每套牌库仅限1张。使用(4充能)。 [reaction]有调查员在你的地点技能检定失败时，横置远古钟面：将1个该次检定期间揭示的混乱标记封印在远古钟面上。 强制 - 在一轮结束时：此处每封印一个混乱标记，你必须花费1充能或释放该标记。
real_text: Researched. Limit 1 per deck. Uses (4 charges). [reaction] When an investigator fails a skill test at your location, exhaust Dial of Ancients: Seal 1 chaos token revealed during that test on Dial of Ancients. Forced - When the round ends: For each chaos token sealed here, you must spend 1 charge or release that token.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 诅咒萦绕

name: 远古表盘
text: 研究完成。每套牌库仅限1张。使用(4充能)。 [action]攻击/躲避。在你于本次攻击或躲避尝试期间揭示混乱标记时，你可以花费1充能以取消该混乱标记，将其放回混乱袋，并揭示一个新标记。你可以执行任意次数。如果本次检定成功，对成为目标的敌人造成1点伤害。
real_text: Researched. Limit 1 per deck. Uses (4 charges). [action]: Fight/Evade. When you reveal a chaos token during this attack or evasion attempt, you may spend 1 charge to cancel that token, return it to the bag, and reveal a new one. You may do this any number of times. If this test succeeds, deal 1 damage to the targeted enemy.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 诅咒萦绕

name: 远古表盘
text: 研究完成。每套牌库仅限1张。使用(4充能)。 [free]你回合期间，横置远古钟面并花费1充能：调查。在本次检定揭示混乱标记时，揭示额外X个标记，其中X为你所在地点的敌人数量。选择1个揭示的标记结算，并忽略其余标记。
real_text: Researched. Limit 1 per deck. Uses (4 charges). [fast] During your turn, exhaust Dial of Ancients and spend 1 charge: Investigate. When revealing chaos tokens for this test, reveal X additional tokens, where X is the number of enemies at your location. Choose 1 of the revealed tokens to resolve and ignore the rest.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 诅咒萦绕

name: 安提基特拉
text:
你技能检定成功后，横置安提基特拉机械：如果你检定成功且……
- ……超过难度正好1点或3点，发现你所在地点的1个线索。
- ……超过难度正好2点或4点，抽取1张卡牌并获得1资源。
- ……超过难度正好5点，你可以在你下个回合期间进行额外一次行动。
real_text:
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test, exhaust Antikythera: If you succeeded by...
-...exactly 1 or 3, discover 1 clue at your location.
-...exactly 2 or 4, draw 1 card and gain 1 resource.
-...exactly 5, you may take an additional action during your next turn.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 科学

name: 鲁格P08手枪
text: 使用(2子弹)。 [free]横置鲁格P08手枪并花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+1[combat]。 [action]花费1资源：补满鲁格P08手枪上的所有子弹并将其重整。
real_text: Uses (2 ammo). [fast] Exhaust Luger P08 and spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. [action] Spend 1 resource: Replenish all ammo on Luger P08 and ready it.
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法

name: 罗伯特·卡斯塔涅
text:
你得到+1[combat]。
[action]弃掉你手牌中一张至多占用1个手部槽位的[[枪械]]支援并横置罗伯特·卡斯泰根：结算弃掉的支援上的一个攻击能力，忽略所有费用。这不会触发趁乱攻击。
real_text: You get +1 [combat]. [action] Discard a [[Firearm]] asset that takes up 1 or fewer hand slots from your hand and exhaust Robert Castaigne: Resolve a Fight ability on the discarded asset, ignoring all costs. This does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: 戏弄
text: [reaction]在你尝试躲避敌人时，横置虚晃一枪：你本次躲避尝试得到技能值+1且该敌人获得警戒。如果你检定成功，抽取1张卡牌且不与该敌人解除交战。
real_text: [reaction] When you attempt to evade an enemy, exhaust String Along: For this evasion attempt, you get +1 skill value and that enemy gains alert. If you succeed, draw 1 card and do not disengage from that enemy.

name: "同党在哪儿？"
text: 谈判。查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一个非[[精英]]敌人并将其以横置状态生成，与你交战。抽取卡牌，数量等于该敌人的伤害值与恐惧值之和。
real_text: Parley. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a non-[[Elite]] enemy and spawn it exhausted and engaged with you. Draw cards equal to that enemy's combined damage and horror values.

name: “你见过更糟的……”
text:
快速。在你所在地点或连接地点的调查员受到伤害和/或恐惧时打出。
该调查员可以花费最多3资源。每花费1点资源，该调查员取消1点受到的伤害或恐惧。
real_text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location or a connecting location is dealt damage and/or horror.
That investigator may spend up to 3 resources. For each resource spent, that investigator cancels 1 damage or 1 horror just dealt.

name: 轰走
text: 躲避。本次躲避尝试将你的[combat]值加入你的技能值。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，对该敌人造成1点伤害。如果该敌人非[[精英]]，你可以将其移动到一个连接地点。
real_text: Evade. Add your [combat] value to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If you succeed by 2 or more, deal that enemy 1 damage. If that enemy is non-[[Elite]], you may move it to a connecting location.

name: 恐吓
text: 谈判。你选择你所在地点的一个敌人并检定[combat](X)，其中X为所选敌人剩余的生命值。如果你检定成功，将该敌人混洗入遭遇牌库(如果它是[[精英]]，改为对它造成2点伤害)。
real_text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and test [combat] (X), where X is the chosen enemy's remaining health. If you succeed, shuffle that enemy into the encounter deck (or deal 2 damage to it instead if it is [[Elite]]).
flavor: “你走错地盘了，孩子。”

name: 百发百中
text: 只能投入到你控制的[[枪械]]或[[远程]]支援上印刷能力的技能检定。
real_text: Commit only to a skill test from an ability printed on a [[Firearm]] or [[Ranged]] asset you control.

name: 二重身
text:
多重。快速。只能在你的回合期间打出。
附属到你所在地点。每个地点仅限1张。
[reaction]敌人进入或离开所附属的地点后，将二重身返回你的手牌：对该敌人执行一次躲避尝试，或立即移动到附属地点(你可以从任何地点触发本能力)。
real_text: Myriad. Fast. Play only during your turn. Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location. [reaction] After an enemy enters or leaves attached location, return Doppelgänger to your hand: Either perform an evasion attempt against that enemy, or immediately move to attached location (you may trigger this ability from any location).

name: 帮派人脉
text:
卓越。
[action]花费2资源：抽取附属到黑道人脉的卡牌。
[reaction]在你控制的[[违法]]支援从场上被弃置时，横置黑道人脉：将该支援正面朝下附属到本卡牌。附属的支援仅限1张。
real_text:
Exceptional.
[action] Spend 2 resources: Draw the card attached to Mob Connections.
[reaction] When an [[Illicit]] asset you control is discarded from play, exhaust Mob Connections: Attach that asset to this card, facedown. Limit 1 attached asset.

name: 模糊
text: 每位调查员仅限1张。 封印(0)。你揭示地点或放置新的地点入场后，你可以再次结算本关键词。 [reaction]在你与敌人交战时，横置变幻莫测并释放一个封印在此的标记：立即攻击或躲避该敌人。本次技能检定期间，你的基础技能值等于你所在地点的隐藏值。
real_text: Limit 1 per investigator. Seal (0). You may resolve this keyword again after you reveal a location or put a new location into play. [reaction] When you engage an enemy, exhaust Obscure and release a token sealed here: Immediately Fight or Evade that enemy. During this skill test, your base skill value is equal to the shroud value of your location.

name: “吃我一招！”
text:
只能投入你正在执行的技能检定。作为将“吃我一招！”投入技能检定的额外费用，花费最多3资源。
如果你检定成功且超过难度至少1点，获得两倍数量的该资源。
real_text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing. As an additional cost to commit "Watch this!" to a skill test, spend up to 3 resources.
If you succeed by 1 or more, gain twice that many resources.
flavor: 你还是在炫耀。

name: 罗伯特·卡斯塔涅
text: 你得到+1[combat]。 [free]横置罗伯特·卡斯泰根：攻击。揭示你手中一张至多占用1个手部槽位的[[枪械]]支援。结算揭示支援上的一个攻击能力，忽略所有费用。然后，你可以弃掉揭示的支援以抽取1张卡牌，或打出该支援(支付其费用)。
real_text: You get +1 [combat]. [fast] Exhaust Robert Castaigne: Fight. Reveal a [[Firearm]] asset that takes up 1 or fewer hand slots from your hand. Resolve a Fight ability on the revealed asset, ignoring all costs. Then, you may either discard the revealed asset to draw 1 card, or play that asset (paying its cost).

name: “你见过更糟的……”
text:
快速。在你所在地点或连接地点的调查员受到伤害和/或恐惧时打出。
该调查员可以给你最多5资源。每以此 效果给出1资源，该调查员取消1点受到的伤害或恐惧。
real_text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location or a connecting location is dealt damage and/or horror.
That investigator may give you up to 5 resources. For each resource given by this effect, that investigator cancels 1 damage or 1 horror just dealt.

name: 加特林机枪
text: 使用(12子弹)。 [action]花费1-6子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+X[combat]。本次攻击的难度等于你所在地点的所有敌人攻击值之和。本次攻击不造成标准伤害，改为造成X点伤害，由你选择在你所在地点的敌人间分配。X为作为本能力的费用花费的子弹数量。
real_text: Uses (12 ammo). [action] Spend 1-6 ammo: Fight. You get +X [combat] for this attack. The difficulty for this attack is equal to the combined fight values of all enemies at your location. Instead of its standard damage, this attack deals X damage divided as you choose among enemies at your location. X is the amount of ammo spent as part of this ability's cost.
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法

name: 托特之血
text:
[reaction]在毁灭标记放置到你控制的卡牌上时，横置透特之血：在本卡牌上放置1资源(从供应堆拿取)，作为贡品。
[free]如果透特之血上有3个或更多贡品，移除透特之血上所有的贡品并将其横置：选择你所在地点的一位调查员立即进行一次行动，如同是自己回合。
real_text: [reaction] When 1 or more doom is placed on a card you control, exhaust Blood of Thoth: Place 1 resource on this card (from the token pool), as an offering. [fast] If Blood of Thoth has 3 or more offerings on it, remove all offerings from Blood of Thoth and exhaust it: Choose an investigator at your location to immediately take an action as if it were their turn.

name: 沉睡者的吐息
text: 使用(9充能)。 [action]：攻击。本次检定不使用你的[combat]，改为使用你的[willpower]。本次检定揭示混乱标记前，你可以花费至多3充能，以额外揭示同等数量的混乱标记。选择1个揭示的标记结算，并忽略其余标记。如果你检定成功，且所选要结算的标记和任一忽略的标记一致，本次攻击造成+2伤害。
real_text: Uses (9 charges). [action]: Fight. Use your [willpower] instead of your [combat] for this test. Before revealing chaos tokens for this test, you may spend up to 3 charges to reveal that many additional chaos tokens. Choose 1 of the revealed tokens to resolve and ignore the rest. If you succeed and the chosen token matches an ignored token, this attack deals +2 damage.

name: 入梦者的眼睛
text: 使用(9充能)。 [action]：调查。本次检定不使用你的[intellect]，改为使用你的[willpower]。本次检定揭示混乱标记前，你可以花费至多3充能，以额外揭示同等数量的混乱标记。选择1个揭示的标记结算，并忽略其余标记。如果你检定成功，且所选要结算的标记和任一忽略的标记一致，发现你所在地点额外1个线索。
real_text: Uses (9 charges). [action]: Investigate. Use your [willpower] instead of your [intellect] for this test. Before revealing chaos tokens for this test, you may spend up to 3 charges to reveal that many additional chaos tokens. Choose 1 of the revealed tokens to resolve and ignore the rest. If you succeed and the chosen token matches an ignored token, discover 1 additional clue at your location.

name: 伟大之作
text:
永久。每套牌库仅限1张。仅当构建牌库时购买。
本剧本的每场冒险后，你取得额外1点经验值。如果你被击败，你被人造人夺舍了(将你牌库中的每张署名卡牌替换为1张随机基础弱点，将本卡牌翻面并在本剧本的剩余时间内替代你的调查员)。
real_text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase only at deck creation.
You earn 1 additional experience after each scenario of this campaign. If you are defeated, you are usurped by the homunculus (replace each signature card in your deck with a random basic weakness, flip this card, and swap it with your investigator for the remainder of the campaign).

name: 失魂的人造人
text: 不能被选为起始调查员。 你不能从你的牌库加入、移除和升级卡牌。 你结算[[法术]]卡牌上的能力时得到技能值+2。 强制 - 在你被击败时：你阵亡。 [elder_sign]效果：+0。抽取1张卡牌。
real_text: Cannot be chosen as a starting investigator. You cannot add, remove, or upgrade cards from your deck. You get +2 skill value while resolving abilities on [[Spell]] cards. Forced - When you are defeated: You are killed. [elder_sign] effect: +0. Draw 1 card.
flavor: 你一直想当个人。

name: 卡塔琳娜·索伊卡

Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, the performing investigator draws 1 card.

real_text: Max 1 committed per skill test.

永久。
你拥有额外1个盟友槽位。
real_text:
Permanent.
You have 1 additional ally slot.
flavor: 魅力光芒万丈，全城为之闪亮。

name: 宝物猎人
text:
永久。
你拥有额外1个饰品槽位。
real_text:
Permanent.
You have 1 additional accessory slot.
flavor:
翻石破砖苦，殚精竭虑忙。
旧宝传千古，妙手一扫光。

real_text: Revelation - Choose and discard all but 1 card from your hand.
flavor: 等等……我在哪？我在干吗？

name: 金甲虫
text: 显现 - 将[金甲虫]放置入场，位于你的威胁区域。除非通过以下[action]能力，否则它不能离场。 你得到生命值-1和神智值-1。 [action]：将[金甲虫]混洗入你的牌库。
real_text: Revelation - Put The Gold Bug into play in your threat area. It cannot leave play except by the [action] ability below. You get -1 health and -1 sanity. [action]: Shuffle the Gold Bug into your deck.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 炼金. 诅咒萦绕.

name: 无名潜伏者
text: 冷漠。 生成 - 最远的无人地点。 强制 - 在调查阶段结束时：如果[无名潜伏者]处于重整状态且其上没有毁灭标记：在其上放置1个毁灭标记。
real_text: Aloof. Spawn - Farthest empty location. Forced - When the investigation phase ends, if The Nameless Lurker is ready and has no doom on it: Place 1 doom on it.

name: 头脑发热
text: 显现 - 抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。该卡牌获得涌动。
real_text: Revelation - Draw the top card of the encounter deck. That card gains surge.
flavor: “是时候做个英雄了！”

name: 妄想症
text: 显现 - 失去你的全部资源。
real_text: Revelation - Lose all of your resources.
flavor: 那是什么声音？

name: 后有追兵
text: 显现 - 将[后有追兵]放置入场，位于你的威胁区域。 强制 - 敌人进入你的地点后(移动进入或生成在你的地点)：受到1点恐惧。 [action][action]：弃掉[后有追兵]。
real_text: Revelation - Put Pursued into play in your threat area. Forced - After an enemy enters (moves into or spawns at) your location: Take 1 horror. [action][action]: Discard Pursued.

name: 组织重担
text: 显现 - 将[组织重担]放置入场，位于你的威胁区域。 强制 - 你花费资源后：受到1点伤害。 [action][action]：弃掉[组织重担]。
real_text: Revelation - Put Syndicate Obligations into play in your threat area. Forced - After you spend 1 or more resources: Take 1 damage. [action][action]: Discard Syndicate Obligations.

name: 受伤
text: 显现 - 将[受伤]放置入场，位于你的威胁区域。 强制 - 你每回合第一次移动：受到1点伤害。 [action][action]：弃掉[受伤]。
real_text: Revelation - Put Wounded into play in your threat area. Forced - The first time you move each turn: Take 1 damage. [action][action]: Discard Wounded.

name: 体能训练
text:
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[combat]。

real_text: Choose either your location or a connecting location. Deal 3 damage to each enemy and to each investigator at the chosen location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: 超感知
text:
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[intellect]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility]。

[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test.

text: 附属到你所在地点。 非[[精英]]敌人不能移动进入或生成在附属地点。非[[精英]]敌人生成在附属地点时，改为将其生成在一个连接地点。 强制 - 在一位调查员离开附属地点时：弃掉屏障。
real_text: Attach to your location. Non-[[Elite]] enemies cannot move into or spawn at attached location. Each time a non-[[Elite]] enemy would spawn at attached location, spawn it at a connecting location instead, if able. Forced - When an investigator leaves attached location: Discard Barricade.

name: 沉重打击

[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[combat]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility]。
real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.

text: 获得10资源。

flavor: “我又赢咯！抱歉，甜心，你只是今晚运气有点差。”

[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower]。

real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test.

text:

real_text:
Fast. Play after a phase begins.
Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy in your location. Until the end of the phase, reduce the chosen enemy's damage and horror values by 1, and treat its printed text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]).

name: 深挖
text:
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility]。
real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.

name: 幸运兔脚
text: [reaction]在你技能检定失败后，横置幸运兔脚：查找你牌库顶X张卡牌，找出一张将其抽取，并将剩余卡牌洗入你的牌库。X为你检定失败且低于难度的点数。
real_text: [reaction] After you fail a skill test, exhaust Rabbit's Foot: Search the top X cards of your deck for a card, draw it, and shuffle the remaining cards into your deck. X is the amount you failed by.
flavor: 他们说这能给我带来好运。我本来不信。但现在我觉得，要是丢了它，我可真要倒霉了

name: 子弹带
text:
你拥有额外2个手部槽位，只可以用来携带[[武器]]支援。
如果你的[[武器]]支援总计占用至少2个手部槽位，你得到+1[willpower]。
real_text:
You have two additional hand slots, which can only be used to hold [[Weapon]] assets.
While you have [[Weapon]] assets held in 2 or more hand slots, you get +1 [willpower].

name: 金属棍棒
text: [action]：攻击。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]。如果你对与另一位调查员交战的敌人执行本次攻击，且你检定成功，本次攻击造成+1伤害。如果你检定失败，则你不造成伤害。
real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If you perform this attack against an enemy engaged with another investigator, you deal +1 damage for this attack if you succeed, and no damage if you fail.
traits: 道具. 武器. 近战

name: 荒唐的素描像
text:
你的地点有线索才能打出。
抽取3张卡牌。
real_text:
Play only if there is a clue on your location.
Draw 3 cards.

name: 奇怪的溶液
text:
研究完成。使用(3补给)。
[action]花费1补给并横置奇怪的溶液：选择你所在地点的一位调查员获得2资源并抽取1张卡牌。
real_text:
Researched. Uses (3 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply and exhaust Strange Solution: Choose an investigator at your location to gain 2 resources and draw 1 card.

name: 走私品
text:
选择你所在地点一位调查员控制的一个支援并选择一项：
- 在该支援上放置2子弹或补给并抽取1张卡牌。
- 将该支援上的子弹或补给标记数量翻倍。
real_text:
Choose an asset controlled by an investigator at your location. Either (choose one):
- Place 2 ammo or supply tokens on that asset and draw 1 card.
- Double the number of ammo or supply tokens on that asset.
flavor: 这可能并不合法，但却能办成事。

name: 逃跑本能
text:
快速。在一个敌人将要进入你的地点时打出。
立刻移动到一个连接地点。(该敌人依然进入你先前地点。)
real_text:
Fast. Play when an enemy enters your location.
Immediately move to a connecting location. (The enemy still enters your previous location.)

name: 礼寻术
text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]花费1充能：调查。本次调查不使用[intellect]，改为使用[willpower]。你本次检定得到+2[willpower]。如果检定成功，你发现所在地点额外1个线索。如果本次检定期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，本次检定结算后，失去所有剩余的行动，立即结束你的回合。
real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using [willpower] instead of [intellect]. You get +2 [willpower] for this test. If you succeed you discover 1 additional clue at this location. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this test, after this test resolves lose all remaining actions and immediately end your turn.

name: 净心术
text:
使用(4充能)。
[action]花费1充能：治愈你所在地点的调查员总计2点恐惧。
real_text:
Uses (4 charges).
[action] Spend 1 charge: Heal 2 horror from among investigators at your location.
flavor:
虚幻带来现实
黑暗带来光明
死亡带来永恒

name: 哎呀！
text:
快速。在你攻击一个敌人时技能检定失败，并且低于难度3点及以内后打出。
对你所在地点的任意一个敌人造成本次攻击的伤害。如果你对与另一位调查员交战的敌人执行本次攻击，本次攻击不对该调查员造成伤害。
real_text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 3 or less while attacking an enemy.
Deal this attack's damage to any enemy at your location. If the attacked enemy is engaged with another investigator, this attack deals no damage to that investigator.

name: 随机应变
text:
只能投入你正在执行，且难度高于你基础技能值的技能检定。
随机应变得到+X[wild]。X为本次检定难度和你基础技能值的差值(最多+3[wild])。
real_text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing, and only if the difficulty of that test is higher than your base skill value.
Rise to the Occasion gets +X [wild] icons, where X is the difference between your base skill and this test's difficulty (to a maximum of +3 [wild] icons).

name: 穿越门扉
text: 显现 - 抽取你牌库顶的牌。如果该卡牌不是弱点，将其从游戏中移除。然后，查找你的牌库、弃牌堆、手牌和所有游戏区域，找到所有你拥有的同名卡牌，将这些卡牌也从游戏中移除。
real_text: Revelation - Draw the top card of your deck. If it is not a weakness, remove that card from the game. Then, search your deck, discard pile, hand, and all play areas for each other copy of that card you own, and remove them from the game, as well.

name: .32柯尔特手枪
text: 使用(6子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击造成+1伤害。 [free]花费1资源：将.32柯尔特手枪返回你的手牌。
real_text: Uses (6 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You deal +1 damage for this attack. [fast] Spend 1 resource: Return .32 Colt to your hand.
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械

name: “吃枪子吧！”
text: 快速。在你激活[[枪械]]支援上的攻击能力时打出。 你可以花费该支援上的额外1子弹标记。在你为本次攻击揭示混乱标记时，额外揭示1个混乱标记。选择其中一个结算并忽略其余标记。
real_text: Fast. Play when you activate the Fight ability on a [[Firearm]] asset. Spend 1 additional ammo token from that asset. When you reveal chaos tokens for this attack, reveal 1 additional chaos token. Choose one to resolve and ignore the other.

name: 逻辑推理
text: 你每有1个线索(最多3个)，治愈你所在地点的一位调查员2点恐惧或弃掉你所在地点的一张[[恐怖]]卡牌。
real_text: For each clue you have (to a maximum of 3), either heal 2 horror from an investigator at your location or discard a [[Terror]] card at your location.
flavor: “我是活着的最智慧的人，因为我知道一件事，那就是我知道我一无所知。”<cite>——柏拉图，《理想国》</cite>

name: 古代雕文
text: 研究完成。(FAQ v2.0)使用(3充能)。 [action]花费1充能：调查。如果你检定成功，你可以将手牌中一张印刷资源费用不高于X的支援放置入场。其中X为你检定成功且超过难度的点数。
real_text: Researched. Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. If you succeed, you may put an asset with printed cost of X or lower into play from your hand. X is the amount you succeeded by.

name: 潜行
text: [free]在你回合期间，横置潜行：躲避。所选敌人本次躲避尝试得到-2躲避。如果你成功躲避该敌人，与它解除交战但不要横置它。直到你回合结束，该敌人不能与你交战。
real_text: [fast] During your turn, exhaust Stealth: Evade. The chosen enemy gets -2 evade for this evasion attempt. If you successfully evade the enemy, disengage with it but do not exhaust it. Until the end of your turn, that enemy cannot engage you.

name: 建议
text: 使用(3充能)。如果建议没有充能，将其弃掉。 [action]横置建议：躲避。本次躲避尝试将你的[willpower]值加入你的技能值。如果你未超过难度至少2点并成功，从建议移除1充能。
real_text: Uses (3 charges). If Suggestion has no charges, discard it. [action] Exhaust Suggestion: Evade. Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If you do not succeed by at least 2, remove 1 charge from Suggestion.

name: 炼金转化
text:
使用(4充能)。
[action]横置炼金转化，花费1充能：检定[willpower](0)。你检定成功且每超过难度1点，获得1资源(最多4个)。如果本次检定期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，受到1点伤害。
real_text:
Uses (4 charges).
[action] Exhaust Alchemical Transmutation, spend 1 charge: Test [willpower] (0). For each point you succeed by, gain 1 resource (to a maximum of 4). If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this test, take 1 damage.

name: 灵力风暴
text: 攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。本次攻击你得到+2[willpower]。如果你检定成功，本次攻击不造成标准伤害，改为对受攻击敌人所在地点的每个敌人造成3点伤害(所有额外伤害只对被攻击敌人造成)。如果本次攻击期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，对受攻击敌人所在地点的每位调查员造成2点伤害。(FAQ v2.0)
real_text: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. You get +2 [willpower] for this attack. If you succeed, instead of its standard damage, this attack deals 3 damage to each enemy at the attacked enemy's location (any additional damage is dealt to the attacked enemy). If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] token is revealed during this attack, deal 2 damage to each investigator at the attacked enemy's location.

name: 提灯
text: [action]：调查。本次调查你所在地点的隐藏值-1。 [action]弃掉提灯：对你所在地点的一个敌人造成1点伤害(或将提灯从游戏中移除，改为造成2点伤害)。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
real_text: [action]: Investigate. Your location gets -1 shroud for this investigation. [action] Discard Lantern: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location (or remove Lantern from the game to deal 2 damage, instead). This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: 挖墓人的铲子
text: [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。 [action]弃掉挖墓人的铲子：发现你所在地点的1个线索(或将挖墓人的铲子从游戏中移除，改为发现2个线索)。
real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. [action] Discard Gravedigger's Shovel: Discover 1 clue at your location (or remove Gravedigger's Shovel from the game to discover 2 clues, instead).
traits: 道具. 工具. 武器. 近战
flavor: 我知道我不应该再挖了，但我就是停不下来。

name: 邪秽誓约(嗜血)
text: 剧本模式专用。险境。隐私。 显现 - 将本卡牌秘密加入你的手牌。 强制 - 在游戏结束或你退场时，如果本卡牌在你手牌中：你本场冒险少取得2点经验值。 [reaction]当你对一个敌人造成过量伤害将其击败时：从你手牌中弃掉本卡牌。
real_text: Campaign Mode only. Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. Forced - When the game ends or you are eliminated, if this card is in your hand: You earn 2 fewer experience. [reaction] When you deal damage to an enemy in excess of its remaining health: Discard this card from your hand.

name: 邪秽誓约(好奇)
text: 剧本模式专用。险境。隐私。 显现 - 将本卡牌秘密加入你的手牌。 强制 - 在游戏结束或你退场时，如果本卡牌在你手牌中：你本场冒险少取得2点经验值。 [reaction]你成功调查了一个没有线索的地点后：从你手牌中弃掉本卡牌。
real_text: Campaign Mode only. Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. Forced - When the game ends or you are eliminated, if this card is in your hand: You earn 2 fewer experience. [reaction] After you successfully investigate a location with no clues on it: Discard this card from your hand.

name: 邪秽誓约(胆怯)
text: 剧本模式专用。险境。隐私。 显现 - 将本卡牌秘密加入你的手牌。 强制 - 在游戏结束或你退场时，如果本卡牌在你手牌中：你本场冒险少取得2点经验值。 [action]：躲避。只能对你所在地点的一个横置且未交战的敌人执行。如果你检定成功，从你手牌中弃掉本卡牌。

Forced - When the game ends or you are eliminated, if this card is in your hand: You earn 2 fewer experience. [action]: Evade. Use only on an exhausted unengaged enemy at your location. If you succeed, discard this card from your hand.

name: 鲜血失色
text: 作为打出鲜血失色的额外费用，受到2点伤害。 攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。本次攻击得到+2[willpower]并造成+2伤害。
real_text: As an additional cost to play Blood Eclipse, take 2 damage. Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. You get +2 [willpower] and deal +2 damage for this attack.

name: 求生匕首
text: [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。 [reaction]在敌军阶段期间，在敌人攻击你时(在此次攻击结算前)，横置求生匕首：攻击。本次攻击以刚刚发起攻击的敌人为目标。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]并造成+1伤害。
real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. [reaction] When an enemy attacks you during the enemy phase (before resolving that attack), exhaust Survival Knife: Fight. This attack targets the attacking enemy. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.
traits: 道具. 武器. 近战

name: 去伪存真

real_text: Place 2 secrets among assets controlled by investigators at your location (3 secrets instead if there is a clue at your location).
flavor:
“你怎么知道我是疯的？”爱丽丝说。“你肯定疯了。”柴郡猫说，“不然你不会到这儿来。”
——路易斯·卡罗尔，《爱丽丝梦游仙境》

name: 古代巨石
text:
研究完成。使用(X秘密)。X为“你鉴定了古代巨石”旁括号内的数字。
[reaction]在你抽取任意数量的卡牌时，花费等量的秘密：移动等量的次数。
real_text:
Researched. Uses (X secrets). X is the number in parentheses next to "you have identified the stone."
[reaction] When you draw any number of cards, spend that many secrets: Move that many times.

name: 彩饰骷髅
text: 使用(0充能)。 [reaction]在你所在地点有调查员、[[盟友]]支援或敌人被击败后：在彩饰骷髅上放置1资源(从供应堆拿取)，作为充能。 [action]花费最多3充能：抽取等量的卡牌并获得等量资源。
real_text: Uses (0 charges). [reaction] After an investigator, [[Ally]] asset, or enemy at your location is defeated: Place 1 resource (from the token bank) on Decorated Skull, as a charge. [action] Spend up to 3 charges: Draw that many cards and gain that many resources.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 诅咒萦绕

name: 柯尔特袖珍手枪
text: 使用(5子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。本次攻击造成+1伤害。 强制 - 当一轮结束时，如果你执行过柯尔特袖珍手枪的“[action]”能力：将其弃掉。
real_text: Uses (5 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. Forced - At the end of the round, if you triggered Colt Vest Pocket's "[action]" ability: Discard it.
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械. 违法

name: 拉莱耶迷雾
text: 使用(5充能)。 [action]花费1充能：躲避。本次躲避尝试不使用[agility]，改为使用[willpower]。你本次躲避尝试得到+1[willpower]。如果你检定成功，在躲避所选敌人后，你可以移动到一个连接地点。如果本次躲避尝试期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，从你手牌中选择并弃掉一张卡牌。
real_text: Uses (5 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. You get +1 [willpower] for this evasion attempt. If you succeed, after evading the chosen enemy, you may move to a connecting location. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this evasion attempt, choose and discard a card from your hand.

name: 钻地魔虫之石
text: 封印([skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing])。使用(3充能)。如果钻地魔虫之石没有充能，将其返回你的手牌。 强制 - 你在技能检定中揭示[auto_fail]符号后：移除钻地魔虫之石上的1充能。
real_text: Seal ([skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing]). Uses (3 charges). If The Chthonian Stone has no charges, return it to your hand. Forced - After you reveal an [auto_fail] symbol during a skill test: Remove 1 charge from The Chthonian Stone.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 诅咒萦绕

name: 改变命运
text: 选择并弃掉场上一张没有附属到[[精英]]敌人上的非弱点诡计卡牌。
real_text: Choose and discard from play a non-weakness treachery that is not attached to an [[Elite]] enemy.
flavor: 我们的命运由自己书写。

name: 自食其力
text: 卓越。永久。 你的调查员获得：“牌库构建限制：无占用盟友槽位的支援。” [reaction]在你打出一张[survivor]事件卡牌时，横置自食其力：该事件费用减2。
real_text: Exceptional. Permanent. Your investigator gains: "Deckbuilding Restrictions: No assets that take up an ally slot." [reaction] When you play a [survivor] event, exhaust On Your Own: Reduce that event's cost by 2.

deck_options.error: You cannot have assets that take up an ally slot.

name: 背包
text:
[reaction]在背包入场后：查找你牌库顶的12张卡牌，找出最多3张非弱点[[道具]]或[[供给]]卡牌，正面朝下附属到背包上。混洗你的牌库。
附属到背包的卡牌可以被打出，如同其在你手中。如果没有卡牌附属在背包，弃掉背包。
real_text:
[reaction] After Backpack enters play: Search the top 12 cards of your deck for up to 3 non-weakness [[Item]] or [[Supply]] cards, and attach them facedown to Backpack. Shuffle your deck.
Cards attached to Backpack may be played as if they were in your hand. If there are no cards attached to Backpack, discard it.

name: 植形异变
text: 显现 - 将植形异变放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。植形异变上没有伤害时不能离场。 [free]受到1点直接伤害：对植形异变造成1点伤害。 本卡牌由植物学家设计于阿卡姆之夜2018。
real_text: Revelation - Put Dendromorphosis into play in your threat area. It cannot leave play while it has no damage on it. [fast] Take 1 direct damage: Deal 1 damage to Dendromorphosis. Card design by the Botanists at Arkham Nights 2018.
flavor: “植物！”

name: 无法拒绝的提议
text: 剧本模式专用。 在你成为本弱点的承受者时，获得2经验。 显现 - 失去5资源。如果你不能这么做，将无法拒绝的提议从你的牌库中移除。查找收藏，找出附加条款，并将其放入你的弃牌堆。
real_text: Campaign Mode only. When you become the bearer of this weakness, gain 2 experience. Revelation - Lose 5 resources. If you cannot, instead remove Offer You Cannot Refuse from your deck, search the collection for Fine Print, and place it in your discard pile.

name: 附加条款
text: 显现 - 失去7资源。如果你不能这么做，将附加条款从你的牌库中移除。查找收藏，找出出卖灵魂，并将其放入你的弃牌堆。
real_text: Revelation - Lose 7 resources. If you cannot, instead remove Fine Print from your deck, search the collection for Sell Your Soul, and place it in your discard pile.
flavor: 你猩红的签名正从其表面滴落。

name: 出卖灵魂
text: 显现 - 失去10资源。如果你不能这么做，你的黑暗恩主将你的意识从躯体中剥离。你发疯。
real_text: Revelation - Lose 10 resources. If you cannot, your dark patron tears your consciousness from your body. You are driven insane.
flavor: 这笔债，终须以某种方式偿还。

name: 星星·XVII
text:
你控制的每个有生命值的支援得到+1生命值。
你控制的每个有神智值的支援得到+1神智值。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果星星·XVII在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
real_text:
Each asset you control with health gets +1 health.
Each asset you control with sanity gets +1 sanity.
[reaction] When the game begins, if The Star • XVII is in your opening hand: Put it into play.

name: 圣化之镜
text: 每套牌库仅限一张。 [reaction]在你打出一张舒缓旋律时，将上面的所有的“2”改为“3”，或结算后不弃掉，改为将其洗回你的牌库。 强制 - 在圣化之镜入场后：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出3张舒缓旋律。将其中一张加入你手牌，将其余2张洗入你的牌库。
real_text: Limit 1 per deck. [reaction] When you play a copy of Soothing Melody: Either change each "2" on it to a "3," or shuffle it into your deck instead of discarding it. Forced - After Hallowed Mirror enters play: Search your bonded cards for 3 copies of Soothing Melody. Add 1 to your hand and shuffle the other 2 into your deck.
traits: 道具. 遗物. 密教. 祝福

name: 世界·XXI
text:
[free]如果你拥有8张或更多手牌，横置世界·XXI：抽取1张卡牌。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果世界·XXI在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
real_text:
[fast] If you have 8 or more cards in your hand, exhaust The World • XXI: Draw 1 card.
[reaction] When the game begins, if The World • XXI is in your opening hand: Put it into play.

name: 密教词典
text: 每套牌库仅限一张。 [reaction]在你打出一张鲜血仪式时，将上面的所有的“2”改为“3”，或结算后不弃掉，改为将其洗回你的牌库。 强制 - 在密教词典入场后：查找你的绑定卡牌，找出3张鲜血仪式。将其中1张加入你手牌，将其余2张洗入你的牌库。
real_text: Limit 1 per deck. [reaction] When you play a copy of Blood-Rite: Either change each "2" on it to a "3," or shuffle it into your deck instead of discarding it. Forced - After Occult Lexicon enters play: Search your bonded cards for 3 copies of Blood-Rite. Add 1 to your hand and shuffle the other 2 into your deck.
traits: 道具. 书籍. 密教

name: 宝剑骑士
text:
[reaction]在你技能检定将要成功时：你本次技能检定得到技能值+1。你可以弃掉宝剑骑士，改为得到技能值+3。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果宝剑骑士在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
real_text:
[reaction] When you would succeed at a skill test: You get +1 skill value for this test. You may discard Knight of Swords to get +3 instead.
[reaction] When the game begins, if Knight of Swords is in your opening hand: Put it into play.

name: 良好人脉
text:
每位调查员仅限1张。
[free]横置良好人脉：你每有4资源，你本次技能检定得到技能值+1。
[free]花费2资源：重整良好人脉。(每轮仅限一次。)
real_text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[fast] Exhaust Well Connected: You get +1 skill value for this skill test for every 4 resources you have.
[fast] Spend 2 resources: Ready Well Connected. (Limit once per round.)

name: 教皇·V
subname: 真正的导师正等待着你
text:
你拥有额外1个法术槽位。
你的法术槽位可以携带占用饰品槽位的支援，反之亦然。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果教皇·V在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
real_text:
You have 1 additional arcane slot.
Your arcane slots can be used to hold cards that take up accessory slots, and vice versa.
[reaction] When the game begins, if The Hierophant • V is in your opening hand: Put it into play.

name: 魔法手势
text: 快速。 你拥有额外1个法术槽位，只能用来携带一张[[法术]]或[[仪式]]支援。 [reaction]在你执行一个[[法术]]或[[仪式]]支援的一个[action]能力后，横置魔法手势：执行你控制的一个不同的[[法术]]或[[仪式]]支援上的一个[action]能力(不支付其[action]费用)。
real_text: Fast. You have 1 additional arcane slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset. [reaction] After you activate an [action] ability on a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset, exhaust Sign Magick: Activate an [action] ability on a different [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset you control (without paying its [action] cost).

name: 权杖九
text:
[reaction]在你抽取一张非弱点遭遇卡牌时，横置权杖九：取消该卡牌的所有效果并将其洗回遭遇牌库。然后，抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果权杖九在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
real_text:
[reaction] When you draw a non-weakness encounter card, exhaust Nine of Rods: Cancel all of that card's effects and shuffle it into the encounter deck. Then, draw another card from the top of the encounter deck.
[reaction] When the game begins, if Nine of Rods is in your opening hand: Put it into play.

name: 勇闯火线
text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
直到你回合结束，将你所有技能的基础值设为5，或将你一项技能的基础值设为7。
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Until the end of your turn, set the base value of each of your skills to 5, or the base value of one of your skills to 7.
flavor: 只有在你性命受到威胁时，你才会认识到自己能力的极限。

name: 愚者·0
text:
[reaction]在你打出一张卡牌时，横置愚者·0：该卡牌的费用减1。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果愚者·0在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
real_text:
[reaction] When you play a card, exhaust The Fool • 0: Reduce that card's cost by 1.
[reaction] When the game begins, if The Fool • 0 is in your opening hand: Put it into play.

name: 月之吊坠
text:
你拥有额外1个塔罗牌槽位。
你手牌中或投入技能检定中的每张非弱点[[塔罗]]支援获得[wild][wild]。
[reaction]在游戏开始时，如果月之吊坠在你起始手牌中：将其放置入场。
real_text:
You have 1 additional tarot slot.
Each non-weakness [[Tarot]] asset in your hand or committed to a skill test gains [wild] [wild].
[reaction] When the game begins, if Moon Pendant is in your opening hand: Put it into play.

name: 赐福注目
text:
永久。每位调查员仅限1张。
每场游戏冒险设置前，从塔罗牌库随机抽取3张卡牌并选择其中1张。将其以正位放置在你的面前。其他调查员忽略该卡牌的效果。将其余卡牌混洗回塔罗牌库。
real_text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per investigator.
Before setting up each game, draw 3 random cards from the tarot deck and choose 1. Place the chosen card in front of you, in the upright position. Each other investigator ignores its effects. Shuffle the rest back into the tarot deck.

name: 诅咒缠身
text:
永久。
每场游戏冒险设置前，从塔罗牌库随机抽取1张卡牌，并将其以逆位放置在你的面前。其他调查员忽略该卡牌的效果。
real_text:
Permanent.
Before setting up each game, draw a random card from the tarot deck and place the chosen card in front of you, in the reverse position. Each other investigator ignores its effects.

name: 恶魔·XV
text: 恶魔·XV在你手牌中时，你不能打出其他支援。 如果冒险设置期间你抽取了恶魔·XV作为你起始手牌(不论在重调之前还是之后)，你不能将其替换。其必须留在你的起始手牌中。
real_text: You cannot play assets other than The Devil • XV while it is in your hand. If The Devil • XV is drawn in your opening hand during setup (before or after taking a mulligan), you cannot replace it. It must stay in your opening hand.

name: 纳撒尼尔·曹
text:
[reaction]在你通过事件，或事件上的一个攻击能力对一个敌人造成伤害时：造成额外1点伤害。(每阶段仅限一次。)
    [elder_sign]效果：+1。如果攻击期间本次技能检定成功，将你弃牌堆中一张事件返回你的手牌。
real_text:
[reaction] When you deal damage to an enemy by an event or a fight ability on an event: Deal 1 additional damage. (Limit once per phase.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If this skill test is successful during an attack, return an event from your discard pile to your hand.
flavor: “我必须继续战斗。”
back_text: 牌库卡片张数：30。 牌库构建选项：守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：兰道尔·曹、汤米·马洛伊、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 前途无量的拳击手纳撒尼尔·曹，曾有人以重金邀请他参加一场拳赛。争夺冠军，那时他以为自己终于要成功了。但纳撒尼尔的经纪人竟是臭名昭著的欧巴尼恩帮成员，他常常逼迫纳撒尼尔在拳击台上假装倒下，捏造赛果。他出言拒绝，导致自己的哥哥兰道尔出了“意外”。这群黑帮匪徒每晚都危害着阿卡姆市民的安全，纳撒尼尔再也无法容忍他们的所为。现在他将自己的拳头用在正途，在街道上巡逻，保护他人不受伤害。但他很快就发现，阿卡姆的阴影之下危机四伏，不仅仅是黑帮……
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Randall Cho, Tommy Malloy, 1 random basic weakness.

name: 兰德尔·曹
text: 纳撒尼尔·曹牌库专用。 [reaction]在兰道尔·曹入场后：治愈3点伤害，或者查找你的牌库和弃牌堆，找出一张[[武器]]支援，将其打出(支付其费用)，并混洗你的牌库。
real_text: Nathaniel Cho deck only. [reaction] After Randall Cho enters play: Heal 3 damage or search your deck and discard pile for a [[Weapon]] asset, play it (paying its cost), and shuffle your deck.
flavor: "你別幹了，納撒尼爾。早晚你會把自己的命也給搭進去。"

name: 汤米·马洛伊
text: 猎物 - 仅对纳撒尼尔·曹。 猎手。 强制 - 在汤米·马洛伊将要受到任意数量的伤害时：将伤害数量减至1。
real_text: Prey - Nathaniel Cho only. Hunter. Forced - When Tommy Malloy would take any amount of damage: Reduce that amount to 1.
traits: 类人. 罪犯. 犯罪团伙
flavor:
他们都管他叫“大傻”。
纳撒尼尔称呼他为人渣。

name: 自我毁灭
text: 显现 - 将自我毁灭放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。 强制 - 在你将要对一个敌人造成至少1点伤害时：受到1点伤害。 [action][action]:弃掉自我毁灭。
real_text: Revelation - Put Self-Destructive into play in your threat area. Forced - When you deal 1 or more damage to an enemy: Take 1 damage. [action][action]: Discard Self-Destructive.

name: 拳击手套
text:
你攻击时得到+1[combat]。
[reaction]在你击败一个敌人后，横置拳击手套：查找你牌库顶的6张卡牌，找出1张[[勇气]]事件，将其加入你的手牌。混洗你的牌库。
real_text:
You get +1 [combat] while fighting.
[reaction] After you defeat an enemy, exhaust Boxing Gloves: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for a [[Spirit]] event and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

name: 血肉结界
text:
使用(4充能)。
[reaction]在你受到敌人攻击造成的伤害和/或恐惧时，横置血肉结界并花费1充能：取消这次攻击造成的1点伤害或恐惧。
real_text:
Uses (4 charges).
[reaction] When you are dealt damage and/or horror from an enemy attack, exhaust Flesh Ward and spend 1 charge: Cancel 1 damage or horror just dealt from that attack.

name: 格雷特·瓦格纳
text:
你得到+1[combat]。
[reaction]在你击败一个敌人后，横置格雷特·瓦格纳并对其造成1点伤害：发现你所在地点的1个线索。
real_text:
You get +1 [combat].
[reaction] After you defeat an enemy, exhaust Grete Wagner and deal 1 damage to her: Discover 1 clue at your location.
flavor: “生命之所需：水火铁盐面，密奶酒衣油。而我只需前四件。”

name: 体能训练
text:
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[combat]。
real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.

name: 无情
text:
[reaction]在你对一个敌人造成过量伤害时，横置无情：将过量伤害放到无情上。
[free]弃掉无情：获得等于其上伤害数量的资源。
real_text:
[reaction] When you deal excess damage to an enemy, exhaust Relentless: Place that excess damage on Relentless.
[fast] Discard Relentless: Gain resources equal to the amount of damage on it.

name: 安全护卫
text: [reaction]在另一位调查员从你所在地点移动到一个连接地点后，横置安全护卫：移动到该地点。
real_text: [reaction] After another investigator moves from your location to a connecting location, exhaust Safeguard: Move to that location.
flavor:
她告诉我，当心别碰上麻烦。
我翻了个白眼。麻烦事可从没消停过。

name: 干掉他们
text: 攻击。在本次行动开始时，获得2资源。
real_text: Fight. When this action begins, gain 2 resources.
flavor: 该紧紧螺丝了。

name: 还击
text: 快速。在敌人攻击你后打出，即使该攻击被取消。 攻击。本次攻击以刚刚发起攻击的敌人为目标。
real_text: Fast. Play after an enemy attacks you, even if that attack was canceled. Fight. This attack targets the attacking enemy.

name: 闪躲
text:
快速。在一个敌人攻击你所在地点的一位调查员时打出。
取消该次攻击。
real_text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
Cancel that attack.

name: “到这儿来！”
text: 交战。攻击。选择你所在地点或连接地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人。将该敌人移动到你所在地点，与其交战，并攻击该敌人。
real_text: Engage. Fight. Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location or a connecting location. Move that enemy to your location, engage it, and attack it.

name: 荣誉
text:
快速。在你击败一个敌人后打出。
抽取2张卡牌。
real_text:
Fast. Play after you defeat an enemy.
Draw 2 cards.
flavor: 叮，叮，叮！

name: 屠怪勇士

你拥有额外1个手部槽位，只可以用来携带[[书籍]]支援。
[reaction][大学档案员]入场后：查找你牌库顶的6张卡牌，找出一张[[书籍]]支援，并将其加入你的手牌。混洗你的牌库。
real_text:
You have 1 additional hand slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Tome]] asset.
[reaction] After University Archivist enters play: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for a [[Tome]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
traits: 盟友. 米斯卡塔尼克.

name: 腐蚀反应
text: 攻击([intellect])。你本次攻击得到+1[intellect]。如果你控制至少2个线索，本次攻击造成伤害+1。
real_text: Fight ([intellect]). You get +1 [intellect] for this attack. If you control 2 or more clues, this attack deals +1 damage.

name: 镇定自若
text: 躲避([agility])。你本次躲避得到+2[agility]。如果你检定成功且你控制至少2个线索，治愈1点恐惧。
real_text: Evade ([agility]). You get +2 [agility] for this evasion. If you succeed and you control 2 or more clues, heal 1 horror.
flavor: “冷静！我们能挺过去。”

name: 荒唐的素描像
text:
你的地点有线索才能打出。
抽取3张卡牌。
real_text:
Play only if there is a clue on your location.
Draw 3 cards.

name: 精神分析
text: 选择你所在地点的一位调查员并揭示其牌库顶3张卡牌。该调查员可以选择抽取1张揭示的卡牌并将其余卡牌混洗入自己的牌库，或治愈2点恐惧并将揭示的卡牌以任意顺序放回其所有者牌库顶。
real_text: Choose an investigator at your location and reveal the top 3 cards of their deck. That investigator may choose to either draw 1 revealed card and shuffle the rest into their deck, or heal 2 horror and return the revealed cards to the top of their owner's deck in any order.

name: 缓和
text: 谈判。选择你所在地点的一个敌人。治愈等于该敌人恐惧值的恐惧。
real_text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location. Heal horror equal to that enemy's horror value.
flavor: “等一下。让我们停下来想想。”

name: 阴险真相
text: 作为打出阴险真相的额外费用，你可以弃掉最多2张手牌。 攻击([combat])。每有一张卡牌以此方式作为本卡牌的费用弃掉，你本次攻击得到+2[combat]并且造成伤害+1。
real_text: As an additional cost to play Insidious Truths, you may discard up to 2 cards from hand. Fight ([combat]). For each card discarded as part of this card's cost, you get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: 推理
text: 如果调查一个地点时本次技能检定成功，额外发现该地点的1个线索。
real_text: If this skill test is successful while investigating a location, discover 1 additional clue at that location.
flavor: 更大的秘密中一点小小碎片。

name: 构建动机
text: 如果本次技能检定成功，执行检定的调查员查找其牌库顶6张卡牌，找出一张[[洞察]]事件，将其抽取，并混洗其牌库。
real_text: If this skill test is successful, the performing investigator searches the top 6 cards of their deck for an [[Insight]] event, draws it, and shuffles their deck.

name: 文本分析
text: 如果本次技能检定成功，补充你所在地点的一个[[书籍]]支援的1秘密。

flavor: 透镜映照处平时看不见的世界，揭示的一切你却并不想看见。

name: 温妮弗雷德·哈巴莫克
text:
[free]如果在本次技能检定中，你投入了自己控制的2张不同的非弱点卡牌：抽取1张卡牌。(每次检定仅限一次。)
    [elder_sign]效果：+1。在本次技能检定结束后，你每成功超过难度2点，将你本次技能检定投入的一张卡牌返回你的手牌。
real_text:
[fast] If 2 different non-weakness cards you control are committed to this skill test: Draw 1 card. (Limit once per test.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. After this test ends, for every 2 points you succeeded by, return a card you committed to this test to your hand.
flavor: “我能飞得更高。”
back_text: 牌库卡片张数：30。 牌库构建选项：流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：你能做得更好、嚣张、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 温妮弗雷德——她父亲叫她温特尔，朋友们都叫她温妮——在就读的保留地学校里，她是最聪明的孩子之一。但是，她做事不顾后果，不将权威放在眼中，常常因此陷入麻烦。有一天，她从一个农夫的车库里发现了一架陈旧的双翼飞机,决定“把它开上天兜一圈”，她的人生轨迹从此彻底改变。曾是一战飞行员的飞机主人被温妮的天赋所折服，主动提出要将自己的所有技艺传授给她。现在，温妮在全国各地巡回表演，炫耀自己的技术，大家都知道她是个“无所畏惧的女人”。但她的无畏在一场表演当中受到了挑战，她发现了一种自己差点没法描述的生物：它有着皮质的翅膀和一双鼓着脓泡的眼睛。
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Anything You Can Do, Better; Arrogance; 1 random basic weakness.

name: 你能做得更好
text:
温妮弗雷德·哈巴莫克牌库专用。
只能投入你正在进行的技能检定。
real_text:

real_text: Commit only to a skill test you are performing (of any type) that has no other cards committed to it. Other cards cannot be committed to this skill test. If this test fails, return this skill to your hand. Forced - If Reckless is in your hand at the end of your turn: Reveal it and lose 2 resources.

back_flavor: 安德烈13岁的时候，父母讨到了足够的钱给他买一张区巴黎中心剧院的电影票。这种艺术形式折服了安德烈，他很快醉心于银幕，不知疲倦地工作，就为实现自己的好莱坞梦。就在好莱坞拍摄《宇宙之旅》的时候，安德烈经历了无法解释、天翻地覆的事情。现实和幻想的界限已在他脑海中模糊。这时候同行朋友贝琪·巴克斯特建议他换换环境。在贝琪的推荐下，安德烈收拾行装，搬到了马萨诸塞州的小镇阿卡姆。他太需要休息了。

back_text: 牌库卡片张数：30。 牌库构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5。 牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：3张不畏风雪、1张雾之召唤、1张随机基础弱点。
back_flavor: 自打斯特拉在阿卡姆邮局当差以来，她很清楚两件事。第一，她的父母错将她叫做儿子，还给她起了一个男孩儿名字。第二是，在深夜里——国王港悬崖上的小屋曾低声念出了她的真名——她为自己挑选的名字：“斯特拉。”斯特拉每周六天不论天气如何都会派送邮件，这不是一件易事，但她只要想到自己在维系人们之间的联系，便对这份工作满怀热忱。随后她就开始翻找信件。每次她派送到最后，包里总会多出来一个信封。信封上的收件人一直是她，盖有国王港的邮戳。信封里只有一封信，信上是打印的一个词：“斯特拉。”
real_back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 3 copies of Neither Rain nor Snow, 1 copy of Called by the Mists, 1 random basic weakness.
